or other automated processes.

## Usage Guidelines

  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.

````javascript
135: export function getClass(classId) {
136:   return CLASSES[classId] || CLASSES.HERO;
137: }
138: export function computeBaseStats(classId, level) {
139:   const def = getClass(classId);
140:   const stats = {};
141:   for (const [key, base] of Object.entries(def.baseStats)) {
142:     stats[key] = Math.floor(base + def.growthRates[key] * (level - 1));
143:   }
144:   stats.hp = stats.maxHp;
145:   return stats;
146: }
147: export function randomName(classId, existingMembers = []) {
148:   const usedFirsts = new Set(existingMembers.map(m => m.name.split(' ')[0]));
149:   const available = NAMES.first.filter(n => !usedFirsts.has(n));
150:   const pool = available.length > 0 ? available : NAMES.first;
151:   const first = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
152:   const surnames = NAMES.last[classId] || NAMES.last.HERO;
153:   const last = surnames[Math.floor(Math.random() * surnames.length)];
154:   return `${first} ${last}`;
155: }
156: export function getAvailableClasses(_guildRank) {
157:   return Object.values(CLASSES).filter(c => c.recruitCost);
158: }
159: const RECRUIT_COSTS = [50, 75, 100, 150, 500, 1000, 1500];
160: export function getRecruitCost(currentPartySize) {
161:   const idx = Math.max(0, currentPartySize - 1);
162:   if (idx >= RECRUIT_COSTS.length) return RECRUIT_COSTS[RECRUIT_COSTS.length - 1];
163:   return RECRUIT_COSTS[idx];
164: }
````

````javascript
124: export function rankGap(partyRank, viewedRank) {
125:   const pi = RANK_ORDER.indexOf(partyRank);
126:   const vi = RANK_ORDER.indexOf(viewedRank);
127:   if (pi < 0 || vi < 0) return 0;
128:   return pi - vi;
129: }
````

````javascript
1: export function randInt(min, max) {
2:   return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
3: }
````

## File: js/skills/index.js
````javascript
  1: import { CLASS_SKILLS } from './class-skills.js';
  2: import { MASTERIES } from './masteries.js';

 10:   ...SPEC_SKILLS,

 15: export { CLASS_SKILLS, MASTERIES, SPEC_SKILLS, LEGACY_SKILLS, EQUIPMENT_SKILLS, TALENTS };
 16: export const HERO_SPECS = {
 17:   vanguard: {
 18:     id: 'vanguard', label: 'Vanguard', icon: '🛡',

 33: export const HERO_RESPEC_COSTS = {
 34:   F: 7500, E: 13500, D: 22500, C: 37500, B: 56250, A: 90000, S: 187500,

 36: export const HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS = ['AWAKENING', 'SECOND_WIND', 'HERO_ULTIMA'];
 37: export function getSkill(skillId) {
 38:   return SKILLS[skillId] || null;
 39: }
 40: export function getClassSkills(classId) {
 41:   return Object.values(SKILLS)
 42:     .filter(s => s.source === 'class' && s.classId === classId)
 43:     .sort((a, b) => (a.unlockLevel || 0) - (b.unlockLevel || 0));
 44: }
 45: export function getUnlockedClassSkills(classId, level) {
 46:   return getClassSkills(classId).filter(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel <= level);
 47: }
 48: export function getNextClassSkill(classId, currentLevel) {
 49:   return getClassSkills(classId).find(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel > currentLevel) || null;
 50: }
 51: export function getClassMasteries(classId) {
 52:   return Object.values(SKILLS)
 53:     .filter(s => s.source === 'mastery' && s.classId === classId)
 54:     .sort((a, b) => (a.unlockLevel || 0) - (b.unlockLevel || 0));
 55: }
 56: export function getUnlockedClassMasteries(classId, level) {
 57:   return getClassMasteries(classId).filter(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel <= level);
 58: }
 59: export function getNextClassMastery(classId, currentLevel) {
 60:   return getClassMasteries(classId).find(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel > currentLevel) || null;
 61: }
 62: export function getEquipmentSkill(itemId) {
 63:   return Object.values(SKILLS).find(s => s.source === 'equipment' && s.itemId === itemId) || null;
 64: }
 65: export function getEquipmentSkills(itemId) {
 66:   return Object.values(SKILLS).filter(s => s.source === 'equipment' && s.itemId === itemId);
 67: }
 68: export function getSpecSkills(specTrack) {
 69:   if (!specTrack || !HERO_SPECS[specTrack]) return [];
 70:   return HERO_SPECS[specTrack].skills.map(id => SKILLS[id]).filter(Boolean)
 71:     .sort((a, b) => (a.unlockLevel || 0) - (b.unlockLevel || 0));
 72: }
 73: export function getUnlockedSpecSkills(specTrack, level) {
 74:   return getSpecSkills(specTrack).filter(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel <= level);
 75: }
 76: export function getNextSpecSkill(specTrack, currentLevel) {
 77:   return getSpecSkills(specTrack).find(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel > currentLevel) || null;
 78: }
 79: export function getAllClassUnlocks(classId) {
 80:   const skills = getClassSkills(classId).map(s => ({ ...s, unlockType: 'skill' }));
 81:   const masteries = getClassMasteries(classId).map(s => ({ ...s, unlockType: 'mastery' }));
 82:   return [...skills, ...masteries].sort((a, b) => (a.unlockLevel || 0) - (b.unlockLevel || 0));
 83: }
 84: export function getNextUnlock(classId, currentLevel) {
 85:   return getAllClassUnlocks(classId).find(s => s.unlockLevel && s.unlockLevel > currentLevel) || null;
 86: }
 87: export function getMasterySkill(_questsCompleted) { return null; }
 88: export function getAllMasterySkills() { return []; }
 89: export function getNextMasterySkill(_questsCompleted) { return null; }
 90: export function getMemberActiveSkills(member, _party) {
 91:   if (!member || !member.skills) return [];
 92:   return member.skills
 93:     .map(skillId => getSkill(skillId))
 94:     .filter(Boolean)
 95:     .filter(skill => skill.type === 'active');
 96: }
 97: export function getMemberPassiveSkills(member, _party) {
 98:   if (!member || !member.skills) return [];
 99:   return member.skills
100:     .map(skillId => getSkill(skillId))
101:     .filter(Boolean)
102:     .filter(skill => skill.type === 'passive');
103: }
104: export function collectPartyAuras(members) {
105:   const auras = { atk: 0, def: 0, mag: 0, spd: 0, crit: 0, dodge: 0, maxHp: 0, heal: 0 };
106:   if (!members || !Array.isArray(members)) return auras;
107:   for (const member of members) {
108:     if (!member || !member.skills) continue;
109:     const skills = member.skills.map(sid => getSkill(sid)).filter(Boolean);
110:     for (const skill of skills) {
111:       if (skill.type !== 'passive' && skill.procChance < 1.0) continue;
112:       if (!skill.effects) continue;
113:       for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(skill.effects)) {
114:         if (!key.startsWith('party')) continue;
115:         const stat = key.replace(/^party/, '').replace(/Bonus$/, '').replace(/Pct$/, '').toLowerCase();
116:         if (stat === 'atk') auras.atk += value;
117:         else if (stat === 'def') auras.def += value;
118:         else if (stat === 'mag') auras.mag += value;
119:         else if (stat === 'spd') auras.spd += value;
120:         else if (stat === 'crit') auras.crit += value;
121:         else if (stat === 'dodge') auras.dodge += value;
122:         else if (stat === 'hp' || stat === 'maxhp') auras.maxHp += value;
123:         else if (stat === 'heal') auras.heal += value;
124:       }
125:     }
126:   }
127:   return auras;
128: }
129: export function applyPassiveSkills(stats, member, party) {
130:   const passives = getMemberPassiveSkills(member, party);
131:   for (const skill of passives) {
132:     if (!skill.effects) continue;
133:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(skill.effects)) {
134:       if (key.startsWith('party')) continue;
135:       if (key === 'powerMultiplier') continue;
136:       if (key === 'dodgeChance') {
137:         stats.dodgeChance = (stats.dodgeChance || 0) + value;
138:         continue;
139:       }
140:       if (key === 'critChance') {
141:         stats.critChance = (stats.critChance || 0) + value;
142:         continue;
143:       }
144:       if (key === 'healBonus') {
145:         stats.healBonus = (stats.healBonus || 0) + value;
146:         continue;
147:       }
148:       const statKey = key.replace(/Bonus$/, '').replace(/Chance$/, '');
149:       if (['atk', 'def', 'spd', 'mag', 'crit', 'dodge'].includes(statKey)) {
150:         stats[statKey] = Math.floor((stats[statKey] || 0) * (1 + value));
151:       } else if (statKey === 'maxHp') {
152:         stats.maxHp = Math.floor((stats.maxHp || 100) * (1 + value));
153:       }
154:     }
155:   }
156:   return stats;
157: }
158: export function rollActiveSkills(member, party) {
159:   const actives = getMemberActiveSkills(member, party);
160:   const triggered = [];
161:   for (const skill of actives) {
162:     if (Math.random() < (skill.procChance || 1.0)) {
163:       triggered.push(skill);
164:     }
165:   }
166:   return triggered;
167: }
````

````javascript
 470: let _sim = null;
 471: let _simQuestId = null;
 472: function buildSimulation(aq, quest) {
 473:   const seed = aq.startedAt;
 474:   const members = aq.partySnapshot || [];
 475:   const enemyNames = quest.enemies || ['Monster'];
 476:   const envName = quest.environment ? esc(quest.environment.name) : 'the unknown';
 477:   let dmgBonus = 1 + (Game.getDmgBonus ? Game.getDmgBonus(aq.questId) : 0);
 478:   const dmgReduction = Game.getDmgReduction ? Game.getDmgReduction(aq.questId) : 0;
 479:   let atkSpeedBonus = Game.getAtkSpeedBonus ? Game.getAtkSpeedBonus(aq.questId) : 0;
 480:   const _ht = (id) => Game.hasTalent ? Game.hasTalent(id) : false;
 481:   const isBossQuest = !!quest.boss;
 482:   if (_ht('PARTY_SIEGE') && isBossQuest) dmgBonus += 0.25;
 483:   const simAuras = Game.getPartyAuras ? Game.getPartyAuras() : null;
 484:   const partyHealAura = simAuras ? simAuras.heal : 0;
 485:   let healBonus = 1 + (Game.getHealBonus ? Game.getHealBonus(aq.questId) : 0) + partyHealAura;
 486:   const effectiveInterval = EVENT_INTERVAL * (1 - atkSpeedBonus);
 487:   const partyHp = members.map(m => {
 488:     const member = Game.getMember(m.id);
 489:     const eff = member ? Game.effectiveStats(member, simAuras) : m.stats;
 490:     return {
 491:       id: m.id, name: esc(m.name), class: m.class,
 492:       maxHp: eff.maxHp || m.stats.maxHp || 100,
 493:       hp: eff.hp || eff.maxHp || m.stats.hp || 100,
 494:       level: m.level, power: m.power || 20,
 495:       atk: eff.atk || m.stats.atk || 10,
 496:       mag: eff.mag || m.stats.mag || 1,
 497:       def: eff.def || m.stats.def || 5,
 498:       spd: eff.spd || m.stats.spd || 10,
 499:       crit: eff.crit || m.stats.crit || 0,
 500:       dodge: eff.dodge || m.stats.dodge || 0,
 501:       dodgeChance: eff.dodgeChance || 0,
 502:       critChance: eff.critChance || 0,
 503:       healBonus: eff.healBonus || 0,
 504:     };
 505:   });
 506:   const memberHealBonuses = partyHp
 507:     .filter(p => p.class === 'CLERIC' || p.class === 'BARD')
 508:     .map(p => p.healBonus || 0);
 509:   if (memberHealBonuses.length > 0) {
 510:     healBonus += Math.max(...memberHealBonuses);
 511:   }
 512:   const _combatDebug = {
 513:     healBonus: { synergy: Game.getHealBonus ? Game.getHealBonus(aq.questId) : 0, partyAura: partyHealAura, memberItem: memberHealBonuses.length ? Math.max(...memberHealBonuses) : 0, total: healBonus },
 514:     dmgBonus, dmgReduction, atkSpeedBonus,
 515:     partyAuras: simAuras,
 516:     members: partyHp.map(p => ({
 517:       id: p.id, name: p.name, class: p.class, level: p.level,
 518:       atk: p.atk, def: p.def, mag: p.mag, spd: p.spd, crit: p.crit, dodge: p.dodge,
 519:       maxHp: p.maxHp, dodgeChance: p.dodgeChance || 0, critChance: p.critChance || 0, healBonus: p.healBonus || 0,
 520:       skills: Game.getActiveMemberSkills ? Game.getActiveMemberSkills(p.id) : [],
 521:     })),
 522:     atb: {
 523:       totalRounds: 0,
 524:       laneActions: {},
 525:       procRolls: [],
 526:       gaugeSnapshots: [],
 527:       equipProcs: [],
 528:       reactiveEvents: [],
 529:       roundSummaries: [],
 530:     },
 531:   };
 532:   function sPickWeighted(arr, seed) {
 533:     if (arr.length === 0) return null;
 534:     if (arr.length === 1) return arr[0];
 535:     const weights = arr.map(m => Math.sqrt((m.spd || 10) + 5) * 6 + 8);
 536:     const total = weights.reduce((s, w) => s + w, 0);
 537:     let roll = sRand(seed) * total;
 538:     for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
 539:       roll -= weights[i];
 540:       if (roll <= 0) return arr[i];
 541:     }
 542:     return arr[arr.length - 1];
 543:   }
 544:   const pendingEquipBuffs = {};
 545:   function consumePendingEquipBuff(memberId) {
 546:     const buf = pendingEquipBuffs[memberId];
 547:     if (!buf) return null;
 548:     delete pendingEquipBuffs[memberId];
 549:     return buf;
 550:   }
 551:   function calcPartyDmg(attacker, seed, bonus) {
 552:     const isMagic = isMagicClass(attacker.class);
 553:     const stat = isMagic ? (attacker.mag || 1) : (attacker.atk || 10);
 554:     const multiplier = COMBAT_TUNING.PARTY_DMG_MIN_MULT + sRand(seed) * COMBAT_TUNING.PARTY_DMG_SPREAD;
 555:     let dmg = Math.max(2, Math.floor(stat * multiplier * bonus));
 556:     const buf = consumePendingEquipBuff(attacker.id);
 557:     if (buf && buf.effects) {
 558:       const e = buf.effects;
 559:       const empowerMult = 1.0 + (e.atkBonus || 0) + (e.magBonus || 0) + (e.powerMultiplier ? (e.powerMultiplier - 1) : 0);
 560:       dmg = Math.max(2, Math.floor(dmg * empowerMult));
 561:     }
 562:     return dmg;
 563:   }
 564:   function applyDef(rawDmg, defender) {
 565:     const def = defender.def || 0;
 566:     const reduction = def / (def + COMBAT_TUNING.DEF_SOFTCAP);
 567:     return Math.max(1, Math.floor(rawDmg * (1 - reduction)));
 568:   }
 569:   function critChance(attacker) {
 570:     const c = attacker.crit || 0;
 571:     const flatBonus = attacker.critChance || 0;
 572:     return Math.min(COMBAT_TUNING.CRIT_CAP, c / (c + COMBAT_TUNING.CRIT_SOFTCAP) + flatBonus);
 573:   }
 574:   function dodgeChance(defender) {
 575:     const d = defender.dodge || 0;
 576:     const flatBonus = defender.dodgeChance || 0;
 577:     return Math.min(COMBAT_TUNING.DODGE_CAP, d / (d + COMBAT_TUNING.DODGE_SOFTCAP) + flatBonus);
 578:   }
 579:   if (_ht('PARTY_CEL_RESONANCE')) {
 580:     for (const p of partyHp) {
 581:       const member = Game.getMember(p.id);
 582:       if (!member) continue;
 583:       const slots = ['weapon', 'armor', 'offhand', 'accessory'];
 584:       let hasCelestial = false;
 585:       for (const slot of slots) {
 586:         const itemId = member.equipment?.[slot];
 587:         if (itemId && itemId.startsWith('CEL_')) { hasCelestial = true; break; }
 588:       }
 589:       if (hasCelestial) {
 590:         p.atk = Math.floor(p.atk * 1.10);
 591:         p.def = Math.floor(p.def * 1.10);
 592:         p.mag = Math.floor(p.mag * 1.10);
 593:         p.spd = Math.floor(p.spd * 1.10);
 594:         p.crit = Math.floor(p.crit * 1.10);
 595:         p.dodge = Math.floor(p.dodge * 1.10);
 596:         p.maxHp = Math.floor(p.maxHp * 1.10);
 597:         p.hp = p.maxHp;
 598:       }
 599:     }
 600:   }
 601:   const talentChainStrike = _ht('HRO_CHAIN_STRIKE');
 602:   const talentRallyingHeal = _ht('HRO_RALLYING_HEAL');
 603:   const talentWhirlwindHeal = _ht('HRO_WHIRLWIND_HEAL');
 604:   const talentDefShred = _ht('KNT_DEF_SHRED');
 605:   const talentKntCounter = _ht('KNT_COUNTER');
 606:   const talentTauntAura = _ht('KNT_TAUNT_AURA');
 607:   const talentBlizzardFrost = _ht('MAG_BLIZZARD_FROST');
 608:   const talentMeteorBurn = _ht('MAG_METEOR_BURN');
 609:   const talentArcaneReflect = _ht('MAG_ARCANE_REFLECT');
 610:   const talentPoison = _ht('ROG_POISON');
 611:   const talentSmokeHeal = _ht('ROG_SMOKE_HEAL');
 612:   const talentExecute = _ht('ROG_EXECUTE');
 613:   const talentSacredWarmth = _ht('CLR_SHIELD_HOT');
 614:   const talentSmiteBurn = _ht('CLR_SMITE_BURN');
 615:   const talentWrath = _ht('CLR_WRATH');
 616:   const talentVolleySlow = _ht('RNG_VOLLEY_SLOW');
 617:   const talentSharedCamo = _ht('RNG_SHARED_CAMO');
 618:   const talentStormMark = _ht('RNG_STORM_MARK');
 619:   const talentDiscordDmg = _ht('BRD_DISCORD_DMG');
 620:   const talentCrescendoAlly = _ht('BRD_CRESCENDO_ALLY');
 621:   const talentSymphonyLeech = _ht('BRD_SYMPHONY_LEECH');
 622:   const talentDeepKi = _ht('MNK_KI_BOOST');
 623:   const talentRetaliating = _ht('MNK_COUNTER_ATK');
 624:   const talentInfiniteFists = _ht('MNK_FURY_PLUS');

 637:   function tryCelestialCascade(dmgDealt, hitTarget, attackerObj, seed, isEcho = false) {
 638:     if (!talentCelCascade) return false;
 639:     if (sRand(seed) >= 0.25) return false;
 640:     const splashDmg = Math.max(1, Math.floor(dmgDealt * 0.50));
 641:     let cascadeHits = 0;
 642:     const currentLiving = enemies.filter(e => e.alive);
 643:     for (const e of currentLiving) {
 644:       if (hitTarget && e.id === hitTarget.id) continue;
 645:       if (e.hp <= 0) continue;
 646:       e.hp = Math.max(0, e.hp - splashDmg);
 647:       if (combatStats[attackerObj.id]) combatStats[attackerObj.id].dmgDealt += splashDmg;
 648:       cascadeHits++;
 649:       if (e.hp <= 0) { e.alive = false; fallenEnemies.push(e.name); tryRaiseDead(e, seed + cascadeHits); }
 650:     }
 651:     if (cascadeHits > 0) {
 652:       const foeWord = cascadeHits === 1 ? 'foe' : 'foes';
 653:       const cascadeText = isEcho
 654:         ? `⚡ <strong>HARMONIC CASCADE!</strong> ${attackerObj.name}'s echo reverberates — energy tears through ${cascadeHits} ${foeWord} for <span class="dmg-num dmg-celestial">${splashDmg}</span> each!`
 655:         : `💫 <strong>CELESTIAL CASCADE!</strong> Energy arcs from ${attackerObj.name}'s strike to ${cascadeHits} ${foeWord} for <span class="dmg-num dmg-celestial">${splashDmg}</span> each!`;
 656:       events.push({
 657:         text: cascadeText,
 658:         type: 'celestial', icon: isEcho ? '⚡' : '💫', phase: 'battle',
 659:       });
 660:       snapshots.push(makeSnapshot(partyHp, enemies, _bufState));
 661:     }
 662:     return cascadeHits > 0;
 663:   }

1305:     if (!corpse || necroMinions.length !== 0) return false;

1313:     const minionDmg = Math.max(2, Math.floor(availableNecro.mag * 0.7));

1318:       def: minionDef, dmgPerTick: minionDmg, ownerId: availableNecro.id,
1319:     });

4073: function ensureSim() {
4074:   const aq = Game.state.guild.activeQuest;
4075:   if (!aq) { _sim = null; _simQuestId = null; return null; }
4076:   const quest = aq.questData || Game.getGeneratedQuest(aq.questId) || getQuest(aq.questId);
4077:   if (!quest) return null;
4078:   if (_simQuestId !== aq.questId) {
4079:     try {
4080:       _sim = buildSimulation(aq, quest);
4081:       _simQuestId = aq.questId;
4082:     } catch (err) {
4083:       console.error('[CombatSim] buildSimulation crashed — clearing stuck quest:', err);
4084:       _sim = null;
4085:       _simQuestId = null;
4086:       Game.state.guild.activeQuest = null;
4087:       return null;
4088:     }
4089:   }
4090:   return _sim;
4091: }
4092: export function getBattleOutcome() {
4093:   return _sim ? _sim.battleOutcome : null;
4094: }
4095: function _getInterval() {
4096:   return _sim ? _sim.effectiveInterval : EVENT_INTERVAL;
4097: }
4098: const FAST_FORWARD_INTERVAL = 0.08;
4099: function _computeVisibleCount(sim, aq) {
4100:   if (!sim || !aq) return 0;
4101:   const interval = sim.effectiveInterval || EVENT_INTERVAL;
4102:   const elapsedSec = (Date.now() - aq.startedAt) / 1000;
4103:   const decisive = (sim.decisiveIndex != null) ? sim.decisiveIndex : sim.totalEvents - 1;
4104:   const decisiveTime = (decisive + 1) * interval;
4105:   if (elapsedSec <= decisiveTime) {
4106:     return Math.min(sim.totalEvents, Math.max(1, Math.floor(elapsedSec / interval) + 1));
4107:   }
4108:   const extraSec = elapsedSec - decisiveTime;
4109:   const extraEvents = Math.floor(extraSec / FAST_FORWARD_INTERVAL);
4110:   return Math.min(sim.totalEvents, decisive + 1 + extraEvents);
4111: }
4112: export function generateCombatLog() {
4113:   const aq = Game.state.guild.activeQuest;
4114:   if (!aq) { _sim = null; _simQuestId = null; return []; }
4115:   const sim = ensureSim();
4116:   if (!sim) return [];
4117:   const visibleCount = _computeVisibleCount(sim, aq);
4118:   return sim.events.slice(0, visibleCount);
4119: }

4122:   if (!aq || !_sim) return null;

4124:   return _sim.snapshots[visibleCount - 1] || null;
4125: }

4132:     decisiveIndex: sim.decisiveIndex != null ? sim.decisiveIndex : sim.totalEvents - 1,
4133:     fastForwardMs: FAST_FORWARD_INTERVAL * 1000,
4134:   };
4135: }
4136: export function getCombatStats() {
4137:   const sim = ensureSim();
4138:   if (!sim || !sim.combatStats) return null;
4139:   return Object.values(sim.combatStats);
4140: }
4141: export function getCombatDebug() {
````

````javascript
116:       <p class="comp-text">Each character's power is calculated as: (ATK × 2) + DEF + SPD + (MAX HP / 10) + (MAG × 1.5) + CRIT + (DODGE × 0.5). This gives a rough measure of overall combat contribution, but the real value depends on party composition and role.</p>
117:     </div>
118:   `;

246: // ── Equipment & Procs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
247: function renderEquipment() {
248:   const rarityOrder = ['common', 'magic', 'rare', 'epic', 'legendary', 'celestial'];
249:   const rarityDescs = {
250:     common:    'Basic starter gear. Stats only, no special effects.',
251:     magic:     'Modest upgrades over common gear. Available in shops early on.',
252:     rare:      'Solid mid-game gear with broader stat coverage. Some rare items grant skill procs.',
253:     epic:      'Strong endgame equipment. Many pieces grant active skill procs.',
254:     legendary: 'Best-in-slot below celestial. Every legendary grants a unique active skill proc.',
255:     celestial: 'God-tier S/S+/S++ drops. Each class has a full 4-piece set with massive stats and celestial-tier skill procs with special visual effects. Drop rates increase at S+ and S++, and Raid Bosses guarantee celestial-only loot.',
256:   };
257:   const rarityInfo = rarityOrder.map(id => ({
258:     id,
259:     label: ITEM_RARITIES[id].label,
260:     color: ITEM_RARITIES[id].color,
261:     desc: rarityDescs[id],
262:   }));
263:   const rarityRows = rarityInfo.map(r => `
264:     <div class="comp-rarity-row">
265:       <span class="comp-rarity-badge" style="color:${r.color};border-color:${r.color}40">${r.label}</span>
266:       <span class="comp-rarity-desc">${r.desc}</span>
267:     </div>
268:   `).join('');
269:   // Collect all items with procs (epic, legendary, celestial)
270:   const items = Object.values(EQUIPMENT);
271:   const procItems = items
272:     .filter(it => it.grantedSkill || (it.grantedSkills && it.grantedSkills.length))
273:     .sort((a, b) => {
274:       const ri = rarityOrder.indexOf(a.rarity) - rarityOrder.indexOf(b.rarity);
275:       if (ri !== 0) return ri;
276:       return (a.classReq?.[0] || 'ZZZ').localeCompare(b.classReq?.[0] || 'ZZZ');
277:     });
278:   const effectLabels = {
279:     atkBonus: 'ATK', defBonus: 'DEF', magBonus: 'MAG', spdBonus: 'SPD',
280:     critChance: 'Crit', critBonus: 'Crit', dodgeChance: 'Dodge', dodgeBonus: 'Dodge',
281:     defPierce: 'Armor Pierce', powerMultiplier: 'Power', healBonus: 'Heal',
282:     maxHpBonus: 'Max HP',
283:   };
284:   function formatEffects(effects) {
285:     if (!effects) return '—';
286:     return Object.entries(effects).map(([key, val]) => {
287:       const label = effectLabels[key] || key;
288:       if (key === 'powerMultiplier') return `${val}× ${label}`;
289:       return `+${Math.round(val * 100)}% ${label}`;
290:     }).join(', ');
291:   }
292:   const procRows = procItems.flatMap(it => {
293:     const skillIds = [].concat(it.grantedSkill || [], it.grantedSkills || []);
294:     const rarity = getItemRarity(it);
295:     const classStr = it.classReq ? it.classReq.map(c => CLASSES[c]?.sigil || c).join('/') : 'Any';
296:     return skillIds.map(skId => {
297:       const skill = SKILLS[skId];
298:       if (!skill) return '';
299:       const isPassive = skill.type === 'passive' || skill.procChance >= 1.0;
300:       const procStr = isPassive
301:         ? '<span class="comp-proc-passive">Passive</span>'
302:         : `<span class="comp-proc-chance">${Math.round(skill.procChance * 100)}%</span>`;
303:       const durationStr = isPassive ? 'Always active' : '1 round (2-round CD)';
304:       const effectStr = formatEffects(skill.effects);
305:       return `
306:         <div class="comp-item-row">
307:           <span class="comp-item-name" style="color:${rarity.color}">${it.name}</span>
308:           <span class="comp-item-slot">${it.slot}</span>
309:           <span class="comp-item-class">${classStr}</span>
310:           <span class="comp-item-skill">${skill.icon || '•'} ${skill.name}${AOE_SKILL_IDS.has(skId) ? ' <span class="comp-aoe-badge">AoE</span>' : ''}</span>
311:           <span class="comp-item-proc">${procStr}</span>
312:           <span class="comp-item-effects">${effectStr}</span>
313:           <span class="comp-item-duration">${durationStr}</span>
314:         </div>
315:       `;
316:     });
317:   }).join('');
318:   return `
319:     <div class="comp-section">
320:       <h2 class="comp-title">Equipment & Procs</h2>
321:       <p class="comp-text">Gear comes in four slots — Weapon, Armor, Offhand, and Accessory — across six rarity tiers. Two-handed weapons (Bard instruments, some greatswords/staves) carry ~1.5× stats to compensate for the lost offhand slot. The Hero's celestial set offers a unique choice: Dawnbreaker (1H sword) + Ascendant Ward (shield) for balanced builds, or the Godslayer (2H greatsword) for Champions who trade defense for devastating offensive power — it grants both an active proc and a passive aura to compensate for the lost shield slot.</p>
322:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Rarity Tiers</h3>
323:       ${rarityRows}
324:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Loot Drops by Rank</h3>
325:       <p class="comp-text">Each guild rank drops equipment from specific rarity tiers. Normal quests draw from the rank's pool. Boss quests skip the current tier entirely and drop gear from the next tier up, with a chance at two tiers up, plus a small chance at celestial drops regardless of rank.</p>
326:       <div class="comp-loot-table">
327:         <div class="comp-loot-header"><span>Rank</span><span>Normal Drops</span><span>Boss Drops</span></div>
328:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-F">F</span><span>Common</span><span>Magic, Magic+Rare, Celestial</span></div>
329:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-E">E</span><span>Magic</span><span>Magic+Rare, Rare, Celestial</span></div>
330:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-D">D</span><span>Magic, Rare</span><span>Rare, Rare+Epic, Celestial</span></div>
331:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-C">C</span><span>Rare</span><span>Rare+Epic, Epic+Legendary, Celestial</span></div>
332:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-B">B</span><span>Rare, Epic</span><span>Epic+Legendary, Legendary+Celestial</span></div>
333:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-A">A</span><span>Epic, Legendary</span><span>Legendary+Celestial</span></div>
334:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-S">S</span><span>Legendary, Celestial</span><span>Legendary, Celestial (increased)</span></div>
335:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-S">S+</span><span>Legendary, Celestial+</span><span>Legendary, Celestial (highest)</span></div>
336:         <div class="comp-loot-row"><span class="rank-S">S++</span><span>Legendary, Celestial++</span><span>Legendary, Celestial (highest)</span></div>
337:       </div>
338:       <p class="comp-text" style="margin-top:8px; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--text-muted)">Celestial drop rates from bosses are very low at early ranks but scale significantly at S and above. Boss fights are designed to be meaningful progression milestones — beating one rewards you with gear from the next tier of content.</p>
339:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Equipment Skill Procs</h3>
340:       <p class="comp-text">Some rare, epic, legendary, and celestial items grant unique skills when equipped. Active procs trigger each round based on their proc chance, last for 1 round, then enter a 2-round cooldown. Passive procs are always active. These appear in combat alongside class skills and rotate via the round-robin cooldown system.</p>
341:       <div class="comp-item-table">
342:         <div class="comp-item-header">
343:           <span>Item</span><span>Slot</span><span>Class</span><span>Skill</span><span>Proc</span><span>Effects</span><span>Duration</span>
344:         </div>
345:         ${procRows}
346:       </div>
347:     </div>
348:   `;
349: }
350: // ── Combat Mechanics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
351: function renderCombat() {
352:   return `
353:     <div class="comp-section">
354:       <h2 class="comp-title">Combat Mechanics</h2>
355:       <p class="comp-text">Combat is a fully deterministic simulation. Each quest has a seeded random number generator — replaying the same quest seed produces identical results.</p>
356:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Battle Phases</h3>
357:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Travel</strong> — 2 flavor events as the party approaches the quest location.</p>
358:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Encounter</strong> — The party spots the enemies. Combat begins.</p>
359:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Battle</strong> — The main loop. Each round, a random event type is rolled: party attack (35%), party skill (15%), enemy attack (22%), party defend (10%), heal/regen (8%), or reinforcement (10%). Combat continues until all enemies or all party members are eliminated.</p>
360:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Resolution</strong> — Victory or defeat is declared. If the fight hits the event cap without a clear winner, the side with more survivors wins.</p>
361:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Damage Formulas</h3>
362:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Party attack damage:</strong> ATK (or MAG for casters) × random multiplier (1.8–2.8) × synergy bonus. Skills deal 1.25× this amount. Volley hits all enemies at 0.60× per target.</p>
363:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Critical hits:</strong> 1.5× damage. Chance based on CRIT stat: CRIT / (CRIT + 100).</p>
364:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Enemy damage:</strong> Enemy ATK × random multiplier (0.5–1.2), then reduced by defender's DEF: DEF / (DEF + 60), then further reduced by synergy damage reduction and any active Divine Shield (−15%).</p>
365:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Dodge:</strong> Before taking damage, the defender rolls to dodge: DODGE / (DODGE + 80). Ranger Camouflage adds a flat +40% on top of this. A dodge negates all damage from that attack.</p>
366:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">SPD & Action Selection</h3>
367:       <p class="comp-text">When the sim picks which party member acts, it uses weighted random selection based on SPD. Each member's weight is (SPD + 5). A Rogue with 140 SPD is roughly 6× more likely to be selected than a Knight with 25 SPD. This affects offensive actions only — healing, Bulwark intercepts, and bard regen are on separate tracks and trigger independently of SPD.</p>
368:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Skill Round-Robin</h3>
369:       <p class="comp-text">When a party member gets a "skill use" turn, the sim picks from their active skills only (passives are always-on and never consume a turn). After using a skill, it goes on a 2-round cooldown. This forces variety — every active skill will see play across a longer fight. If all skills are on cooldown, any active becomes available again.</p>
370:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Special Mechanics</h3>
371:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Bulwark (Knight):</strong> Reactively intercepts hits aimed at allies every 3 rounds. Independent of SPD — always triggers when ready.</p>
372:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Rally Cry (Hero):</strong> When any ally drops below 30% HP, a Hero with this skill automatically heals them for 15% of their max HP. 4-round cooldown.</p>
373:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Mark for Death (Rogue):</strong> On a critical hit, marks the target. All party members deal +20% damage to marked enemies for 2 rounds.</p>
374:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Ki Barrier (Monk):</strong> 25% of all damage dealt is returned as HP. Self-sustain without a healer.</p>
375:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Spell Echo (Mage):</strong> After casting a skill, the Mage gains 1.5× damage for 2 rounds.</p>
376:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Divine Intervention (Cleric):</strong> When an ally would be killed, the Cleric intercepts the killing blow and saves them at 1 HP. 4-round cooldown.</p>
377:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Resurrection (Cleric):</strong> After a group heal, if any party members are KO'd, the Cleric revives one at 40% HP. 3-round cooldown.</p>
378:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Divine Shield (Cleric):</strong> After a group heal, the entire party takes 15% less damage for 3 rounds.</p>
379:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Divine Presence (Cleric):</strong> Epic passive aura — party gains +15% MAG, +12% DEF, +10% MAX HP, and +8% healing.</p>
380:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Discord (Bard):</strong> A devastating debuff on all enemies for 3 rounds: -20% ATK, 25% chance to fumble attacks entirely, and sonic damage each round (scales off MAG). 4-round cooldown. Casts automatically after regen.</p>
381:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Crescendo (Bard):</strong> Buffs the next party attack to be a guaranteed devastating critical hit at 2.5× damage (instead of the normal 1.5× crit). 3-round cooldown.</p>
382:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Symphony of War (Bard):</strong> Epic passive aura — party gains +15% ATK, +12% SPD, +8% CRIT.</p>
383:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Camouflage (Ranger):</strong> After using Volley, gains +40% dodge chance for 2 rounds.</p>
384:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Hero Specialization Mechanics</h3>
385:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Vanguard's Oath:</strong> Reactive intercept (like Bulwark) with 40% damage reduction. Absorbs hits meant for allies. 3-round cooldown. Checked when no Knight Bulwark is available.</p>
386:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Unbreakable Will:</strong> When the Vanguard Hero would be killed, survives at 1 HP with 80% damage reduction for 2 rounds. 5-round cooldown. Checked before Divine Intervention.</p>
387:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Executioner's Mark:</strong> When any enemy drops below 30% HP, the Champion Hero delivers a bonus 2.0× ATK finishing strike. 3-round cooldown.</p>
388:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Bloodlust:</strong> After any enemy kill, the Champion's next attack deals 1.5× damage. Passive stat bonuses always active: +20% ATK, +15% CRIT chance, +12% SPD.</p>
389:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Hero's Wrath:</strong> Active skill (45% proc). Deals a guaranteed 3.0× critical hit. Devastating when combined with Bloodlust.</p>
390:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Guardian Spirit:</strong> When any ally drops below 25% HP, the Warden Hero heals them for 30% of their max HP. 3-round cooldown.</p>
391:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>War Banner:</strong> Passive party aura — ATK +12%, DEF +10%, SPD +8%, CRIT +5%. Always active.</p>
392:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Second Dawn:</strong> When 2+ allies are KO'd, the Warden revives ALL fallen allies at 25% HP. Once per fight.</p>
393:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Raid Bosses (S++ Only)</h3>
394:       <p class="comp-text">Raid Bosses are the ultimate combat encounters, exclusive to S++ rank. They are significantly more powerful than standard bosses and use the same combat simulation, but with dramatically higher difficulty scaling.</p>
395:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Celestial-only loot:</strong> Raid Bosses suppress all non-celestial equipment drops. Every piece of gear that drops from a raid is guaranteed celestial rarity.</p>
396:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Guaranteed drops:</strong> Normal bosses guarantee 4–8 loot drops. Raid Bosses guarantee 8–12 drops, making them the most rewarding encounters in the game.</p>
397:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Drop rate boost:</strong> Celestial drop chance is massively amplified on raids (up to 45% cap vs 25% for normal S++ quests). This makes raid bosses the fastest path to completing celestial sets.</p>
398:     </div>
399:   `;
400: }

483:         <div class="combat-log-entry log-dodge"><span class="log-icon">💨</span><span class="log-text">Lyra deftly sidesteps — the attack misses!</span></div>

488:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Design Principles</h3>
489:       <div class="clg-principles">
490:         <p><strong>One background per event type.</strong> Every row immediately tells you what's happening through its subtle background tint and left-border accent.</p>
491:         <p><strong>Uniform body text.</strong> All descriptive text is the same warm off-white. The background and highlights do the work — body text stays neutral and readable.</p>
492:         <p><strong>Skill names pop.</strong> Each skill category gets one consistent highlight color — gold for class skills, amber for AoE, purple for magic, blue for buffs, teal for reactives. The skill name is the only colored word in the sentence.</p>
493:         <p><strong>Numbers match their source.</strong> Physical = white, skill = gold, magic = purple, heals = green, enemy = red, crits = bright gold glow, DoTs = orange. Always consistent.</p>
494:         <p><strong>Weight = importance.</strong> Crits, defeats, KOs, and divine saves get bold text. Travel and dodges are italic and muted — low priority info stays quiet.</p>
495:       </div>
496:       <!-- ═══ READING TIPS ═══ -->
497:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Reading Tips</h3>
498:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Round markers</strong> appear as centered dividers showing the round number. Events within each round are listed sequentially for readability.</p>
499:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Reactive abilities</strong> (Ki Barrier, Bulwark, Divine Intervention, Riposte) trigger automatically and appear as separate entries from the triggering attack.</p>
500:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Equipment procs</strong> fire after their triggering attack. Look for purple-highlighted proc names like Lifesteal or Spell Echo.</p>
501:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>KO and Revival</strong> — a red KO entry may be followed by a golden divine entry if a Cleric has Resurrection ready.</p>
502:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Target counts</strong> in multi-hit attacks are colored to match the damage type — e.g. an amber "5" in "5 enemies battered" matches the amber AoE damage chip.</p>
503:     </div>
504:   `;
505: }
506: // ── Tower Climb Guide ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
507: function renderTowerGuide() {

523:   return `

525:       <h2 class="comp-title">The Endless Tower</h2>

527:       ${bestFloor > 0 || totalRuns > 0 ? `
528:         <div class="comp-tower-stats">
529:           <span><strong>Best Floor:</strong> ${bestFloor}</span>
530:           <span><strong>Total Runs:</strong> ${totalRuns}</span>

Here you can choose to continue climbing (your party is partially healed) or teleport back to the guild with your rewards. Pushing further means bigger rewards — but risk losing everything if your party falls.</p>
536:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Party Defeat:</strong> If your party is defeated, the run ends immediately. You still receive rewards for all the floors you cleared before the defeat, but you won't benefit from continuing further.</p>

539:       <p class="comp-text">Enemy tiers increase as you climb: basic tower guardians on early floors give way to elite constructs, shadow entities, and eventually celestial-tier threats on the highest floors.</p>

543:       <p class="comp-text"><strong>Celestial Drops:</strong> Starting from floor 10, you gain an increasing chance at celestial equipment drops. The chance grows by roughly 4% every 10 floors, up to a 50% maximum, with up to 5 celestial items possible per run.</p>
544:       <h3 class="comp-subtitle">Tower Gem Bags</h3>

552:     </div>

617: // ── Guild Legacy Guide ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
618: function renderLegacyGuide() {
619:   const talents = Game.LEGACY_TALENTS;
620:   if (!talents) {
621:     return `<div class="comp-section"><h2 class="comp-title">Guild Legacy</h2><p class="comp-text">Guild Legacy unlocks at S++ rank.</p></div>`;
622:   }
623:   // Only show party-wide talents here — per-class talents are on each class page
624:   const partyTalents = Object.values(talents).filter(t => !t.classId).sort((a, b) => a.tier - b.tier);
625:   let partySection = '';
626:   if (partyTalents.length > 0) {
627:     const rows = partyTalents.map(t => `<div class="comp-legacy-talent">
628:       <span class="comp-legacy-icon">${t.icon}</span>
629:       <div class="comp-legacy-info">
630:         <span class="comp-legacy-name">${t.label} <span class="comp-legacy-tier">Tier ${t.tier} &middot; ${t.cost} pt${t.cost > 1 ? 's' : ''} &middot; Req Lv.${t.reqLevel}</span></span>
631:         <span class="comp-legacy-desc">${t.desc}</span>
632:       </div>

834:         <p><strong>Brutal(N) ≈ Easy(N+1).</strong> The hardest fights of one rank overlap with the easiest fights of the next. This smooths the rank-up transition.</p>
835:         <p><strong>Boss add quality scales with rank.</strong> F-rank bosses bring weak minions. S++ bosses are surrounded by generals. The boss itself is always the same relative threat — it's the entourage that gets dangerous.</p>
836:         <p><strong>Tower is the endgame stress test.</strong> The +6% compounding floor scaling means Floor 50 enemies have nearly 4× the stats of Floor 1. Floor 100 is designed to be a wall that only fully optimized parties can clear.</p>
837:       </div>
838:     </div>
839:   `;
````

## File: js/ui/effects.js
````javascript
 1: export function floatText(text, color = '#f0c060', anchorEl = null) {
 2:   const el = document.createElement('div');
 3:   el.className = 'float-text';
 4:   el.textContent = text;
 5:   el.style.color = color;
 6:   if (anchorEl) {
 7:     const rect = anchorEl.getBoundingClientRect();
 8:     el.style.left = (rect.left + rect.width / 2) + 'px';
 9:     el.style.top = rect.top + 'px';
10:   } else {
11:     const goldEl = document.getElementById('header-gold');
12:     if (goldEl) {
13:       const rect = goldEl.getBoundingClientRect();
14:       el.style.left = (rect.left + rect.width / 2) + 'px';
15:       el.style.top = (rect.bottom + 4) + 'px';
16:     } else {
17:       el.style.left = '50%';
18:       el.style.top = '60px';
19:     }
20:   }
21:   document.body.appendChild(el);
22:   setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 1200);
23: }
24: export function particleBurst(x, y, opts = {}) {
25:   const count = opts.count || 12;
26:   const colors = opts.colors || ['#f0c060', '#4ecdc4', '#e74c3c', '#9b59b6', '#2ecc71'];
27:   const spread = opts.spread || 80;
28:   const duration = opts.duration || 800;
29:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
30:     const particle = document.createElement('div');
31:     particle.className = 'fx-particle';
32:     const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
33:     const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
34:     const dist = spread * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
35:     const dx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
36:     const dy = Math.sin(angle) * dist - 20;
37:     const size = 3 + Math.random() * 4;
38:     particle.style.cssText = `
39:       left: ${x}px; top: ${y}px;
40:       width: ${size}px; height: ${size}px;
41:       background: ${color};
42:       --dx: ${dx}px; --dy: ${dy}px;
43:       animation-duration: ${duration + Math.random() * 300}ms;
44:     `;
45:     document.body.appendChild(particle);
46:     setTimeout(() => particle.remove(), duration + 400);
47:   }
48: }
````

````javascript
300: function renderTalentNode(t, purchased, tp, legacyLevel) {
301:   const owned = purchased.has(t.id);
302:   const canBuy = !owned && tp.available >= t.cost && legacyLevel >= t.reqLevel;
303:   const locked = !owned && legacyLevel < t.reqLevel;
304:   const tierLabel = t.tier === 1 ? 'I' : t.tier === 2 ? 'II' : t.tier === 3 ? 'III' : 'IV';
305:   let stateClass = 'talent-locked';
306:   if (owned) stateClass = 'talent-owned';
307:   else if (canBuy) stateClass = 'talent-available';
308:   const costDots = Array(t.cost).fill('<span class="tp-dot"></span>').join('');
309:   return `
310:     <div class="talent-node ${stateClass}" ${canBuy ? `onclick="window._purchaseTalent('${t.id}')"` : ''} title="${t.desc}">
311:       <div class="talent-icon">${t.icon}</div>
312:       <div class="talent-info">
313:         <div class="talent-name">${t.label} <span class="talent-tier">T${tierLabel}</span></div>
314:         <div class="talent-desc">${t.desc}</div>
315:       </div>
316:       <div class="talent-cost">${costDots}${locked ? `<span class="talent-req">Lv.${t.reqLevel}</span>` : ''}</div>
317:     </div>
318:   `;
319: }
320: // Wire up global handlers for talent interactions
321: if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
322:   window._purchaseTalent = (id) => {
323:     const result = Game.purchaseTalent(id);
324:     if (result.ok) {
325:       _rendered = false;
326:       renderHall();
327:     }
328:   };
329:   window._resetTalents = () => {
330:     if (confirm('Reset all talent points? This is free.')) {
331:       Game.resetTalents();
332:       _rendered = false;
333:       renderHall();
334:     }
335:   };
336: }
````

````javascript
 1: import { rankCss } from '../util.js';
 2: export function rankTag(rank) {
 3:   return `<span class="quest-rank-tag rank-${rankCss(rank)}" style="color:var(--rank-${rankCss(rank)});border-color:var(--rank-${rankCss(rank)})">${rank}</span>`;
 4: }
 5: export function hpClass(hp, maxHp) {
 6:   const pct = hp / maxHp;
 7:   return pct > 0.6 ? 'hp-high' : pct > 0.3 ? 'hp-med' : 'hp-low';
 8: }
 9: export function fmtTime(seconds) {
10:   if (seconds <= 0) return 'Done!';
11:   const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
12:   const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
13:   const s = seconds % 60;
14:   if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
15:   if (m > 0) return `${m}m ${s}s`;
16:   return `${s}s`;
17: }
18: export function timeAgo(ts) {
19:   const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000);
20:   if (s < 60) return `${s}s ago`;
21:   if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s/60)}m ago`;
22:   return `${Math.floor(s/3600)}h ago`;
23: }
24: let toastTimeout;
25: export function showToast(msg, type = 'info') {
26:   let toast = document.getElementById('toast');
27:   if (!toast) {
28:     toast = document.createElement('div');
29:     toast.id = 'toast';
30:     toast.style.cssText = `
31:       position:fixed; bottom:24px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
32:       padding:10px 20px; border-radius:6px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500;
33:       z-index:999; transition:opacity 0.3s; pointer-events:none;
34:       border:1px solid; max-width:400px; text-align:center;
35:     `;
36:     document.body.appendChild(toast);
37:   }
38:   toast.textContent = msg;
39:   if (type === 'success') { toast.style.background='var(--green-dim)'; toast.style.borderColor='var(--green)'; toast.style.color='var(--green)'; }
40:   else if (type === 'error') { toast.style.background='var(--red-dim)'; toast.style.borderColor='var(--red)'; toast.style.color='var(--red)'; }
41:   else { toast.style.background='var(--cyan-dim)'; toast.style.borderColor='var(--cyan)'; toast.style.color='var(--cyan)'; }
42:   toast.style.opacity = '1';
43:   clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
44:   toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => { toast.style.opacity = '0'; }, 2500);
45: }

61: export function animateCountUp(element, startVal, endVal, duration = 800) {
62:   if (!element) return;
63:   const startTime = Date.now();
64:   const interval = setInterval(() => {
65:     const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
66:     const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / duration);
67:     const current = Math.floor(startVal + (endVal - startVal) * progress);
68:     element.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
69:     if (progress >= 1) clearInterval(interval);
70:   }, 30);
71: }
````

````javascript
  5:   getClassMasteries, getUnlockedClassMasteries, getNextClassMastery,
  6:   getAllClassUnlocks, getNextUnlock, getEquipmentSkill,
  7:   HERO_SPECS, getSpecSkills, getUnlockedSpecSkills, HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS
  8: } from '../skills.js';
  9: import { hpClass, fmtTime, showToast } from './helpers.js';
 10: import { esc } from '../util.js';
 11: let partyView = 'roster';
 12: let selectedMemberId = null;
 13: let pickingSlot = null;
 14: let respecPickerOpen = false;
 15: export function resetPartyState() {
 16:   partyView = 'roster';
 17:   selectedMemberId = null;
 18:   pickingSlot = null;
 19:   respecPickerOpen = false;
 20: }
 21: export function tickUpdateParty() {
 22:   const s = Game.state;
 23:   const el = document.getElementById('tab-party');
 24:   if (!el) return;
 25:   const tickAuras = Game.getPartyAuras();
 26:   el.querySelectorAll('.slot-card.filled').forEach(card => {
 27:     const mid = card.dataset.memberId;
 28:     const m = mid === 'player' ? s.player : s.party.find(p => p.id === mid);
 29:     if (!m) return;
 30:     const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, tickAuras);
 31:     const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
 32:     const fill = card.querySelector('.progress-fill');
 33:     if (fill) {
 34:       fill.style.width = hpPct + '%';
 35:       fill.className = 'progress-fill ' + hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp);
 36:     }
 37:     const hpSpan = card.querySelector('span[style*="font-size:0.72rem"]');
 38:     if (hpSpan) hpSpan.textContent = `${eff.hp}/${eff.maxHp} HP`;
 39:   });
 40:   el.querySelectorAll('.roster-row').forEach(row => {
 41:     const mid = row.dataset.memberId;
 42:     const m = mid === 'player' ? s.player : s.party.find(p => p.id === mid);
 43:     if (!m) return;
 44:     const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, tickAuras);
 45:     const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
 46:     const fill = row.querySelector('.roster-hp .progress-fill');
 47:     if (fill) {
 48:       fill.style.width = hpPct + '%';
 49:       fill.className = 'progress-fill ' + hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp);
 50:     }
 51:   });
 52:   const charHpFill = el.querySelector('.char-bar-row .progress-fill');
 53:   if (charHpFill && selectedMemberId) {
 54:     const m = selectedMemberId === 'player' ? s.player : s.party.find(p => p.id === selectedMemberId);
 55:     if (m) {
 56:       const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, tickAuras);
 57:       const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
 58:       charHpFill.style.width = hpPct + '%';
 59:       charHpFill.className = 'progress-fill ' + hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp);
 60:       const valSpan = charHpFill.closest('.char-bar-row')?.querySelector('.char-bar-value');
 61:       if (valSpan) valSpan.textContent = `${eff.hp} / ${eff.maxHp}`;
 62:     }
 63:   }
 64: }
 65: export function renderParty() {
 66:   const s = Game.state;
 67:   const el = document.getElementById('tab-party');
 68:   if (partyView === 'recruit') { renderRecruit(el, s); return; }
 69:   if (partyView === 'sheet' && selectedMemberId) { renderCharSheet(el, s); return; }
 70:   const maxParty = Game.getMaxPartySize();
 71:   const auras = Game.getPartyAuras();
 72:   const slotCards = Array.from({ length: maxParty }, (_, i) => i).map(i => {
 73:     const id = s.activeSlots[i];
 74:     const m = id ? s.party.find(p => p.id === id) : null;
 75:     if (m) {
 76:       const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, auras);
 77:       const cls = getClass(m.class);
 78:       const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
 79:       return `
 80:         <div class="slot-card filled" data-member-id="${m.id}">
 81:           <span class="slot-name">${esc(m.name)}</span>
 82:           <span class="slot-cls">${cls.label} · Lv.${m.level}</span>
 83:           <div class="slot-hp progress-bar">
 84:             <div class="progress-fill ${hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp)}" style="width:${hpPct}%"></div>
 85:           </div>
 86:           <span style="font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim)">${eff.hp}/${eff.maxHp} HP</span>
 87:         </div>`;
 88:     }
 89:     return `<div class="slot-card" data-slot="${i}"><span class="slot-empty-text">Empty slot</span></div>`;
 90:   }).join('');
 91:   const allMembers = [
 92:     { id: 'player', data: s.player, type: 'player' },
 93:     ...s.party.map(m => ({ id: m.id, data: m, type: 'member' }))
 94:   ];
 95:   const rosterRows = allMembers.map(({ id, data: m, type }) => {
 96:     const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, auras);
 97:     const cls = getClass(m.class);
 98:     const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
 99:     const isActive = s.activeSlots.includes(m.id);
100:     const statusClass = isActive ? 'status-active' : (eff.hp < eff.maxHp * 0.5 ? 'status-injured' : 'status-reserve');
101:     const statusLabel = type === 'player' ? 'Leader' : (isActive ? 'Active' : 'Reserve');
102:     let specBadge = '';
103:     if (m.class === 'HERO') {
104:       if (m.heroSpec && HERO_SPECS[m.heroSpec]) {
105:         const spec = HERO_SPECS[m.heroSpec];
106:         specBadge = `<span class="hero-spec-badge">${spec.icon} ${spec.label}</span>`;
107:       } else if (m.level >= 10) {
108:         specBadge = `<span class="hero-spec-badge hero-spec-warn">⚠ No Spec</span>`;
109:       }
110:     }
111:     return `
112:       <div class="roster-row${isActive ? ' in-active' : ''}" data-member-id="${m.id}">
113:         <div class="roster-info">
114:           <div class="roster-name">${esc(m.name)} <span class="member-sigil">${cls.sigil}</span>${specBadge}</div>
115:           <div class="roster-sub">Lv.${m.level}${m.level >= Game.PLAYER_LEVEL_CAP ? ' <span class="lvl-max-tag">MAX</span>' : ''} ${cls.label} · Power: ${Math.round(Game.memberPower(m))}</div>
116:         </div>
117:         <div class="roster-hp progress-bar">
118:           <div class="progress-fill ${hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp)}" style="width:${hpPct}%"></div>
119:         </div>
120:         <span class="roster-status ${statusClass}">${statusLabel}</span>
121:       </div>
122:     `;
123:   }).join('');
124:   // Guild hall expansion panel
125:   // Party is Hero + active slots: base 4 slots (5 total), expandable to 5 slots (6 total)
126:   const expansionCost = Game.getPartyExpansionCost();
127:   const expansionMaxed = expansionCost === null;
128:   const canAffordExpansion = !expansionMaxed && s.gold >= expansionCost;
129:   const totalPartyMax = maxParty + 1; // +1 for the Hero who is always present
130:   const totalPartyCap = 6; // Hero + 5 active slots (max after expansion)
131:   const expansionPanel = !expansionMaxed ? `
132:     <div class="party-expand-panel">
133:       <div class="party-expand-header">
134:         <span class="party-expand-title">Party Capacity ${totalPartyMax}/${totalPartyCap}</span>
135:         <button class="btn btn-sm${canAffordExpansion ? ' btn-expand' : ''}" id="btn-expand-party" ${canAffordExpansion ? '' : 'disabled'}>
136:           Expand — ${expansionCost.toLocaleString()}g
137:         </button>
138:       </div>
139:     </div>
140:   ` : `
141:     <div class="party-expand-panel">
142:       <div class="party-expand-header">
143:         <span class="party-expand-title">Party Capacity ${totalPartyCap}/${totalPartyCap}</span>
144:         <span class="party-expand-maxed">MAX</span>
145:       </div>
146:     </div>
147:   `;
148:   el.innerHTML = `
149:     <div class="card">
150:       <div class="section-header">
151:         <div class="card-title" style="margin:0">Active Party <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--text-muted)">(${s.activeSlots.length}/${maxParty})</span></div>
152:       </div>
153:       <div class="active-slots">${slotCards}</div>
154:       ${expansionPanel}
155:     </div>
156:     <div class="card">
157:       <div class="section-header">
158:         <div class="card-title" style="margin:0">Roster <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--text-muted)">(${s.party.length}/8)</span></div>
159:         <button class="btn btn-sm btn-success" id="btn-recruit">+ Recruit</button>
160:       </div>
161:       <div class="roster-grid">${rosterRows}</div>
162:     </div>
163:   `;
164:   // Clicking a roster row or slot card opens the character sheet
165:   el.querySelectorAll('.roster-row[data-member-id]').forEach(row => {
166:     row.addEventListener('click', () => {
167:       selectedMemberId = row.dataset.memberId;
168:       partyView = 'sheet';
169:       pickingSlot = null;
170:       renderParty();
171:     });
172:   });
173:   el.querySelectorAll('.slot-card.filled[data-member-id]').forEach(card => {
174:     card.addEventListener('click', () => {
175:       selectedMemberId = card.dataset.memberId;
176:       partyView = 'sheet';
177:       pickingSlot = null;
178:       renderParty();
179:     });
180:   });
181:   el.querySelector('#btn-recruit')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
182:     partyView = 'recruit';
183:     renderParty();
184:   });
185:   // Guild hall expansion
186:   const expandBtn = el.querySelector('#btn-expand-party');
187:   if (expandBtn) {
188:     expandBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
189:       const result = Game.expandParty();
190:       if (result.ok) {
191:         showToast(`Guild hall expanded! Party size now ${result.newMax}.`, 'success');
192:         Game.save();
193:       } else {
194:         showToast(result.reason, 'error');
195:       }
196:       renderParty();
197:       document.getElementById('header-gold').textContent = Game.state.gold.toLocaleString();
198:     });
199:   }
200: }

202: // CHARACTER SHEET
203: // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
204: function renderCharSheet(el, s) {
205:   const m = selectedMemberId === 'player' ? s.player : s.party.find(p => p.id === selectedMemberId);
206:   if (!m) { partyView = 'roster'; renderParty(); return; }
207:   const cls = getClass(m.class);
208:   const baseStats = m.stats;
209:   const charAuras = Game.getPartyAuras();
210:   const eff = Game.effectiveStats(m, charAuras);
211:   const isPlayer = selectedMemberId === 'player';
212:   const isActive = s.activeSlots.includes(m.id);
213:   const hpPct = Math.round((eff.hp / eff.maxHp) * 100);
214:   const atLevelCap = m.level >= Game.PLAYER_LEVEL_CAP;
215:   const expNeeded = Math.floor(100 * Math.pow(m.level, 1.5));
216:   const expPct = atLevelCap ? 100 : Math.round((m.exp / Math.max(1, expNeeded)) * 100);
217:   const power = Math.round(Game.memberPower(m));
218:   // Equipment section
219:   const equipHtml = renderEquipmentPanel(m, s);
220:   // Stats section
221:   const statsHtml = renderStatsPanel(baseStats, eff);
222:   // Skills section
223:   const skillsHtml = renderSkillsPanel(m);
224:   // Action buttons
225:   const toggleLabel = isActive ? 'Remove from Party' : 'Add to Party';
226:   const toggleClass = isActive ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-success';
227:   el.innerHTML = `
228:     <div class="char-sheet">
229:       <div class="char-sheet-topbar">
230:         <button class="btn btn-sm btn-roster" id="btn-back-roster">← Roster</button>
231:         <div class="char-sheet-actions">
232:           ${!isPlayer ? `<button class="btn btn-sm ${toggleClass}" id="btn-toggle-active">${toggleLabel}</button>` : ''}
233:           ${!isPlayer ? `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" id="btn-dismiss-member">Dismiss</button>` : ''}
234:         </div>
235:       </div>
236:       <div class="char-header">
237:         <div class="char-portrait">
238:           <span class="char-portrait-sigil">${cls.sigil}</span>
239:         </div>
240:         <div class="char-header-info">
241:           <div class="char-name">${esc(m.name)}</div>
242:           <div class="char-class">${cls.label} · Level ${m.level}${atLevelCap ? ' <span class="lvl-max-tag">MAX</span>' : ''}</div>
243:           <div class="char-power">Power: <strong>${power}</strong></div>
244:           <div class="char-bars">
245:             <div class="char-bar-row">
246:               <span class="char-bar-label">HP</span>
247:               <div class="progress-bar" style="flex:1"><div class="progress-fill ${hpClass(eff.hp, eff.maxHp)}" style="width:${hpPct}%"></div></div>
248:               <span class="char-bar-value">${eff.hp} / ${eff.maxHp}</span>
249:             </div>
250:             <div class="char-bar-row">
251:               <span class="char-bar-label">EXP</span>
252:               <div class="progress-bar" style="flex:1"><div class="progress-fill exp-bar" style="width:${expPct}%"></div></div>
253:               <span class="char-bar-value">${atLevelCap ? 'MAX' : `${m.exp} / ${expNeeded}`}</span>
254:             </div>
255:           </div>
256:         </div>
257:       </div>
258:       <div class="char-body">
259:         <div class="char-col-left">
260:           <div class="char-section">
261:             <div class="char-section-title">Equipment</div>
262:             ${equipHtml}
263:           </div>
264:           <div class="char-section">
265:             <div class="char-section-title">Stats</div>
266:             ${statsHtml}
267:           </div>
268:         </div>
269:         <div class="char-col-right">
270:           <div class="char-section">
271:             <div class="char-section-title">Skills & Abilities</div>
272:             ${skillsHtml}
273:           </div>
274:         </div>
275:       </div>
276:     </div>
277:   `;
278:   bindCharSheetEvents(el, s, m);
279: }
280: // ── Equipment Panel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
281: function renderEquipmentPanel(m, s) {
282:   const isRogue = m.class === 'ROGUE';
283:   const isMonk = m.class === 'MONK';
284:   const isRanger = m.class === 'RANGER';
285:   const canDualWieldClass = isRogue || isMonk || isRanger;
286:   // Check if weapon is 2h — if so, offhand is locked
287:   const wpnItem = m.equipment && m.equipment.weapon ? getItem(m.equipment.weapon) : null;
288:   const hasTwoHanded = wpnItem && wpnItem.twoHanded;
289:   const slots = ['weapon', 'armor', 'accessory', 'offhand'];
290:   const slotIcons = { weapon: '⚔', armor: '🛡', accessory: '💍', offhand: '🔮' };
291:   const offhandLabel = isRogue ? 'off hand 🗡' : isMonk ? 'off hand 🐾' : isRanger ? 'off hand ⚔' : 'offhand';
292:   const slotLabels = {
293:     weapon: 'weapon',
294:     armor: 'armor',
295:     accessory: 'accessory',
296:     offhand: hasTwoHanded ? 'offhand 🔒' : offhandLabel,
297:   };
298:   const slotRows = slots.map(slot => {
299:     const itemId = m.equipment ? m.equipment[slot] : null;
300:     const item = itemId ? getItem(itemId) : null;
301:     const isOpen = pickingSlot === slot;
302:     const bonusStr = item ? formatBonuses(item.statBonus) : '';
303:     const grantedSkillIds = item ? [].concat(item.grantedSkill || [], item.grantedSkills || []) : [];
304:     const grantedSkillObjs = grantedSkillIds.map(id => getSkill(id)).filter(Boolean);
305:     const rarity = item ? getItemRarity(item) : null;
306:     const rarityClass = rarity ? ` equip-rarity-${rarity.id}` : '';
307:     let slotHtml = `
308:       <div class="equip-slot-card${isOpen ? ' open' : ''}${item ? ' has-item' : ''}${rarityClass}" data-slot="${slot}">
309:         <div class="equip-slot-header" data-slot-click="${slot}">
310:           <span class="equip-slot-icon">${slotIcons[slot]}</span>
311:           <div class="equip-slot-info">
312:             <span class="equip-slot-type">${slotLabels[slot]}</span>
313:             ${item
314:               ? `<span class="equip-slot-item-name" style="color:${rarity.color}">${item.name} <span class="item-rarity-badge" style="color:${rarity.color};border-color:${rarity.color}30">${rarity.label}</span></span>`
315:               : `<span class="equip-slot-empty">Empty — click to equip</span>`}
316:           </div>
317:           ${item ? `<div class="equip-slot-bonus">${bonusStr}</div>` : ''}
318:           ${item ? `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost equip-unequip-btn" data-unequip="${slot}" title="Unequip">✕</button>` : ''}
319:         </div>
320:         ${item ? `<div class="equip-slot-class-req">${item.classReq ? item.classReq.map(cid => CLASSES[cid]?.label || cid).join(', ') : 'Any class'}</div>` : ''}
321:         ${grantedSkillObjs.length ? grantedSkillObjs.map(gs => `<div class="equip-skill-grant">${gs.icon} Grants: ${gs.name}</div>`).join('') : ''}
322:     `;
323:     if (isOpen) {
324:       if (slot === 'offhand' && hasTwoHanded) {
325:         slotHtml += `<div class="equip-picker"><div class="equip-picker-empty">Offhand locked — two-handed weapon equipped</div></div>`;
326:         slotHtml += `</div>`;
327:         return slotHtml;
328:       }
329:       const slotItems = s.inventory.filter(e => {
330:         const it = getItem(e.itemId);
331:         if (!it || e.quantity <= 0) return false;
332:         if (it.slot === slot) return true;
333:         if (slot === 'offhand' && it.slot === 'weapon' && !it.twoHanded) {
334:           if (isRogue && it.dagger) return true;
335:           if (isMonk && it.claw) return true;
336:           if (isRanger && !it.dagger && !it.claw && !it.bow && it.classReq && it.classReq.includes('RANGER') && !it.twoHanded) return true;
337:         }
338:         return false;
339:       });
340:       if (slotItems.length === 0) {
341:         slotHtml += `<div class="equip-picker"><div class="equip-picker-empty">No ${slotLabels[slot]} items in inventory</div></div>`;
342:       } else {
343:         const items = slotItems.map(e => {
344:           const it = getItem(e.itemId);
345:           const bStr = formatBonuses(it.statBonus);
346:           const gsIds = [].concat(it.grantedSkill || [], it.grantedSkills || []);
347:           const gsArr = gsIds.map(id => getSkill(id)).filter(Boolean);
348:           const qtyTag = e.quantity > 1 ? ` <span class="equip-picker-qty">x${e.quantity}</span>` : '';
349:           const iRarity = getItemRarity(it);
350:           const classOk = canClassEquip(m.class, it);
351:           const classReqStr = it.classReq
352:             ? it.classReq.map(cid => CLASSES[cid]?.label || cid).join(', ')
353:             : null;
354:           // Dual-wield tag for offhand weapons
355:           const isDualWield = slot === 'offhand' && it.slot === 'weapon';
356:           const dwLabel = it.dagger ? '🗡 Dual Wield (off hand)' : it.claw ? '🐾 Dual Wield (off hand)' : '⚔ Dual Wield (off hand)';
357:           const is2h = it.twoHanded;
358:           return `
359:             <div class="equip-picker-item${classOk ? '' : ' class-locked'} rarity-${iRarity.id}" ${classOk ? `data-equip-item="${it.id}" data-equip-slot="${slot}"` : ''}>
360:               <div class="equip-picker-item-main">
361:                 <span class="equip-picker-item-name" style="color:${iRarity.color}">${it.name}${qtyTag} <span class="item-rarity-badge" style="color:${iRarity.color};border-color:${iRarity.color}30">${iRarity.label}</span></span>
362:                 <span class="equip-picker-item-bonus">${bStr}</span>
363:               </div>
364:               ${isDualWield ? `<div class="equip-picker-dual-wield">${dwLabel}</div>` : ''}
365:               ${is2h ? `<div class="equip-picker-two-handed">🔒 Two-Handed (blocks offhand)</div>` : ''}
366:               ${!classOk ? `<div class="equip-picker-class-warn">Requires: ${classReqStr}</div>` : ''}
367:               ${gsArr.length ? gsArr.map(gs => `<div class="equip-picker-item-skill">${gs.icon} ${gs.name}</div>`).join('') : ''}
368:               ${it.desc ? `<div class="equip-picker-item-desc">${it.desc}</div>` : ''}
369:             </div>`;
370:         }).join('');
371:         slotHtml += `<div class="equip-picker">${items}</div>`;
372:       }
373:     }
374:     slotHtml += `</div>`;
375:     return slotHtml;
376:   }).join('');
377:   return `<div class="equip-panel">${slotRows}</div>`;
378: }
379: // ── Stats Panel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
380: function renderStatsPanel(base, eff) {
381:   const statDefs = [
382:     { key: 'maxHp', label: 'MAX HP' },
383:     { key: 'atk',   label: 'ATK' },
384:     { key: 'def',   label: 'DEF' },
385:     { key: 'spd',   label: 'SPD' },
386:     { key: 'mag',   label: 'MAG' },
387:     { key: 'crit',  label: 'CRT' },
388:     { key: 'dodge', label: 'DDG' },
389:   ];
390:   const rows = statDefs.map(({ key, label }) => {
391:     const baseVal = base[key] || 0;
392:     const effVal = eff[key] || 0;
393:     const diff = effVal - baseVal;
394:     const diffStr = diff > 0 ? `<span class="stat-bonus">+${diff}</span>` : (diff < 0 ? `<span class="stat-penalty">${diff}</span>` : '');
395:     return `
396:       <div class="stat-row">
397:         <span class="stat-row-label">${label}</span>
398:         <span class="stat-row-base">${baseVal}</span>
399:         <span class="stat-row-arrow">→</span>
400:         <span class="stat-row-final">${effVal}</span>
401:         ${diffStr}
402:       </div>`;
403:   }).join('');
404:   // Show special percentage bonuses from items/passives (dodge chance, crit chance, heal bonus)
405:   const specials = [];
406:   if (eff.dodgeChance > 0) specials.push(`<div class="stat-row"><span class="stat-row-label">DDG%</span><span class="stat-row-final"><span class="stat-bonus">+${Math.round(eff.dodgeChance * 100)}%</span></span></div>`);
407:   if (eff.critChance > 0) specials.push(`<div class="stat-row"><span class="stat-row-label">CRT%</span><span class="stat-row-final"><span class="stat-bonus">+${Math.round(eff.critChance * 100)}%</span></span></div>`);
408:   if (eff.healBonus > 0) specials.push(`<div class="stat-row"><span class="stat-row-label">HEAL</span><span class="stat-row-final"><span class="stat-bonus">+${Math.round(eff.healBonus * 100)}%</span></span></div>`);
409:   return `<div class="stats-panel">${rows}${specials.join('')}</div>`;
410: }
411: // ── Skills Panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
412: function renderSkillsPanel(m) {
413:   // Hero spec replacement: when a Hero picks a spec, the baseline L10/L14/L18
414:   // skills are stripped from the class list in favor of spec skills. Apply the
415:   // same filter the sim uses so the UI reflects what actually fires in combat.
416:   const isSpeccedHero = m.class === 'HERO' && m.heroSpec;
417:   const allClassSkills = getClassSkills(m.class)
418:     .filter(s => !(isSpeccedHero && HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS.includes(s.id)));
419:   const unlockedClass = getUnlockedClassSkills(m.class, m.level)
420:     .filter(s => !(isSpeccedHero && HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS.includes(s.id)));
421:   const unlockedIds = new Set(unlockedClass.map(s => s.id));
422:   const eqSkills = [];
423:   for (const slot of Object.values(m.equipment || {})) {
424:     if (!slot) continue;

429:       if (sk) eqSkills.push({ skill: sk, source: item.name });

433:   const unlockedMasteryIds = new Set(getUnlockedClassMasteries(m.class, m.level).map(s => s.id));
434:   let html = '';
435:   // Class skills
436:   html += `<div class="skills-category-label">Class Skills</div>`;
437:   if (isSpeccedHero) {
438:     const specLabel = HERO_SPECS[m.heroSpec]?.label || m.heroSpec;
439:     html += `<div class="skill-empty-note" style="opacity:0.7;font-size:0.72rem;margin-bottom:6px">Lv.10, Lv.14 &amp; Lv.18 baseline skills replaced by ${specLabel} spec — see Specialization below.</div>`;
440:   }
441:   if (allClassSkills.length === 0) {
442:     html += `<div class="skill-empty-note">No class skills available.</div>`;
443:   }
444:   for (const sk of allClassSkills) {
445:     const unlocked = unlockedIds.has(sk.id);
446:     html += renderSkillRow(sk, unlocked, unlocked ? null : `Unlocks at Lv.${sk.unlockLevel}`);
447:   }
448:   // Hero Specialization section
449:   if (m.class === 'HERO') {
450:     html += renderSpecSection(m);
451:   }
452:   html += `<div class="skills-category-label" style="margin-top:12px">Masteries</div>`;
453:   if (allMasteries.length === 0) {
454:     html += `<div class="skill-empty-note">No masteries available.</div>`;
455:   }
456:   for (const sk of allMasteries) {
457:     const unlocked = unlockedMasteryIds.has(sk.id);
458:     html += renderSkillRow(sk, unlocked, unlocked ? null : `Unlocks at Lv.${sk.unlockLevel}`);
459:   }
460:   if (eqSkills.length > 0) {
461:     html += `<div class="skills-category-label" style="margin-top:12px">Equipment Skills</div>`;
462:     for (const { skill, source } of eqSkills) {
463:       html += renderSkillRow(skill, true, null, source);
464:     }
465:   }
466:   return `<div class="skills-panel">${html}</div>`;
467: }

552: function renderSkillRow(skill, unlocked, lockMsg, itemSource) {
553:   const icon = skill.icon || '•';

565:         </div>
566:       </div>`;
567:   }

569:     <div class="skill-row">
570:       <span class="skill-row-icon">${icon}</span>
571:       <div class="skill-row-info">
572:         <div class="skill-row-top">

578:         ${effectStr ? `<div class="skill-row-effects">${effectStr}</div>` : ''}
579:       </div>
580:     </div>`;
581: }

675: function renderRecruit(el, s) {

690:             HP ${cls.baseStats.maxHp} · ATK ${cls.baseStats.atk} · DEF ${cls.baseStats.def} · SPD ${cls.baseStats.spd} · MAG ${cls.baseStats.mag}
691:           </div>
692:         </div>
693:         <span class="recruit-cost${!canAfford ? ' too-pricey' : ''}">${cost}g</span>
694:       </div>
695:     `;

701:         <button class="btn btn-sm btn-roster" id="btn-back-roster">← Back</button>
702:       </div>
703:       <div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:12px">Gold: <strong style="color:var(--gold)">${s.gold}g</strong> · Roster: ${s.party.length}/8 · Next recruit: <strong style="color:var(--gold)">${cost}g</strong></div>
704:       <div class="recruit-list">${rows || '<div class="empty-state">No classes available.</div>'}</div>
705:     </div>
706:   `;

726: function formatBonuses(statBonus) {
727:   if (!statBonus) return '';
728:   return Object.entries(statBonus).map(([k, v]) => {
729:     const cls = v < 0 ? 'stat-penalty' : 'stat-bonus';
730:     return `<span class="${cls}">${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v} ${k.toUpperCase()}</span>`;
731:   }).join('  ');
732: }
733: function formatSkillEffects(skill) {
734:   if (!skill.effects) return '';
735:   const parts = [];
736:   for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(skill.effects)) {
737:     if (key === 'atkBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% ATK`);
738:     else if (key === 'defBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% DEF`);
739:     else if (key === 'spdBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% SPD`);
740:     else if (key === 'magBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% MAG`);
741:     else if (key === 'lckBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% LCK`);
742:     else if (key === 'hpBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% HP`);
743:     else if (key === 'healRate') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% heal rate`);
744:     else if (key === 'partyAtkBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% party ATK`);
745:     else if (key === 'partyDefBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% party DEF`);
746:     else if (key === 'partySpdBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% party SPD`);
747:     else if (key === 'partyCritBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% party CRIT`);
748:     else if (key === 'partyHealBonus' || key === 'partyHealPct') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% party heal`);
749:     else if (key === 'maxHpBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% max HP`);
750:     else if (key === 'healBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% heal`);
751:     else if (key === 'critBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% CRIT`);
752:     else if (key === 'dodgeBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% DODGE`);
753:     else if (key === 'goldBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% gold`);
754:     else if (key === 'expBonus') parts.push(`+${Math.round(val * 100)}% EXP`);
755:     else if (key === 'critChance') parts.push(`${Math.round(val * 100)}% crit chance`);
756:     else if (key === 'dodgeChance') parts.push(`${Math.round(val * 100)}% dodge chance`);
757:     else if (key === 'powerMultiplier') parts.push(`${val}x power`);
758:     else if (key === 'dmgReduction') parts.push(`${Math.round(val * 100)}% DR`);
759:     else if (key === 'executeThreshold') parts.push(`execute <${Math.round(val * 100)}% HP`);
760:     else if (key === 'executeMult') parts.push(`${val}x execute dmg`);
761:     else if (key === 'healThreshold') parts.push(`heal at <${Math.round(val * 100)}% HP`);
762:     else if (key === 'healPercent') parts.push(`${Math.round(val * 100)}% HP heal`);
763:     else if (key === 'reviveAllPercent') parts.push(`revive at ${Math.round(val * 100)}% HP`);
764:   }
765:   if (skill.procChance && skill.procChance < 1 && skill.type === 'active') {
766:     parts.push(`${Math.round(skill.procChance * 100)}% proc`);
767:   }
768:   return parts.join(' · ');
769: }
````
