````javascript
 92:         const el = document.querySelector(`.aq-party-member[data-member-id="${p.id}"]`);
 93:         if (!el) return;
 94:         const dead = p.hp <= 0;
 95:         const hpPct = dead ? 0 : Math.round((p.hp / Math.max(1, p.maxHp)) * 100);
 96:         const hpColor = dead ? 'var(--text-muted)' : hpPct > 60 ? 'var(--green)' : hpPct > 30 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--red)';
 97:         const fill = el.querySelector('.aq-hp-fill');
 98:         if (fill) { fill.style.width = hpPct + '%'; fill.style.background = hpColor; }
 99:         const text = el.querySelector('.aq-hp-text');
100:         if (text) text.textContent = dead ? '💀 KO' : `${p.hp}/${p.maxHp}`;
101:         el.classList.toggle('aq-member-dead', dead);
102:         const sigil = el.querySelector('.aq-party-sigil');
103:         if (sigil && dead && sigil.textContent !== '💀') sigil.textContent = '💀';
104:         const buffs = p.buffs || [];
105:         let buffRow = el.querySelector('.aq-buff-row');
106:         if (buffs.length > 0) {
107:           const buffHtml = buffs.map(b => {
108:             const cdClass = b.cooldown ? ' buff-cd' : '';
109:             return `<span class="aq-buff-pip${cdClass}" title="${b.label}: ${b.desc}">${b.icon}</span>`;
110:           }).join('');
111:           if (!buffRow) {
112:             buffRow = document.createElement('div');
113:             buffRow.className = 'aq-buff-row';
114:             el.appendChild(buffRow);
115:           }
116:           buffRow.innerHTML = buffHtml;
117:         } else if (buffRow) {
118:           buffRow.remove();
119:         }
120:       });
121:       const enemyStrip = document.querySelector('.aq-enemy-strip');
122:       if (enemyStrip) {
123:         snap.enemies.forEach(e => {
124:           let el = enemyStrip.querySelector(`[data-enemy-id="${e.id}"]`);
125:           if (!el) {
126:             el = document.createElement('div');
127:             el.className = 'aq-enemy-card reinforcement';
128:             el.dataset.enemyId = e.id;
129:             el.style.animation = 'slideUp 0.3s ease-out';
130:             el.innerHTML = `<div class="aq-enemy-icon">👹</div>
131:               <div class="aq-enemy-info">
132:                 <div class="aq-enemy-name">${e.name} <span class="aq-reinforce-tag">NEW</span></div>
133:                 <div class="aq-hp-bar enemy"><div class="aq-hp-fill" style="width:100%;background:var(--red)"></div></div>
134:                 <div class="aq-hp-text">${e.hp}/${e.maxHp}</div>
135:               </div>`;
136:             enemyStrip.appendChild(el);
137:           }
138:           const dead = e.hp <= 0 || !e.alive;
139:           const hpPct = Math.round((e.hp / Math.max(1, e.maxHp)) * 100);
140:           const hpColor = dead ? 'var(--text-muted)' : hpPct > 50 ? 'var(--red)' : hpPct > 25 ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--gold)';
141:           el.classList.toggle('defeated', dead);
142:           el.classList.toggle('debuffed', (e.debuffs || []).length > 0);
143:           const icon = el.querySelector('.aq-enemy-icon');
144:           if (icon) icon.textContent = dead ? '💀' : '👹';
145:           const fill = el.querySelector('.aq-hp-fill');
146:           if (fill) { fill.style.width = (dead ? 0 : hpPct) + '%'; fill.style.background = hpColor; }
147:           const text = el.querySelector('.aq-hp-text');
148:           if (text) text.textContent = dead ? 'Defeated' : `${e.hp}/${e.maxHp}`;
149:           const debuffs = e.debuffs || [];
150:           const nameEl = el.querySelector('.aq-enemy-name');
151:           if (nameEl) {
152:             let debuffRow = nameEl.querySelector('.aq-debuff-row');
153:             if (debuffs.length > 0) {
154:               const debuffHtml = debuffs.map(d =>
155:                 `<span class="aq-debuff-pip" title="${d.label}: ${d.desc}">${d.icon}<span class="aq-debuff-rounds">${d.rounds || ''}</span></span>`
156:               ).join('');
157:               if (!debuffRow) {
158:                 debuffRow = document.createElement('span');
159:                 debuffRow.className = 'aq-debuff-row';
160:                 nameEl.appendChild(debuffRow);
161:               }
162:               debuffRow.innerHTML = debuffHtml;
163:             } else if (debuffRow) {
164:               debuffRow.remove();
165:             }
166:           }
167:         });
168:       }
169:     }
170:   }
171: }
172: export function tickUpdateQuests() {
173:   const s = Game.state;
174:   if (s.guild.activeQuest) {
175:     tickUpdateCombatVisuals();
176:     return;
177:   }
178:   const refreshEl = document.getElementById('qb-refresh-timer');
179:   if (refreshEl) {
180:     const timerSpan = refreshEl.querySelector('.qb-timer-text');
181:     if (timerSpan) {
182:       const refreshMs = Game.questBoardRefreshMs(questRankFilter);
183:       timerSpan.textContent = refreshMs <= 0
184:         ? 'New quests available! '
185:         : `New quests in: ${fmtTime(Math.ceil(refreshMs / 1000))} — `;
186:     }
187:   }

189: function renderActiveQuestView(s) {
190:   const aq = s.guild.activeQuest;
191:   const quest = aq.questData || Game.getGeneratedQuest(aq.questId) || getQuest(aq.questId);
192:   if (!quest) return '<div class="empty-state">Quest data not found.</div>';
193:   if (!aq.eventCount) {
194:     const simInfo = getSimInfo();
195:     if (simInfo) Game.setQuestEventCount(simInfo.eventCount, simInfo.intervalMs, simInfo.decisiveIndex, simInfo.fastForwardMs);
196:   }
197:   const progress = Game.questProgress();
198:   const phase = getQuestPhase(progress);
199:   const env = quest.environment || { name: 'Unknown', icon: '?', mood: 'dungeon' };
200:   const phases = getPhases();
201:   const phaseTracker = phases.map(p => {
202:     const isActive = p.id === phase.id;
203:     const isPast = phases.indexOf(p) < phases.indexOf(phase);
204:     return `<div class="aq-phase-step">
205:       <div class="aq-phase-dot${isActive ? ' active' : ''}${isPast ? ' done' : ''}" id="aq-phase-${p.id}"></div>
206:       <span class="aq-phase-name${isActive ? ' active' : ''}">${p.label}</span>
207:     </div>`;
208:   }).join('<div class="aq-phase-line"></div>');
209:   const snap = getCombatSnapshot();
210:   const partyStrip = aq.partySnapshot.map(m => {
211:     const cls = getClass(m.class);
212:     const pSnap = snap ? snap.party.find(p => p.id === m.id) : null;
213:     const hp = pSnap ? pSnap.hp : (m.stats.hp || m.stats.maxHp);
214:     const maxHp = pSnap ? pSnap.maxHp : m.stats.maxHp;
215:     const dead = hp <= 0;
216:     const hpPct = dead ? 0 : Math.round((hp / Math.max(1, maxHp)) * 100);
217:     const hpColor = dead ? 'var(--text-muted)' : hpPct > 60 ? 'var(--green)' : hpPct > 30 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--red)';
218:     const buffs = (pSnap && pSnap.buffs) ? pSnap.buffs : [];
219:     const buffIcons = buffs.map(b => {
220:       const cdClass = b.cooldown ? ' buff-cd' : '';
221:       return `<span class="aq-buff-pip${cdClass}" title="${b.label}: ${b.desc}">${b.icon}</span>`;
222:     }).join('');
223:     const buffRow = buffs.length > 0 ? `<div class="aq-buff-row">${buffIcons}</div>` : '';
224:     return `<div class="aq-party-member${dead ? ' aq-member-dead' : ''}" data-member-id="${m.id}">
225:       <div class="aq-party-header">
226:         <div class="aq-party-sigil">${dead ? '💀' : cls.sigil}</div>
227:         <div class="aq-party-info">
228:           <div class="aq-party-name">${esc(m.name.split(' ')[0])}</div>
229:           <div class="aq-party-level">${cls.label} Lv.${m.level}</div>
230:         </div>
231:       </div>
232:       <div class="aq-hp-bar"><div class="aq-hp-fill" style="width:${hpPct}%;background:${hpColor}"></div></div>
233:       <div class="aq-hp-text">${dead ? '💀 KO' : `${hp}/${maxHp}`}</div>
234:       ${buffRow}
235:     </div>`;
236:   }).join('');
237:   // Enemy cards with HP bars — includes reinforcements from snapshot
238:   let enemyList = (quest.enemies || ['Monster']).map((name, i) => ({
239:     id: `enemy_${i}`, name, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, alive: true, isReinforcement: false,
240:   }));
241:   if (snap) {
242:     enemyList = snap.enemies;
243:   }
244:   // Role-based styling for boss encounter enemies
245:   const ROLE_STYLE = {
246:     boss:     { icon: '👑', border: '#c41e3a', bg: 'rgba(196,30,58,0.12)', label: 'BOSS' },
247:     raidBoss: { icon: '💀', border: '#8b00ff', bg: 'rgba(139,0,255,0.15)', label: 'RAID' },
248:     general:  { icon: '⚔',  border: '#ff8c00', bg: 'rgba(255,140,0,0.10)', label: 'GEN' },
249:     lt:       { icon: '🗡',  border: '#daa520', bg: 'rgba(218,165,32,0.10)', label: 'LT' },
250:     captain:  { icon: '🛡',  border: '#4a90d9', bg: 'rgba(74,144,217,0.10)', label: 'CPT' },
251:     raidLt:   { icon: '🗡',  border: '#9b59b6', bg: 'rgba(155,89,182,0.12)', label: 'R-LT' },
252:     minion:   { icon: '👹', border: '', bg: '', label: '' },
253:     standard: { icon: '👹', border: '', bg: '', label: '' },
254:   };
255:   const enemyCards = enemyList.map(e => {
256:     const hpPct = Math.round((e.hp / Math.max(1, e.maxHp)) * 100);
257:     const hpColor = e.hp <= 0 ? 'var(--text-muted)' : hpPct > 50 ? 'var(--red)' : hpPct > 25 ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--gold)';
258:     const dead = e.hp <= 0 || !e.alive;
259:     const role = e.role || 'standard';
260:     const rs = ROLE_STYLE[role] || ROLE_STYLE.standard;
261:     const roleIcon = dead ? '💀' : rs.icon;
262:     const roleBorder = rs.border ? `border-left:3px solid ${rs.border};` : '';
263:     const roleBg = rs.bg ? `background:${rs.bg};` : '';
264:     const roleTag = rs.label ? `<span class="aq-role-tag" style="color:${rs.border};border-color:${rs.border};font-size:0.65em;padding:1px 4px;border:1px solid;border-radius:3px;margin-left:4px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;">${rs.label}</span>` : '';
265:     // Debuff indicators from snapshot
266:     const debuffs = (e.debuffs || []);
267:     const debuffIcons = debuffs.map(d =>
268:       `<span class="aq-debuff-pip" title="${d.label}: ${d.desc}">${d.icon}<span class="aq-debuff-rounds">${d.rounds || ''}</span></span>`
269:     ).join('');
270:     const debuffRow = debuffs.length > 0 ? `<div class="aq-debuff-row">${debuffIcons}</div>` : '';
271:     return `<div class="aq-enemy-card${dead ? ' defeated' : ''}${e.isReinforcement ? ' reinforcement' : ''}${debuffs.length > 0 ? ' debuffed' : ''}" data-enemy-id="${e.id}" style="${roleBorder}${roleBg}">
272:       <div class="aq-enemy-icon">${roleIcon}</div>
273:       <div class="aq-enemy-info">
274:         <div class="aq-enemy-name">${e.name}${roleTag}${e.isReinforcement ? ' <span class="aq-reinforce-tag">NEW</span>' : ''}${debuffRow}</div>
275:         <div class="aq-hp-bar enemy"><div class="aq-hp-fill" style="width:${dead ? 0 : hpPct}%;background:${hpColor}"></div></div>
276:         <div class="aq-hp-text">${dead ? 'Defeated' : `${e.hp}/${e.maxHp}`}</div>
277:       </div>
278:     </div>`;
279:   }).join('');
280:   const log = generateCombatLog();
281:   const logEntries = log.map(entry =>
282:     `<div class="combat-log-entry log-${entry.type}"><span class="log-icon">${entry.icon}</span><span class="log-text">${entry.text}</span></div>`
283:   ).join('');
284:   // Auto-run indicator
285:   let autoRunInfo = '';
286:   if (s.autoRun && s.autoRun.remaining > 0) {
287:     const stratIcons = { safe: '🛡', balanced: '⚖', push: '🔥' };
288:     const stratLabels = { safe: 'Play it Safe', balanced: 'Balanced', push: 'Push Limits' };
289:     const icon = stratIcons[s.autoRun.strategy] || '⚖';
290:     const label = stratLabels[s.autoRun.strategy] || 'Balanced';
291:     autoRunInfo = `<div class="aq-auto-run">${icon} Auto-Battle (${label}): ${s.autoRun.remaining} of ${s.autoRun.total} remaining</div>`;
292:   }
293:   return `
294:     <div class="aq-scene">
295:       <div class="aq-scene-header mood-${env.mood}">
296:         <div class="aq-scene-env">
297:           <span class="aq-scene-icon">${env.icon}</span>
298:           <span class="aq-scene-name">${env.name}</span>
299:         </div>
300:         <div class="aq-scene-quest">
301:           ${rankTag(quest.rank)}
302:           <span class="aq-scene-title">${quest.title}</span>
303:         </div>
304:         ${autoRunInfo}
305:       </div>
306:       <div class="aq-phase-tracker">${phaseTracker}</div>
307:       <div class="aq-main-content">
308:         <div class="aq-left-col">
309:           <div class="aq-phase-status">
310:             <div class="aq-phase-current" id="aq-phase-label">${phase.icon} ${phase.label}</div>
311:           </div>
312:           <div class="aq-party-strip-section">
313:             <div class="aq-section-label">Party</div>
314:             <div class="aq-party-strip">${partyStrip}</div>
315:           </div>
316:           <div class="aq-enemies-section">
317:             <div class="aq-section-label">Enemies</div>
318:             <div class="aq-enemy-strip">${enemyCards}</div>
319:           </div>
320:           <div class="aq-rewards-preview">
321:             <div class="aq-section-label">Potential Rewards</div>
322:             <div class="aq-rewards-row">
323:               <span class="aq-reward"><span class="aq-reward-icon">💰</span> ${quest.goldReward.min}–${quest.goldReward.max}g</span>
324:               <span class="aq-reward"><span class="aq-reward-icon">✦</span> ${quest.expReward.min}–${quest.expReward.max} exp</span>
325:               <span class="aq-reward"><span class="aq-reward-icon">⭐</span> +${quest.rankPointReward} RP</span>

333:           </div>
334:         </div>
335:       </div>
336:     </div>
337:   `;

339: // ── Quest Board ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
340: function renderQuestBoard(s) {
341:   const filterBtns = RANK_ORDER.map(r => {
342:     const unlocked = rankIndex(s.guild.rank) >= rankIndex(r);
343:     const active = r === questRankFilter;
344:     return `<button class="rank-filter-btn rank-${rankCss(r)}${active ? ' active' : ''}${!unlocked ? ' locked' : ''}" data-rank="${r}">${r}</button>`;
345:   }).join('');
346:   const unlockedRank = rankIndex(s.guild.rank) >= rankIndex(questRankFilter);
347:   let questItems = '';
348:   let refreshTimer = '';
349:   if (!unlockedRank) {
350:     questItems = `<div class="empty-state">Requires ${questRankFilter} Rank to view these quests.</div>`;
351:   } else {
352:     const quests = Game.getQuestBoardQuests(questRankFilter);
353:     const partyStrength = Game.getPartyStrength();
354:     if (quests.length === 0) {
355:       questItems = `<div class="empty-state">No quests available. Check back soon!</div>`;
356:     } else {
357:       questItems = quests.map(q => renderQuestCard(s, q, partyStrength)).join('');
358:     }
359:     const refreshMs = Game.questBoardRefreshMs(questRankFilter);
360:     const timerText = refreshMs > 0 ? `New quests in: ${fmtTime(Math.ceil(refreshMs / 1000))} — ` : '';
361:     refreshTimer = `<div class="qb-refresh-timer" id="qb-refresh-timer"><span class="qb-timer-text">${timerText}</span><button class="btn btn-sm btn-refresh-board" style="font-size:0.85em;padding:2px 10px;cursor:pointer;">🔄 Refresh Board</button></div>`;
362:   }
363:   // Party strength display
364:   const partyStr = Game.getPartyStrength();
365:   // Auto-run strategy picker
366:   const maxRun = Game.getMaxAutoRun();
367:   const autoRun = s.autoRun;
368:   let strategyPicker = '';
369:   if (maxRun >= 2) {
370:     const runOpts = [2, 5, 10, 20].filter(n => n <= maxRun);
371:     const strategies = [
372:       { id: 'safe', icon: '🛡', label: 'Play it Safe', desc: 'Easiest quests' },
373:       { id: 'balanced', icon: '⚖', label: 'Balanced', desc: 'Moderate difficulty' },
374:       { id: 'push', icon: '🔥', label: 'Push Limits', desc: 'Hardest quests' },
375:     ];
376:     if (autoRun && autoRun.remaining > 0) {
377:       // Active auto-run — show status + stop button
378:       const strat = strategies.find(s => s.id === autoRun.strategy) || strategies[1];
379:       strategyPicker = `
380:         <div class="ar-picker ar-active">
381:           <div class="ar-status">
382:             <span class="ar-status-icon">${strat.icon}</span>
383:             <span class="ar-status-text">${strat.label}: ${autoRun.remaining} of ${autoRun.total} remaining</span>
384:           </div>
385:           <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger btn-ar-stop">⏹ Stop</button>
386:         </div>`;
387:     } else {
388:       // Show strategy picker
389:       const stratBtns = strategies.map(st =>
390:         `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-ar-strategy" data-strategy="${st.id}" title="${st.desc}">${st.icon} ${st.label}</button>`
391:       ).join('');
392:       const countBtns = runOpts.map(n =>
393:         `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-ar-count${n === 2 ? ' selected' : ''}" data-count="${n}">×${n}</button>`
394:       ).join('');
395:       strategyPicker = `
396:         <div class="ar-picker">
397:           <div class="ar-label">Auto-Battle</div>
398:           <div class="ar-strategies">${stratBtns}</div>
399:           <div class="ar-counts">${countBtns}</div>
400:         </div>`;
401:     }
402:   }
403:   return `
404:     <div class="qb-header">
405:       <div class="qb-header-row">
406:         <div>
407:           <div class="qb-title">Quest Board</div>
408:           <div class="qb-subtitle">5 quests per rank — refreshes on quest completion or every 15 min</div>
409:         </div>
410:         <div class="qb-party-strength">
411:           <div class="qb-ps-label">Party Strength</div>
412:           <div class="qb-ps-value">${Math.round(partyStr)}</div>
413:         </div>
414:       </div>
415:       ${strategyPicker}
416:       ${refreshTimer}
417:     </div>
418:     <div class="rank-filter">${filterBtns}</div>
419:     <div class="quest-list">${questItems}</div>
420:   `;
421: }
422: // ── Quest Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
423: function renderQuestCard(s, quest, partyStrength) {
424:   const check = Game.canTakeQuest(quest.id);
425:   const completions = Game.completionCount(quest.id);
426:   const expanded = selectedQuestId === quest.id;
427:   // Sub-tier badge — authoritative under the §9 rework. Replaces the old
428:   // ratio-based classifier which saturated at low party strength and lied
429:   // about toughness once intrinsic rank curves took over.
430:   const subTier = quest.subTier || 'standard';
431:   const SUB_TIER_DISPLAY = {
432:     easy:     { label: 'Easy',     color: '#2ecc71', icon: '◐' },
433:     standard: { label: 'Standard', color: '#f0c060', icon: '●' },
434:     hard:     { label: 'Hard',     color: '#e67e22', icon: '◆' },
435:     brutal:   { label: 'Brutal',   color: '#e74c3c', icon: '✦' },
436:   };
437:   const tier = SUB_TIER_DISPLAY[subTier] || SUB_TIER_DISPLAY.standard;
438:   const isDone = !quest.isRepeatable && completions > 0;
439:   const isBoss = quest.boss;
440:   const isRaidBoss = quest.raidBoss;
441:   const isGemMining = quest.gemMining;
442:   const cardClass = `quest-card${expanded ? ' selected' : ''}${isDone ? ' done' : ''}${isBoss ? ' quest-boss' : ''}${isRaidBoss ? ' quest-raid' : ''}${isGemMining ? ' quest-gem-mining' : ''}`;
443:   const env = quest.environment || { name: '???', icon: '?', mood: 'dungeon' };
444:   const rarity = quest.rarity || 'common';
445:   const rarityBadge = rarity !== 'common'
446:     ? `<span class="rarity-badge rarity-${rarity}">${rarity}</span>`
447:     : '';
448:   // Special quest type tag
449:   const typeTag = isBoss
450:     ? `<span class="quest-type-tag tag-boss">⚠ BOSS</span>`
451:     : isGemMining
452:       ? `<span class="quest-type-tag tag-gem-mining">💎 GEM HAUL</span>`
453:       : '';
454:   const metaRight = `
455:     <span class="qc-stat qc-gold" title="Gold reward">💰 ${quest.goldReward.min}–${quest.goldReward.max}</span>
456:     <span class="qc-stat qc-exp" title="EXP reward">✦ ${quest.expReward.min}–${quest.expReward.max}</span>
457:     <span class="qc-stat qc-rp" title="Rank points">⭐ ${quest.rankPointReward}</span>
458:     <span class="qc-stat qc-rec" title="Recommended power">⚔ ${Math.round(quest.recommendedPower)}</span>
459:     <span class="difficulty-badge" style="background:${tier.color}20;color:${tier.color}">${tier.icon} ${tier.label}</span>
460:     ${rarityBadge}
461:     ${completions > 0 ? `<span class="quest-done-badge">×${completions}</span>` : ''}
462:   `;
463:   let detail = '';
464:   if (expanded) {
465:     const lootEntries = quest.lootTable.map(e => {
466:       const item = getItem(e.itemId);
467:       if (!item) return `<span>${e.itemId}</span>`;
468:       const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
469:       const classReqStr = item.classReq
470:         ? item.classReq.map(cid => CLASSES[cid]?.label || cid).join(', ')
471:         : 'Any class';
472:       return `<span class="qd-loot-entry"><span style="color:${rarity.color}">${item.name}</span> <span class="item-rarity-badge" style="color:${rarity.color};border-color:${rarity.color}30">${rarity.label}</span> <span class="qd-loot-class-req">${classReqStr}</span></span>`;
473:     }).join('');
474:     const powerRatio = partyStrength / Math.max(1, quest.recommendedPower);
475:     const powerPct = Math.min(100, powerRatio * 50);
476:     const powerBarColor = tier.color;
477:     const enemies = (quest.enemies || []).join(', ');
478:     // Synergy bonuses for repeated quests
479:     const synergyBonuses = [];
480:     const goldXp = Game.getGoldXpBonus(quest.id);
481:     if (goldXp > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`💰 +${Math.round(goldXp * 100)}% Gold/XP`);
482:     const dmg = Game.getDmgBonus(quest.id);
483:     if (dmg > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`⚔ +${Math.round(dmg * 100)}% Damage`);
484:     const spd = Game.getAtkSpeedBonus(quest.id);
485:     if (spd > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`⚡ +${Math.round(spd * 100)}% ATK Speed`);
486:     const dmgRed = Game.getDmgReduction(quest.id);
487:     if (dmgRed > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`🛡 −${Math.round(dmgRed * 100)}% Damage Taken`);
488:     const heal = Game.getHealBonus(quest.id);
489:     if (heal > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`💚 +${Math.round(heal * 100)}% Healing`);
490:     const itemF = Game.getItemFind(quest.id);
491:     if (itemF > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`🔮 +${Math.round(itemF * 100)}% Item Find`);
492:     const rpB = Game.getRpBonus(quest.id);
493:     if (rpB > 0) synergyBonuses.push(`📈 +${Math.round(rpB * 100)}% Rank Points`);
494:     const synergyInfo = synergyBonuses.length > 0
495:       ? `<div class="qd-synergy-bonuses">${synergyBonuses.join(' · ')}</div>`
496:       : '';
497:     // (Auto-run is now a board-level control, not per-quest)
498:     let actionRow = '';
499:     if (!check.ok) {
500:       actionRow = `<div class="quest-block-reason">${check.reason}</div>`;
501:     } else {
502:       actionRow = `<button class="btn btn-success btn-lg btn-send-party" data-quest-id="${quest.id}">⚔ Send Party</button>`;
503:     }
504:     detail = `
505:       <div class="quest-detail">
506:         <div class="qd-flavor">
507:           <span class="qd-env-icon">${env.icon}</span>
508:           <div>
509:             <div class="qd-env-name">${env.name}</div>
510:             <div class="quest-description">"${quest.description}"</div>
511:           </div>
512:         </div>
513:         ${enemies ? `<div class="qd-enemies">
514:           <span class="qd-enemies-label">Threats:</span>
515:           <span class="qd-enemies-list">${enemies}</span>
516:         </div>` : ''}
517:         <div class="qd-rewards-grid">
518:           <div class="qd-reward-box">
519:             <div class="qd-reward-val text-gold">${quest.goldReward.min}–${quest.goldReward.max}g</div>
520:             <div class="qd-reward-label">Gold</div>
521:           </div>
522:           <div class="qd-reward-box">
523:             <div class="qd-reward-val text-cyan">${quest.expReward.min}–${quest.expReward.max}</div>
524:             <div class="qd-reward-label">Exp / member</div>
525:           </div>
526:           <div class="qd-reward-box">
527:             <div class="qd-reward-val" style="color:var(--purple)">+${quest.rankPointReward}</div>
528:             <div class="qd-reward-label">Rank pts</div>
529:           </div>
530:         </div>
531:         <div class="qd-power-section">
532:           <div class="qd-power-header">
533:             <span>Party Strength: <strong style="color:${powerBarColor}">${Math.round(partyStrength)}</strong></span>
534:             <span>Recommended: <strong>${Math.round(quest.recommendedPower)}</strong></span>
535:           </div>
536:           <div class="progress-bar">
537:             <div class="progress-fill" style="width:${powerPct}%; background:${powerBarColor}"></div>
538:           </div>
539:           <div class="qd-tier-label" style="color:${tier.color}">${tier.icon} ${tier.label} Difficulty</div>
540:         </div>
541:         ${synergyInfo}
542:         <div class="qd-loot">
543:           <span class="qd-loot-label">Possible Loot:</span>
544:           <div class="qd-loot-list">${lootEntries}</div>
545:         </div>
546:         <div class="qd-actions">
547:           <span class="qd-repeatable">${quest.isRepeatable ? 'Repeatable' : 'One-time'}</span>
548:           ${actionRow}
549:         </div>
550:       </div>
551:     `;
552:   }
553:   return `
554:     <div class="${cardClass}">
555:       <div class="quest-header" data-quest-id="${quest.id}">
556:         <span class="quest-rank-tag rank-${rankCss(quest.rank)}" style="color:var(--rank-${rankCss(quest.rank)});border-color:var(--rank-${rankCss(quest.rank)})">${quest.rank}</span>
557:         <span class="qc-env-icon">${env.icon}</span>
558:         <span class="quest-title">${quest.title}</span>${typeTag}
559:         <div class="quest-meta">${metaRight}</div>
560:       </div>
561:       ${detail}
562:     </div>
563:   `;
564: }
565: // ── Quest History View ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
566: function renderQuestHistory(s) {
567:   const history = s.questHistory || [];
568:   if (history.length === 0) {
569:     return `<div class="empty-state">No quest history yet. Complete your first quest to see results here.</div>`;
570:   }
571:   const entries = history.map((h, i) => {
572:     const isExpanded = expandedHistoryIdx === i;
573:     // Quick stats line (always visible)
574:     const quickStats = [
575:       h.goldEarned > 0 ? `<span class="qh-stat text-gold">+${h.goldEarned}g</span>` : '',
576:       h.expEarned > 0 ? `<span class="qh-stat text-cyan">+${h.expEarned} exp</span>` : '',
577:       h.rankPoints > 0 ? `<span class="qh-stat" style="color:var(--purple)">+${h.rankPoints} RP</span>` : '',
578:     ].filter(Boolean).join('');
579:     const lootCount = (h.loot || []).length;
580:     const hasSecretBoss = !!h.secretBoss;
581:     const chevron = isExpanded ? '▾' : '▸';
582:     // Collapsed summary hints
583:     const hints = [];
584:     if (lootCount > 0) hints.push(`${lootCount} item${lootCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
585:     if (hasSecretBoss) hints.push('Boss!');
586:     if ((h.levelUps || []).length > 0) hints.push('Level up!');
587:     const hintText = hints.length > 0 ? `<span class="qh-hints">${hints.join(' · ')}</span>` : '';
588:     // Expanded detail section
589:     let detail = '';
590:     if (isExpanded) {
591:       // Environment & difficulty
592:       const env = h.environment;
593:       const envLine = env ? `<div class="qh-detail-row"><span class="qh-detail-label">Location:</span> <span>${env.icon} ${env.name}</span></div>` : '';
594:       const enemies = (h.enemies || []);
595:       const enemiesLine = enemies.length > 0
596:         ? `<div class="qh-detail-row"><span class="qh-detail-label">Enemies:</span> <span>${enemies.join(', ')}</span></div>`
597:         : '';
598:       // Difficulty tier — prefer stored subTier (new system), fall back to
599:       // ratio-based reconstruction for legacy entries.
600:       let tierLine = '';
601:       if (h.subTier) {
602:         const SUB_TIER_HIST = {
603:           easy:     { label: 'Easy',     color: '#2ecc71', icon: '◐' },
604:           standard: { label: 'Standard', color: '#f0c060', icon: '●' },
605:           hard:     { label: 'Hard',     color: '#e67e22', icon: '◆' },
606:           brutal:   { label: 'Brutal',   color: '#e74c3c', icon: '✦' },
607:         };
608:         const st = SUB_TIER_HIST[h.subTier] || SUB_TIER_HIST.standard;
609:         const powerNote = (h.questPower && h.partyPower)
610:           ? ` <span class="qh-detail-sub">(Party ${Math.round(h.partyPower)} vs Quest ${Math.round(h.questPower)})</span>` : '';
611:         tierLine = `<div class="qh-detail-row"><span class="qh-detail-label">Difficulty:</span> <span style="color:${st.color}">${st.icon} ${st.label}</span>${powerNote}</div>`;
612:       } else if (h.questPower && h.partyPower) {
613:         const tier = getQuestDifficultyTier(h.questPower, h.partyPower);
614:         tierLine = `<div class="qh-detail-row"><span class="qh-detail-label">Difficulty:</span> <span style="color:${tier.color}">${tier.icon} ${tier.label}</span> <span class="qh-detail-sub">(Party ${Math.round(h.partyPower)} vs Quest ${Math.round(h.questPower)})</span></div>`;
615:       }
616:       // Rarity
617:       const rarityLine = h.rarity && h.rarity !== 'common'
618:         ? `<div class="qh-detail-row"><span class="qh-detail-label">Rarity:</span> <span class="rarity-badge rarity-${h.rarity}">${h.rarity}</span></div>`
619:         : '';
620:       // Narrative
621:       const narrativeLine = h.narrative ? `<div class="qh-detail-narrative">"${h.narrative}"</div>` : '';
622:       // Combat stats
623:       let combatStatsHtml = '';
624:       const cStats = h.combatStats || [];
625:       if (cStats.length > 0) {
626:         const maxDmg = Math.max(1, ...cStats.map(c => c.dmgDealt));
627:         const csRows = cStats.map(c => {
628:           const cls = getClass(c.class);
629:           const sigil = cls ? cls.sigil : '?';
630:           const dmgPct = Math.round((c.dmgDealt / maxDmg) * 100);
631:           const healDone = c.healingDone > 0 ? `<span class="cs-heal" title="Healing done">⚕${c.healingDone}</span>` : '';
632:           const healRcvd = (c.healingReceived || 0) > 0 ? `<span class="cs-heal-rcvd" title="Healing received">💚${c.healingReceived}</span>` : '';
633:           const taken = c.dmgTaken > 0 ? `<span class="cs-taken" title="Damage taken">💔${c.dmgTaken}</span>` : '';
634:           return `<div class="cs-row">
635:             <div class="cs-name">${sigil} ${esc(c.name.split(' ')[0])}</div>
636:             <div class="cs-bar-wrap"><div class="cs-bar" style="width:${dmgPct}%"></div><span class="cs-dmg-val">${c.dmgDealt}</span></div>
637:             <div class="cs-extras">${healDone}${healRcvd}${taken}</div>
638:           </div>`;
639:         }).join('');
640:         combatStatsHtml = `<div class="qh-detail-section">
641:           <div class="qh-detail-section-title">Combat Performance</div>
642:           <div class="cs-header"><span>Member</span><span>Damage Dealt</span><span>⚕ Done · 💚 Rcvd · 💔 Taken</span></div>
643:           ${csRows}
644:         </div>`;
645:       }
646:       // Loot detail
647:       let lootHtml = '';
648:       const loot = h.loot || [];
649:       if (loot.length > 0) {
650:         const lootItems = loot.map(d => {
651:           const item = getItem(d.itemId);
652:           if (!item) return `<span class="qh-loot-item">${d.itemId}</span>`;
653:           const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
654:           const classReqStr = item.classReq
655:             ? item.classReq.map(cid => CLASSES[cid]?.label || cid).join(', ')
656:             : 'Any class';
657:           const qty = d.quantity > 1 ? ` ×${d.quantity}` : '';
658:           return `<span class="qh-loot-item"><span style="color:${rarity.color}">${item.name}</span>${qty} <span class="item-rarity-badge" style="color:${rarity.color};border-color:${rarity.color}30">${rarity.label}</span> <span class="qh-loot-class-req">${classReqStr}</span></span>`;
659:         }).join('');
660:         lootHtml = `<div class="qh-detail-section"><div class="qh-detail-section-title">Loot Obtained</div><div class="qh-loot-grid">${lootItems}</div></div>`;
661:       }
662:       // Skills activated — consolidated: count per member's skill, show top uses
663:       let skillsHtml = '';
664:       const skills = h.activatedSkills || [];
665:       if (skills.length > 0) {
666:         // Count uses per skill per member
667:         const skillCounts = {};
668:         for (const a of skills) {
669:           const key = `${a.memberName}::${a.skill.name}`;
670:           if (!skillCounts[key]) skillCounts[key] = { name: a.memberName, skill: a.skill.name, icon: a.skill.icon || '•', count: 0 };
671:           skillCounts[key].count++;
672:         }
673:         const sorted = Object.values(skillCounts).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
674:         const topSkills = sorted.slice(0, 5); // show top 5
675:         const skillRows = topSkills.map(s =>
676:           `<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">${s.icon}</span><span class="highlight-label">${esc(s.name)}</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(s.skill)} — <strong>×${s.count}</strong></span></div>`
677:         ).join('');
678:         skillsHtml = `<div class="qh-detail-section"><div class="qh-detail-section-title">Top Skills Used</div>${skillRows}</div>`;
679:       }
680:       // Level ups — consolidated per character
681:       let levelUpsHtml = '';
682:       const levelUps = h.levelUps || [];
683:       if (levelUps.length > 0) {
684:         const byName = {};
685:         for (const lu of levelUps) {
686:           if (!byName[lu.name]) byName[lu.name] = [];
687:           byName[lu.name].push(lu.level);
688:         }
689:         const luRows = Object.entries(byName).map(([name, levels]) => {
690:           const from = Math.min(...levels) - 1;
691:           const to = Math.max(...levels);
692:           return `<div class="result-levelup-entry"><span class="levelup-name">⭐ ${esc(name)}</span><span class="levelup-levels">${from} → ${to}</span></div>`;
693:         }).join('');
694:         levelUpsHtml = `<div class="qh-detail-section"><div class="qh-detail-section-title">Level Ups</div>${luRows}</div>`;
695:       }
696:       // Secret boss
697:       let secretBossHtml = '';
698:       if (h.secretBoss) {
699:         const sb = h.secretBoss;
700:         secretBossHtml = `
701:           <div class="qh-detail-section">
702:             <div class="qh-secret-boss ${sb.success ? 'success' : 'failure'}">
703:               ${sb.boss.icon} <strong>Secret Boss: ${sb.boss.name}</strong> — ${sb.success ? 'Defeated!' : 'Escaped!'}
704:               ${sb.success ? `<br>Bonus: +${sb.goldBonus}g, +${sb.expBonus} exp` : ''}
705:               ${sb.success && sb.classReward ? `<br>${sb.recipientName} gained <strong>${sb.classReward.name}</strong>` : ''}
706:             </div>
707:           </div>`;
708:       }
709:       detail = `
710:         <div class="qh-detail">
711:           ${narrativeLine}
712:           <div class="qh-detail-grid">
713:             ${envLine}${enemiesLine}${tierLine}${rarityLine}
714:           </div>
715:           ${combatStatsHtml}
716:           ${lootHtml}
717:           ${skillsHtml}
718:           ${levelUpsHtml}
719:           ${secretBossHtml}
720:         </div>`;
721:     }
722:     return `
723:       <div class="qh-entry ${h.success ? 'success' : 'failure'}${isExpanded ? ' expanded' : ''}" data-history-idx="${i}">
724:         <div class="qh-header" data-history-toggle="${i}">
725:           <div class="qh-title">
726:             <span class="qh-chevron">${chevron}</span>
727:             ${rankTag(h.questRank)}
728:             <span class="qh-quest-name">${h.questTitle}</span>
729:             <span class="qh-outcome ${h.success ? 'success' : 'failure'}">${h.success ? '✓' : '✗'}</span>
730:           </div>
731:           <div class="qh-header-right">
732:             <div class="qh-stats">${quickStats}</div>
733:             ${hintText}
734:             <span class="qh-time">${timeAgo(h.timestamp)}</span>
735:           </div>
736:         </div>
737:         ${detail}
738:       </div>
739:     `;
740:   }).join('');
741:   return `
742:     <div class="qh-container">
743:       <div class="qh-title-bar">
744:         <div class="qb-title">Quest History</div>
745:         <div class="qb-subtitle">${history.length} recent quests (max 50) · Click to expand</div>
746:       </div>
747:       <div class="qh-list">${entries}</div>
748:     </div>
749:   `;
750: }
751: // ── Party Synergy View ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
752: function renderPartySynergy(s) {

754:   const thresholds = Game.SYNERGY_THRESHOLDS;

763:         </div>
764:         <div class="syn-bonus-desc">${t.desc}</div>
765:         ${!unlocked ? `<div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${progress}%; background:var(--cyan)"></div></div>` : ''}
766:       </div>
767:     `;
768:   }).join('');
769:   const maxRepeat = Game.getMaxAutoRun();
770:   const secretChance = Game.getSecretBossChance();

772:     <div class="syn-container">

776:       </div>

781:         </div>

786:         <div class="syn-stat-box">

789:         </div>
790:         <div class="syn-stat-box">

799: // ── Event Binding ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
800: function bindEvents(el, setTabCallback) {
801:   // Tab sub-navigation
802:   el.querySelectorAll('.quest-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
803:     btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
804:       const view = btn.dataset.view;
805:       if (view === 'board' && Game.state.guild.activeQuest) {
806:         questView = 'active';
807:       } else {
808:         questView = view;
809:       }
810:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
811:     });
812:   });
813:   el.querySelectorAll('.rank-filter-btn:not(.locked)').forEach(btn => {
814:     btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
815:       questRankFilter = btn.dataset.rank;
816:       selectedQuestId = null;
817:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
818:     });
819:   });
820:   el.querySelectorAll('.quest-header[data-quest-id]').forEach(header => {
821:     header.addEventListener('click', () => {
822:       const qid = header.dataset.questId;
823:       selectedQuestId = selectedQuestId === qid ? null : qid;
824:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
825:     });
826:   });
827:   el.querySelectorAll('.btn-send-party[data-quest-id]').forEach(btn => {
828:     btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
829:       e.stopPropagation();
830:       const result = Game.startQuest(btn.dataset.questId);
831:       if (result.ok) {
832:         selectedQuestId = null;
833:         resetCombatLog();
834:         questView = 'active';
835:         renderQuests(setTabCallback);
836:       } else {
837:         showToast(result.reason, 'error');
838:       }
839:     });
840:   });
841:   let selectedArCount = 2;
842:   el.querySelectorAll('.btn-ar-count').forEach(btn => {
843:     btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
844:       e.stopPropagation();
845:       selectedArCount = parseInt(btn.dataset.count, 10);
846:       el.querySelectorAll('.btn-ar-count').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
847:       btn.classList.add('selected');
848:     });
849:   });
850:   el.querySelectorAll('.btn-ar-strategy').forEach(btn => {
851:     btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
852:       e.stopPropagation();
853:       const strategy = btn.dataset.strategy;
854:       const countBtn = el.querySelector('.btn-ar-count.selected');
855:       const count = countBtn ? parseInt(countBtn.dataset.count, 10) : selectedArCount;
856:       const result = Game.startAutoRun(strategy, count, questRankFilter);
857:       if (result.ok) {
858:         selectedQuestId = null;
859:         resetCombatLog();
860:         questView = 'active';
861:         renderQuests(setTabCallback);
862:       } else {
863:         showToast(result.reason || 'Cannot start auto-battle', 'error');
864:       }
865:     });
866:   });
867:   const stopBtn = el.querySelector('.btn-ar-stop');
868:   if (stopBtn) {
869:     stopBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
870:       e.stopPropagation();
871:       Game.stopAutoRun();
872:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
873:     });
874:   }
875:   const refreshBoardBtn = el.querySelector('.btn-refresh-board');
876:   if (refreshBoardBtn) {
877:     refreshBoardBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
878:       e.stopPropagation();
879:       Game.refreshQuestBoard(questRankFilter, true);
880:       selectedQuestId = null;
881:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
882:     });
883:   }
884:   el.querySelectorAll('[data-history-toggle]').forEach(header => {
885:     header.addEventListener('click', () => {
886:       const idx = parseInt(header.dataset.historyToggle, 10);
887:       expandedHistoryIdx = expandedHistoryIdx === idx ? null : idx;
888:       renderQuests(setTabCallback);
889:     });
890:   });
891:   const logEl = document.getElementById('aq-combat-log');
892:   if (logEl) logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
893: }
````

## File: js/ui/results.js
````javascript
  1: import Game from '../game.js';
  2: import { getItem, getItemRarity, CLASSES, EQUIPMENT } from '../data.js';
  3: import { getSkill, SKILLS } from '../skills.js';
  4: import { esc, rankCss } from '../util.js';
  5: import { floatText, confettiBurst, screenFlash, particleBurst } from './effects.js';
  6: function formatLootEntry(d) {
  7:   const item = getItem(d.itemId);
  8:   if (!item) return `<span>${d.itemId}</span>`;
  9:   const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
 10:   const classReqStr = item.classReq
 11:     ? item.classReq.map(cid => CLASSES[cid]?.label || cid).join(', ')
 12:     : 'Any class';
 13:   const qty = d.quantity > 1 ? ` \u00d7${d.quantity}` : '';
 14:   const dropAnim = rarity.id !== 'common' ? ` loot-drop-${rarity.id}` : '';
 15:   const nameGlow = rarity.id === 'celestial' ? ' item-name-celestial' : rarity.id === 'legendary' ? ' item-name-legendary' : rarity.id === 'epic' ? ' item-name-epic' : '';
 16:   return `<span class="result-loot-entry${dropAnim}"><span class="${nameGlow}" style="color:${rarity.color}">${item.name}</span>${qty} <span class="item-rarity-badge" style="color:${rarity.color};border-color:${rarity.color}30">${rarity.label}</span> <span class="result-loot-class-req">${classReqStr}</span></span>`;
 17: }
 18: // ── Fight Log Export ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 19: function formatFightLog() {
 20:   const pr = Game.state.pendingResults;
 21:   if (!pr) return '(No pending results)';
 22:   const { quest, result, levelUps, combatStats } = pr;
 23:   const s = Game.state;
 24:   const lines = [];
 25:   // Header
 26:   lines.push('═══════════════════════════════════════════');
 27:   lines.push('           ADVENTURERS GUILD — FIGHT LOG');
 28:   lines.push('═══════════════════════════════════════════');
 29:   lines.push(`Quest: ${quest.title} [${quest.rank}-Rank]`);
 30:   lines.push(`Outcome: ${result.success ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT'}`);
 31:   lines.push(`Narrative: "${result.narrative}"`);
 32:   lines.push(`Party Power: ${result.partyPower} vs Quest Power: ${result.questPower} (${Math.round(result.ratio * 100)}%)`);
 33:   if (quest.environment) lines.push(`Environment: ${quest.environment.name} ${quest.environment.icon || ''}`);
 34:   if (quest.enemies) lines.push(`Enemies: ${quest.enemies.join(', ')}`);
 35:   if (quest.boss) lines.push(`** BOSS QUEST — ${quest.bossName || 'Unknown Boss'} **`);
 36:   if (quest.gemMining) lines.push(`** GEM MINING QUEST **`);
 37:   lines.push('');
 38:   // Party composition with gear
 39:   // Prefer sim-time snapshot from combatDebug so levels/stats match the
 40:   // ATB block — post-fight level-ups otherwise create a confusing mismatch
 41:   // between the header Lv and the debug "at sim start" section.
 42:   lines.push('── PARTY COMPOSITION ──────────────────────');
 43:   const activeMembers = [s.player, ...s.activeSlots.map(id => s.party.find(p => p.id === id)).filter(Boolean)];
 44:   const resultAuras = Game.getPartyAuras();
 45:   const snapshotById = {};
 46:   if (pr.combatDebug?.members) {
 47:     for (const snap of pr.combatDebug.members) snapshotById[snap.id] = snap;
 48:   }
 49:   for (const m of activeMembers) {
 50:     const cls = CLASSES[m.class];
 51:     const snap = snapshotById[m.id];
 52:     const eff = snap || Game.effectiveStats(m, resultAuras);
 53:     const shownLevel = snap ? snap.level : m.level;
 54:     const specLabel = m.heroSpec ? ` [${m.heroSpec.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + m.heroSpec.slice(1)}]` : '';
 55:     lines.push(`${cls?.sigil || '?'} ${m.name} — ${cls?.label || m.class}${specLabel} Lv.${shownLevel}  (Power: ${Game.memberPower(m)})`);
 56:     lines.push(`  HP: ${eff.maxHp}  ATK: ${eff.atk}  DEF: ${eff.def}  MAG: ${eff.mag}  SPD: ${eff.spd}  CRT: ${eff.crit}  DDG: ${eff.dodge}`);
 57:     // Special percentage bonuses
 58:     const specials = [];
 59:     if (eff.dodgeChance > 0) specials.push(`DDG%+${Math.round(eff.dodgeChance * 100)}%`);
 60:     if (eff.critChance > 0) specials.push(`CRT%+${Math.round(eff.critChance * 100)}%`);
 61:     if (eff.healBonus > 0) specials.push(`HEAL+${Math.round(eff.healBonus * 100)}%`);
 62:     if (specials.length > 0) lines.push(`  Bonuses: ${specials.join(', ')}`);
 63:     // Equipment
 64:     const slots = ['weapon', 'armor', 'offhand', 'accessory'];
 65:     const gearParts = [];
 66:     for (const slot of slots) {
 67:       const itemId = m.equipment?.[slot];
 68:       if (itemId) {
 69:         const item = EQUIPMENT[itemId] || getItem(itemId);
 70:         if (item) {
 71:           const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
 72:           gearParts.push(`[${slot}] ${item.name} (${rarity?.label || item.rarity})`);
 73:         }
 74:       }
 75:     }
 76:     if (gearParts.length > 0) lines.push(`  Gear: ${gearParts.join(' | ')}`);
 77:     const memberData = Game.getMember(m.id);
 78:     const skillList = (snap && snap.skills && snap.skills.length > 0)
 79:       ? snap.skills
 80:       : (memberData?.skills || []);
 81:     if (skillList.length > 0) {
 82:       const skillNames = skillList.map(sid => {
 83:         const sk = getSkill(sid);
 84:         if (!sk) return sid;
 85:         let tag;
 86:         if (sk.type === 'passive') tag = 'passive';
 87:         else if (sk.reactive) tag = 'reactive';
 88:         else if (sk.procChance != null && sk.procChance < 1) tag = `${Math.round(sk.procChance*100)}%`;
 89:         else tag = 'active';
 90:         return `${sk.name} [${sk.source} ${tag}]`;
 91:       });
 92:       lines.push(`  Skills: ${skillNames.join(', ')}`);
 93:     }
 94:     lines.push('');
 95:   }
 96:   // Combat debug info (bonuses, auras, effective stats at sim start)
 97:   const debugData = pr.combatDebug;
 98:   if (debugData) {
 99:     lines.push('── COMBAT DEBUG ──────────────────────────');
100:     const hb = debugData.healBonus;
101:     const healParts = [];
102:     if (hb.synergy > 0) healParts.push(`synergy=${(hb.synergy * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);
103:     if (hb.partyAura > 0) healParts.push(`aura=${(hb.partyAura * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);
104:     if (hb.memberItem > 0) healParts.push(`item/skill=${(hb.memberItem * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);
105:     lines.push(`  Heal Multiplier: ${hb.total.toFixed(2)}× ${healParts.length ? '(' + healParts.join(' + ') + ')' : ''}`);
106:     if (debugData.dmgBonus > 1) lines.push(`  Damage Multiplier: ${debugData.dmgBonus.toFixed(2)}×`);
107:     if (debugData.dmgReduction > 0) lines.push(`  Damage Reduction: -${Math.round(debugData.dmgReduction * 100)}%`);
108:     if (debugData.atkSpeedBonus > 0) lines.push(`  Attack Speed: +${Math.round(debugData.atkSpeedBonus * 100)}%`);
109:     const auras = debugData.partyAuras;
110:     if (auras) {
111:       const auraParts = [];
112:       if (auras.atk > 0) auraParts.push(`ATK+${Math.round(auras.atk * 100)}%`);
113:       if (auras.def > 0) auraParts.push(`DEF+${Math.round(auras.def * 100)}%`);
114:       if (auras.mag > 0) auraParts.push(`MAG+${Math.round(auras.mag * 100)}%`);
115:       if (auras.spd > 0) auraParts.push(`SPD+${Math.round(auras.spd * 100)}%`);
116:       if (auras.crit > 0) auraParts.push(`CRT+${Math.round(auras.crit * 100)}%`);
117:       if (auras.dodge > 0) auraParts.push(`DDG+${Math.round(auras.dodge * 100)}%`);
118:       if (auras.maxHp > 0) auraParts.push(`HP+${Math.round(auras.maxHp * 100)}%`);
119:       if (auras.heal > 0) auraParts.push(`HEAL+${Math.round(auras.heal * 100)}%`);
120:       if (auraParts.length > 0) lines.push(`  Party Auras: ${auraParts.join(', ')}`);
121:     }
122:     lines.push('  ── Effective Combat Stats (at sim start) ──');
123:     for (const m of debugData.members) {
124:       const cls = CLASSES[m.class];
125:       const extras = [];
126:       if (m.dodgeChance > 0) extras.push(`DDG%+${Math.round(m.dodgeChance * 100)}%`);
127:       if (m.critChance > 0) extras.push(`CRT%+${Math.round(m.critChance * 100)}%`);
128:       if (m.healBonus > 0) extras.push(`HEAL+${Math.round(m.healBonus * 100)}%`);
129:       lines.push(`  ${cls?.sigil || '?'} ${m.name} (${cls?.label || m.class} Lv.${m.level}) — ATK:${m.atk} DEF:${m.def} MAG:${m.mag} SPD:${m.spd} CRT:${m.crit} DDG:${m.dodge} HP:${m.maxHp}${extras.length ? ' | ' + extras.join(', ') : ''}`);
130:     }
131:     lines.push('');
132:   }
133:   // ATB System Debug
134:   const atbData = debugData?.atb;
135:   if (atbData && atbData.totalRounds > 0) {
136:     lines.push('── ATB SYSTEM DEBUG ──────────────────────');
137:     lines.push(`  Total Rounds: ${atbData.totalRounds}`);
138:     lines.push('');
139:     // Per-member lane utilization
140:     lines.push('  ── Lane Utilization (per member) ──');
141:     lines.push('  Member              ATK Fires  Basic FB  Skill Fires  Skill Att  BUFF Fires  Buff Fail  HEAL Fires  Heal Held');
142:     lines.push('  ──────────────────  ─────────  ────────  ───────────  ─────────  ──────────  ─────────  ──────────  ─────────');
143:     for (const [, data] of Object.entries(atbData.laneActions)) {
144:       const label = `${data.name} (${data.class})`.padEnd(20);
145:       const atkF = String(data.attack.fires).padStart(9);
146:       const atkB = String(data.attack.basicFallbacks).padStart(8);
147:       const atkS = String(data.attack.skillFires).padStart(11);
148:       const atkA = String(data.attack.skillAttempts).padStart(9);
149:       const bufF = String(data.buff.fires).padStart(10);
150:       const bufP = String(data.buff.procFails).padStart(9);
151:       const hlF = String(data.heal.fires).padStart(10);
152:       const hlH = String(data.heal.held).padStart(9);
153:       lines.push(`  ${label}${atkF}${atkB}${atkS}${atkA}${bufF}${bufP}${hlF}${hlH}`);
154:     }
155:     lines.push('');
156:     // Skill pool assignments
157:     lines.push('  ── Skill Pool Assignments ──');
158:     for (const [, data] of Object.entries(atbData.laneActions)) {
159:       lines.push(`  ${data.name} (${data.class}):`);
160:       if (data.skillPools.attack.length > 0) lines.push(`    Attack: ${data.skillPools.attack.join(', ')}`);
161:       if (data.skillPools.buff.length > 0) lines.push(`    Buff:   ${data.skillPools.buff.join(', ')}`);
162:       if (data.skillPools.heal.length > 0) lines.push(`    Heal:   ${data.skillPools.heal.join(', ')}`);
163:     }
164:     lines.push('');
165:     // Proc roll log (summarized — group by skill)
166:     if (atbData.procRolls.length > 0) {
167:       lines.push('  ── Proc Roll Summary (by skill) ──');
168:       const skillRollMap = {};
169:       for (const r of atbData.procRolls) {
170:         const key = `${r.member}|${r.skillName}|${r.lane}`;
171:         if (!skillRollMap[key]) {
172:           skillRollMap[key] = { member: r.member, skill: r.skillName, lane: r.lane, procChance: r.procChance, attempts: 0, fires: 0 };
173:         }
174:         skillRollMap[key].attempts++;
175:         if (r.fired) skillRollMap[key].fires++;
176:       }
177:       lines.push('  Member              Skill                Lane    Proc%   Attempts  Fires  Actual%');
178:       lines.push('  ──────────────────  ───────────────────  ──────  ──────  ────────  ─────  ───────');
179:       for (const s of Object.values(skillRollMap)) {
180:         const label = s.member.padEnd(20);
181:         const sk = s.skill.substring(0, 19).padEnd(19);
182:         const lane = s.lane.padEnd(6);
183:         const pct = `${Math.round(s.procChance * 100)}%`.padStart(6);
184:         const att = String(s.attempts).padStart(8);
185:         const fires = String(s.fires).padStart(5);
186:         const actual = s.attempts > 0 ? `${Math.round((s.fires / s.attempts) * 100)}%`.padStart(7) : '   N/A';
187:         lines.push(`  ${label}${sk}  ${lane}${pct}${att}${fires}${actual}`);
188:       }
189:       lines.push('');
190:     }
191:     // Reactive events
192:     if (atbData.reactiveEvents.length > 0) {
193:       lines.push('  ── Reactive Triggers ──');
194:       for (const r of atbData.reactiveEvents) {
195:         lines.push(`  [Rd ${String(r.round).padStart(3)}] ${r.type} — ${r.member}${r.target ? ` → ${r.target}` : ''} (${r.trigger})`);
196:       }
197:       lines.push('');
198:     }
199:     // Round-by-round HP progression (sampled — every 5 rounds or first/last 3)
200:     if (atbData.roundSummaries.length > 0) {
201:       lines.push('  ── Round Progression ──');
202:       lines.push('  Round  Party#  Enemy#  PartyHP%  EnemyHP%');
203:       lines.push('  ─────  ──────  ──────  ────────  ────────');
204:       const summaries = atbData.roundSummaries;
205:       const showAll = summaries.length <= 20;
206:       for (let idx = 0; idx < summaries.length; idx++) {
207:         const s = summaries[idx];
208:         const show = showAll || idx < 3 || idx >= summaries.length - 3 || s.round % 5 === 0;
209:         if (show) {
210:           const rd = String(s.round).padStart(5);
211:           const lp = String(s.livingParty).padStart(6);
212:           const le = String(s.livingEnemies).padStart(6);
213:           const php = `${s.partyHpPct}%`.padStart(8);
214:           const ehp = `${s.enemyHpPct}%`.padStart(8);
215:           lines.push(`  ${rd}${lp}${le}${php}${ehp}`);
216:         } else if (idx === 3 && !showAll) {
217:           lines.push('  ...');
218:         }
219:       }
220:       lines.push('');
221:     }
222:     // Full proc roll log (detailed, every roll)
223:     if (atbData.procRolls.length > 0) {
224:       lines.push('  ── Proc Roll Detail Log ──');
225:       for (const r of atbData.procRolls) {
226:         const result = r.fired ? 'FIRE' : 'FAIL';
227:         lines.push(`  [Rd ${String(r.round).padStart(3)}] ${r.member.padEnd(16)} ${r.lane.padEnd(6)} ${r.skillName.substring(0, 18).padEnd(18)} need<${Math.round(r.procChance * 100)}% got ${Math.round(r.roll * 100)}% → ${result}`);
228:       }
229:       lines.push('');
230:     }
231:   }
232:   // Combat stats
233:   if (combatStats && combatStats.length > 0) {
234:     lines.push('── DAMAGE DEALT ──────────────────────────');
235:     const totalDmg = combatStats.reduce((s, c) => s + c.dmgDealt, 0);
236:     for (const c of combatStats) {
237:       const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
238:       const dmgPct = totalDmg > 0 ? Math.round((c.dmgDealt / totalDmg) * 100) : 0;
239:       lines.push(`  ${cls?.sigil || '?'} ${c.name} (${cls?.label || c.class}) — ${c.dmgDealt} dmg (${dmgPct}%)`);
240:     }
241:     lines.push(`  TOTAL DAMAGE: ${totalDmg}`);
242:     // Defense & Support table
243:     const defTotal = c => (c.dmgMitigated||0) + (c.dmgAbsorbed||0) + (c.dmgReflected||0) + (c.dmgDodged||0);
244:     const hasDefStats = combatStats.some(c => defTotal(c) > 0);
245:     if (hasDefStats) {
246:       lines.push('');
247:       lines.push('── DEFENSE & SUPPORT ─────────────────────');
248:       lines.push('  Member              Mitigated  Absorbed  Reflected  Dodged   Total');
249:       lines.push('  ──────────────────  ─────────  ────────  ─────────  ──────   ─────');
250:       const sorted = [...combatStats].filter(c => defTotal(c) > 0).sort((a, b) => defTotal(b) - defTotal(a));
251:       for (const c of sorted) {
252:         const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
253:         const label = `${cls?.sigil || '?'} ${c.name}`.padEnd(20);
254:         const mit = (c.dmgMitigated || 0).toString().padStart(9);
255:         const abs = (c.dmgAbsorbed || 0).toString().padStart(8);
256:         const ref = (c.dmgReflected || 0).toString().padStart(9);
257:         const dodge = (c.dmgDodged || 0).toString().padStart(6);
258:         const tot = defTotal(c).toString().padStart(7);
259:         lines.push(`  ${label}${mit}${abs}${ref}${dodge}${tot}`);
260:       }
261:     }
262:     const hasHealStats = combatStats.some(c => (c.healingDone||0) > 0 || (c.healingReceived||0) > 0 || (c.dmgTaken||0) > 0);
263:     if (hasHealStats) {
264:       lines.push('');
265:       lines.push('── HEALING & DAMAGE TAKEN ────────────────');
266:       lines.push('  Member              Healed  Received   Taken');
267:       lines.push('  ──────────────────  ──────  ────────   ─────');
268:       const sorted = [...combatStats]
269:         .filter(c => (c.healingDone||0) > 0 || (c.healingReceived||0) > 0 || (c.dmgTaken||0) > 0)
270:         .sort((a, b) => ((b.healingDone||0) + (b.healingReceived||0)) - ((a.healingDone||0) + (a.healingReceived||0)));
271:       for (const c of sorted) {
272:         const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
273:         const label = `${cls?.sigil || '?'} ${c.name}`.padEnd(20);
274:         const heal = (c.healingDone || 0).toString().padStart(6);
275:         const rcvd = (c.healingReceived || 0).toString().padStart(8);
276:         const taken = (c.dmgTaken || 0).toString().padStart(7);
277:         lines.push(`  ${label}${heal}${rcvd}${taken}`);
278:       }
279:     }
280:     lines.push('');
281:   }
282:   // Skill activations from the game engine (power roll procs)
283:   if (result.activatedSkills?.length > 0) {
284:     lines.push('── SKILL ACTIVATIONS (Power Roll) ────────');
285:     for (const act of result.activatedSkills) {
286:       const sk = act.skill;
287:       const effectParts = [];
288:       if (sk.effects) {
289:         for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(sk.effects)) {
290:           if (key === 'powerMultiplier') effectParts.push(`×${val} power`);
291:           else if (typeof val === 'number') effectParts.push(`${key}: ${val >= 1 ? val : (val > 0 ? '+' + Math.round(val * 100) + '%' : val)}`);
292:         }
293:       }
294:       const sourceSkill = getSkill(sk.id);
295:       const src = sourceSkill?.source || '?';
296:       let effectStr;
297:       if (effectParts.length > 0) {
298:         effectStr = effectParts.join(', ');
299:       } else if (sourceSkill?.reactive) {
300:         effectStr = 'reactive';
301:       } else if (sourceSkill?.type === 'passive') {
302:         effectStr = 'passive';
303:       } else {
304:         effectStr = 'active';
305:       }
306:       lines.push(`  ${sk.icon || '•'} ${act.memberName}: ${sk.name} [${src}] — ${effectStr}`);
307:     }
308:     lines.push('');
309:   }
310:   // Full combat event log (cached from sim before quest resolved)
311:   const events = pr.combatEvents || [];
312:   if (events.length > 0) {
313:     lines.push('── FULL COMBAT LOG ───────────────────────');
314:     for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
315:       const e = events[i];
316:       lines.push(`  [${String(i+1).padStart(3)}] ${e.icon} (${e.type.padEnd(10)}) ${e.text}`);
317:     }
318:     lines.push('');
319:   }
320:   // Rewards
321:   lines.push('── REWARDS ───────────────────────────────');
322:   if (result.success) {
323:     lines.push(`  Gold: +${result.goldEarned}g`);
324:     lines.push(`  Exp: +${result.expEarned} per member`);
325:     if (result.rankPoints) lines.push(`  Rank Points: +${result.rankPoints}`);
326:     if (result.loot?.length > 0) {
327:       lines.push('  Loot:');
328:       for (const d of result.loot) {
329:         const item = getItem(d.itemId);
330:         if (item) {
331:           const rarity = getItemRarity(item);
332:           const qty = d.quantity > 1 ? ` ×${d.quantity}` : '';
333:           const classReq = item.classReq ? ` (${item.classReq.map(c => CLASSES[c]?.label || c).join('/')})` : '';
334:           lines.push(`    - ${item.name}${qty} [${rarity?.label || '?'}]${classReq}`);
335:         }
336:       }
337:     }
338:   } else {
339:     lines.push(`  Exp (reduced): +${result.expEarned}`);
340:     lines.push('  Gold / Rank Points: None');
341:   }
342:   if (levelUps?.length > 0) {
343:     lines.push('');
344:     lines.push('── LEVEL UPS ─────────────────────────────');
345:     const byName = {};
346:     for (const lu of levelUps) {
347:       if (!byName[lu.name]) byName[lu.name] = [];
348:       byName[lu.name].push(lu.level);
349:     }
350:     for (const [name, levels] of Object.entries(byName)) {
351:       const from = Math.min(...levels) - 1;
352:       const to = Math.max(...levels);
353:       lines.push(`  ⭐ ${name} ${from} → ${to}`);
354:     }
355:   }
356:   // Secret boss
357:   if (result.secretBoss) {
358:     lines.push('');
359:     lines.push('── SECRET BOSS ───────────────────────────');
360:     lines.push(`  ${result.secretBoss.boss.icon} ${result.secretBoss.boss.name}: ${result.secretBoss.success ? 'DEFEATED' : 'ESCAPED'}`);
361:     if (result.secretBoss.success) {
362:       if (result.secretBoss.goldBonus) lines.push(`  Bonus Gold: +${result.secretBoss.goldBonus}g`);
363:       if (result.secretBoss.expBonus) lines.push(`  Bonus Exp: +${result.secretBoss.expBonus}`);
364:     }
365:   }
366:   lines.push('');
367:   lines.push('═══════════════════════════════════════════');
368:   lines.push(`Exported at: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`);
369:   lines.push(`Guild Rank: ${s.guild.rank}  |  Gold: ${s.gold}g`);
370:   lines.push('═══════════════════════════════════════════');
371:   return lines.join('\n');
372: }
373: export function showResultsModal() {
374:   const pr = Game.state.pendingResults;
375:   if (!pr) return;
376:   if (pr.quest.towerRun) {
377:     showTowerResultsModal(pr);
378:     return;
379:   }
380:   const { quest, result, levelUps, rankUp, synergyUnlocks, skillGains, combatStats } = pr;
381:   const s = Game.state;
382:   let rewardsHtml = '';
383:   if (result.success) {
384:     const lootItems = result.loot.map(d => `<div class="result-loot-entry">${formatLootEntry(d)}</div>`).join('');
385:     rewardsHtml = `
386:       <div class="result-section">
387:         <div class="result-section-title">Rewards</div>
388:         <div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Gold earned</span><span class="result-row-value result-gold">+${result.goldEarned}g</span></div>
389:         <div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Exp per member</span><span class="result-row-value result-exp">+${result.expEarned}</span></div>
390:         ${result.rankPoints ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Rank points</span><span class="result-row-value result-rank">+${result.rankPoints}</span></div>` : ''}
391:         ${result.loot.length > 0 ? `<div class="result-loot-section"><div class="result-row-label">Loot</div>${lootItems}</div>` : ''}
392:       </div>
393:     `;
394:   } else {
395:     rewardsHtml = `
396:       <div class="result-section">
397:         <div class="result-section-title">Consolation</div>
398:         ${result.expEarned > 0 ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Exp (reduced)</span><span class="result-row-value result-exp">+${result.expEarned}</span></div>` : ''}
399:         <div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Gold / Rank Points</span><span class="result-row-value" style="color:var(--red)">None</span></div>
400:       </div>
401:     `;
402:   }
403:   // Consolidate level-ups: one row per character showing startLevel → endLevel
404:   let levelUpHtml = '';
405:   if (levelUps.length > 0) {
406:     const byName = {};
407:     for (const lu of levelUps) {
408:       if (!byName[lu.name]) byName[lu.name] = { name: lu.name, levels: [] };
409:       byName[lu.name].levels.push(lu.level);
410:     }
411:     const entries = Object.values(byName).map(entry => {
412:       const startLvl = Math.min(...entry.levels) - 1;
413:       const endLvl = Math.max(...entry.levels);
414:       return `<div class="result-levelup-entry"><span class="levelup-name">⭐ ${esc(entry.name)}</span><span class="levelup-levels">${startLvl} → ${endLvl}</span></div>`;
415:     }).join('');
416:     levelUpHtml = `
417:       <div class="result-levelup-section">
418:         <div class="levelup-title">Level Up!</div>
419:         ${entries}
420:       </div>
421:     `;
422:   }
423:   const skillGainHtml = skillGains && skillGains.length > 0 ? skillGains.map(sg => {
424:     const verb = sg.type === 'mastery' ? 'gained mastery' : 'learned skill';
425:     return `<div class="result-skill-gain">${sg.skillIcon} ${esc(sg.memberName)} ${verb}: <strong>${esc(sg.skillName)}</strong>!</div>`;
426:   }).join('') : '';
427:   const synergyHtml = synergyUnlocks && synergyUnlocks.length > 0 ? `
428:     <div class="result-synergy-unlocks">
429:       <div class="synergy-unlock-title">🔗 Party Synergy</div>
430:       ${synergyUnlocks.map(su =>
431:         `<div class="synergy-unlock-entry"><span class="synergy-unlock-label">${su.label}</span><span class="synergy-unlock-desc">${su.desc}</span></div>`
432:       ).join('')}
433:     </div>
434:   ` : '';
435:   // ── Battle Highlights — extracted from combat events ──
436:   const highlightsHtml = (() => {
437:     const events = pr.combatEvents || [];
438:     if (events.length === 0) return '';
439:     // Parse damage numbers from event text (matches <span class="dmg-num ...">123</span> or plain numbers)
440:     function extractDmg(text) {
441:       // Try HTML span first
442:       const m = text.match(/class="dmg-num[^"]*">\s*(\d[\d,]*)/);
443:       if (m) return parseInt(m[1].replace(/,/g, ''), 10);
444:       // Fallback: last number in text after a dash or "for"
445:       const nums = text.match(/(?:—|for)\s*(\d[\d,]*)/g);
446:       if (nums) {
447:         const last = nums[nums.length - 1].match(/(\d[\d,]*)/);
448:         if (last) return parseInt(last[1].replace(/,/g, ''), 10);
449:       }
450:       return 0;
451:     }
452:     // Extract name from start of event text (before "attacks", "activates", etc.)
453:     function extractName(text) {
454:       // Strip HTML tags, decode common entities, remove stray angle brackets
455:       const clean = text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
456:         .replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
457:         .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
458:         .replace(/[<>]/g, '');
459:       const m = clean.match(/^([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)?)/);
460:       return m ? m[1] : null;
461:     }
462:     let biggestHit = { name: null, dmg: 0, type: '', text: '' };
463:     let biggestHeal = { name: null, amt: 0, text: '' };
464:     let biggestBlock = { name: null, dmg: 0, text: '' };
465:     const kills = {};   // memberName → count
466:     const dodges = {};   // memberName → count
467:     const crits = {};    // memberName → count
468:     let totalDodges = 0;
469:     let totalCrits = 0;
470:     for (const e of events) {
471:       const dmg = extractDmg(e.text);
472:       const name = extractName(e.text);
473:       // Biggest single hit (party attacks/skills/crits)
474:       if (['attack', 'magic', 'crit', 'skill', 'celestial', 'equip'].includes(e.type) && dmg > biggestHit.dmg) {
475:         biggestHit = { name, dmg, type: e.type, text: e.text };
476:       }
477:       if (e.type === 'heal' && dmg > biggestHeal.amt) {
478:         biggestHeal = { name, amt: dmg, text: e.text };
479:       }
480:       if (e.type === 'cover' && dmg > biggestBlock.dmg) {
481:         biggestBlock = { name, dmg, text: e.text };
482:       }
483:       if (e.type === 'defeat' && name) {
484:         const clean = e.text.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
485:           .replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
486:           .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;/g, "'").replace(/[<>]/g, '');
487:         const killer = clean.match(/([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)?)\s+(?:delivers|defeats|strikes)/);
488:         if (killer) kills[killer[1]] = (kills[killer[1]] || 0) + 1;
489:       }
490:       // Dodge tracking
491:       if (e.type === 'dodge') {
492:         totalDodges++;
493:         if (name) dodges[name] = (dodges[name] || 0) + 1;
494:       }
495:       if (e.type === 'crit') {
496:         totalCrits++;
497:         if (name) crits[name] = (crits[name] || 0) + 1;
498:       }
499:     }
500:     const highlights = [];
501:     if (biggestHit.dmg > 0) {
502:       const critTag = biggestHit.type === 'crit' ? ' CRIT' : '';
503:       highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">💥</span><span class="highlight-label">Biggest Hit</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(biggestHit.name)} — <strong>${biggestHit.dmg}${critTag}</strong></span></div>`);
504:     }
505:     if (biggestHeal.amt > 0) {
506:       highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">💚</span><span class="highlight-label">Biggest Heal</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(biggestHeal.name)} — <strong>+${biggestHeal.amt} HP</strong></span></div>`);
507:     }
508:     if (biggestBlock.dmg > 0) {
509:       highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">🛡</span><span class="highlight-label">Biggest Block</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(biggestBlock.name)} — <strong>${biggestBlock.dmg} absorbed</strong></span></div>`);
510:     }
511:     // Top killer
512:     const topKiller = Object.entries(kills).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
513:     if (topKiller && topKiller[1] > 0) {
514:       highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">☠</span><span class="highlight-label">Most Kills</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(topKiller[0])} — <strong>${topKiller[1]} kills</strong></span></div>`);
515:     }
516:     // Top critter
517:     if (totalCrits > 0) {
518:       const topCrit = Object.entries(crits).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
519:       if (topCrit) {
520:         highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">⚡</span><span class="highlight-label">Crit Machine</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(topCrit[0])} — <strong>${topCrit[1]} crits</strong></span></div>`);
521:       }
522:     }
523:     // Dodges
524:     if (totalDodges > 0) {
525:       const topDodge = Object.entries(dodges).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
526:       if (topDodge) {
527:         highlights.push(`<div class="highlight-row"><span class="highlight-icon">💨</span><span class="highlight-label">Untouchable</span><span class="highlight-value">${esc(topDodge[0])} — <strong>${topDodge[1]} dodge${topDodge[1] > 1 ? 's' : ''}</strong></span></div>`);
528:       }
529:     }
530:     if (highlights.length === 0) return '';
531:     return `<div class="result-section">
532:       <div class="result-section-title">Battle Highlights</div>
533:       ${highlights.join('')}
534:     </div>`;
535:   })();
536:   // Combat stats section
537:   const combatStatsHtml = combatStats && combatStats.length > 0 ? (() => {
538:     const maxDmg = Math.max(1, ...combatStats.map(c => c.dmgDealt));
539:     const rows = combatStats.map(c => {
540:       const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
541:       const sigil = cls ? cls.sigil : '?';
542:       const dmgPct = Math.round((c.dmgDealt / maxDmg) * 100);
543:       return `<div class="cs-row">
544:         <div class="cs-name">${sigil} ${esc(c.name.split(' ')[0])}</div>
545:         <div class="cs-bar-wrap">
546:           <div class="cs-bar" style="width:${dmgPct}%"></div>
547:           <span class="cs-dmg-val">${c.dmgDealt}</span>
548:         </div>
549:       </div>`;
550:     }).join('');
551:     return `<div class="result-section">
552:       <div class="result-section-title">Damage Dealt</div>
553:       <div class="cs-header"><span>Member</span><span>Damage</span></div>
554:       ${rows}
555:     </div>`;
556:   })() : '';
557:   // Defense & Support table (mitigation, absorption, reflect, dodge)
558:   const defStatsHtml = combatStats && combatStats.length > 0 ? (() => {
559:     const defTotal = c => (c.dmgMitigated||0) + (c.dmgAbsorbed||0) + (c.dmgReflected||0) + (c.dmgDodged||0);
560:     const hasAny = combatStats.some(c => defTotal(c) > 0);
561:     if (!hasAny) return '';
562:     const sorted = [...combatStats].filter(c => defTotal(c) > 0).sort((a, b) => defTotal(b) - defTotal(a));
563:     const maxMit = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.dmgMitigated || 0));
564:     const maxAbs = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.dmgAbsorbed || 0));
565:     const maxRef = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.dmgReflected || 0));
566:     const maxDodge = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.dmgDodged || 0));
567:     const tableRows = sorted.map(c => {
568:       const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
569:       const sigil = cls ? cls.sigil : '?';
570:       const total = defTotal(c);
571:       const hi = (val, max) => val > 0 && val === max ? ' class="ds-best"' : '';
572:       const cell = (val, max) => `<td${hi(val, max)}>${val > 0 ? val.toLocaleString() : '—'}</td>`;
573:       return `<tr>
574:         <td class="ds-name">${sigil} ${esc(c.name.split(' ')[0])}</td>
575:         ${cell(c.dmgMitigated||0, maxMit)}
576:         ${cell(c.dmgAbsorbed||0, maxAbs)}
577:         ${cell(c.dmgReflected||0, maxRef)}
578:         ${cell(c.dmgDodged||0, maxDodge)}
579:         <td class="ds-total">${total.toLocaleString()}</td>
580:       </tr>`;
581:     }).join('');
582:     return `<div class="result-section">
583:       <div class="result-section-title">Defense & Support</div>
584:       <table class="ds-table">
585:         <thead><tr>
586:           <th>Member</th><th>🛡 Mitigated</th><th>🏰 Absorbed</th><th>💜 Reflected</th><th>💨 Dodged</th><th>Total</th>
587:         </tr></thead>
588:         <tbody>${tableRows}</tbody>
589:       </table>
590:     </div>`;
591:   })() : '';
592:   // Healing & Damage Taken table
593:   const healStatsHtml = combatStats && combatStats.length > 0 ? (() => {
594:     const hasAny = combatStats.some(c => (c.healingDone||0) > 0 || (c.healingReceived||0) > 0 || (c.dmgTaken||0) > 0);
595:     if (!hasAny) return '';
596:     const sorted = [...combatStats]
597:       .filter(c => (c.healingDone||0) > 0 || (c.healingReceived||0) > 0 || (c.dmgTaken||0) > 0)
598:       .sort((a, b) => ((b.healingDone||0) + (b.healingReceived||0)) - ((a.healingDone||0) + (a.healingReceived||0)));
599:     const maxHealD = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.healingDone || 0));
600:     const maxHealR = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.healingReceived || 0));
601:     const maxTaken = Math.max(...sorted.map(c => c.dmgTaken || 0));
602:     const tableRows = sorted.map(c => {
603:       const cls = CLASSES[c.class];
604:       const sigil = cls ? cls.sigil : '?';
605:       const hi = (val, max) => val > 0 && val === max ? ' class="ds-best"' : '';
606:       const cell = (val, max) => `<td${hi(val, max)}>${val > 0 ? val.toLocaleString() : '—'}</td>`;
607:       return `<tr>
608:         <td class="ds-name">${sigil} ${esc(c.name.split(' ')[0])}</td>
609:         ${cell(c.healingDone||0, maxHealD)}
610:         ${cell(c.healingReceived||0, maxHealR)}
611:         <td class="ds-taken${(c.dmgTaken||0) > 0 && (c.dmgTaken||0) === maxTaken ? ' ds-best' : ''}">${(c.dmgTaken||0) > 0 ? (c.dmgTaken||0).toLocaleString() : '—'}</td>
612:       </tr>`;
613:     }).join('');
614:     return `<div class="result-section">
615:       <div class="result-section-title">Healing & Damage Taken</div>
616:       <table class="ds-table">
617:         <thead><tr>
618:           <th>Member</th><th>⚕ Healed</th><th>💚 Received</th><th>💔 Taken</th>
619:         </tr></thead>
620:         <tbody>${tableRows}</tbody>
621:       </table>
622:     </div>`;
623:   })() : '';
624:   // Secret boss section
625:   const secretBossHtml = result.secretBoss ? `
626:     <div class="result-section">
627:       <div class="result-section-title" style="color:var(--gold)">Secret Boss Encounter!</div>

632:         </span>
633:       </div>
634:       ${result.secretBoss.success && result.secretBoss.goldBonus > 0 ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Bonus Gold</span><span class="result-row-value result-gold">+${result.secretBoss.goldBonus}g</span></div>` : ''}
635:       ${result.secretBoss.success && result.secretBoss.expBonus > 0 ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Bonus Exp</span><span class="result-row-value result-exp">+${result.secretBoss.expBonus}</span></div>` : ''}
636:       ${result.secretBoss.success && result.secretBoss.classReward ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">${result.secretBoss.recipientName}</span><span class="result-row-value" style="color:var(--gold)">Gained ${result.secretBoss.classReward.name}!</span></div>` : ''}
637:     </div>
638:   ` : '';
639:   const rankUpHtml = rankUp ? `
640:     <div class="result-rank-up">

643:       <div class="rank-up-badges">

647:       </div>

649:     </div>
650:   ` : '';
651:   const powerPct = Math.round(result.ratio * 100);
652:   const powerColor = result.ratio >= 1.2 ? 'var(--green)' : result.ratio >= 0.8 ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--red)';
653:   document.getElementById('results-content').innerHTML = `

738:         const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
739:         particleBurst(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2, {
740:           count: 14, colors: ['#f0c060', '#ffe066', '#ffcc33'], spread: 50, duration: 800
````
