````javascript
746: function showTowerResultsModal(pr) {
747:   const { quest, result, levelUps, rankUp, synergyUnlocks, skillGains } = pr;
748:   const floorsCleared = result.towerFloor || quest.towerFloor || 0;
749:   const bestFloor = result.bestFloor || 0;
750:   const isNewRecord = floorsCleared >= bestFloor && floorsCleared > 0;
751:   const voluntary = result.success;
752:   const outcomeLabel = voluntary ? 'Tower Run Complete' : 'Party Defeated';
753:   const outcomeClass = voluntary ? 'success' : 'failure';
754:   const lootItems = (result.loot || []).map(d => `<div class="result-loot-entry">${formatLootEntry(d)}</div>`).join('');
755:   // Rewards section
756:   const rewardsHtml = `
757:     <div class="result-section">
758:       <div class="result-section-title">Tower Rewards</div>
759:       <div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Gold earned</span><span class="result-row-value result-gold">+${result.goldEarned.toLocaleString()}g</span></div>
760:       <div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Exp per member</span><span class="result-row-value result-exp">+${result.expEarned.toLocaleString()}</span></div>
761:       ${result.rankPoints ? `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-row-label">Rank points</span><span class="result-row-value result-rank">+${result.rankPoints.toLocaleString()}</span></div>` : ''}
762:       ${result.loot && result.loot.length > 0 ? `<div class="result-loot-section"><div class="result-row-label">Loot</div>${lootItems}</div>` : ''}
763:     </div>
764:   `;
765:   // Level ups
766:   let levelUpHtml = '';
767:   if (levelUps && levelUps.length > 0) {
768:     const byName = {};
769:     for (const lu of levelUps) {
770:       if (!byName[lu.name]) byName[lu.name] = { name: lu.name, levels: [] };
771:       byName[lu.name].levels.push(lu.level);
772:     }
````

````javascript
176: function calculatePreviewRewards(floorsCleared) {
177:   let totalGold = 0;
178:   let totalExp = 0;
179:   for (let f = 1; f <= floorsCleared; f++) {
180:     totalGold += TOWER_CONFIG.GOLD_PER_FLOOR.base + (f * TOWER_CONFIG.GOLD_PER_FLOOR.scale);
181:     totalExp += TOWER_CONFIG.EXP_PER_FLOOR.base + (f * TOWER_CONFIG.EXP_PER_FLOOR.scale);
182:   }
183:   const rankPoints = Math.floor(floorsCleared * 500 + Math.pow(floorsCleared, 1.5) * 100);
184:   return { gold: totalGold, exp: totalExp, rankPoints };
185: }
186: export function tickUpdateTower() {
187:   const tower = Game.getTowerState();
188:   if (!tower || !tower.active) return;
189:   const container = document.getElementById('tab-tower');
190:   if (!container) return;
191:   const currentFloorEl = container.querySelector('.tower-floor-number');
192:   if (currentFloorEl) {
193:     const displayedFloor = currentFloorEl.textContent;
194:     const actualFloor = `Floor ${tower.active.floor}`;
195:     if (displayedFloor !== actualFloor || tower.active.atRest) {
196:       renderTower();
197:     }
198:   }
199: }
````

````javascript
245:           spotlight.style.width = (rect.width + pad * 2) + 'px';
246:           spotlight.style.height = (rect.height + pad * 2) + 'px';
247:         }
248:       }

251: }
252: function _stopChecking() {
````

````javascript
 109:     const hpRatio = (stats.hp || baseMaxHp) / baseMaxHp;

 125:       if (partyAuras.atk)   stats.atk   = Math.floor((stats.atk || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.atk));
 126:       if (partyAuras.def)   stats.def   = Math.floor((stats.def || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.def));
 127:       if (partyAuras.mag)   stats.mag   = Math.floor((stats.mag || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.mag));
 128:       if (partyAuras.spd)   stats.spd   = Math.floor((stats.spd || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.spd));
 129:       if (partyAuras.crit)  stats.crit  = Math.floor((stats.crit || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.crit));
 130:       if (partyAuras.dodge) stats.dodge = Math.floor((stats.dodge || 0) * (1 + partyAuras.dodge));
 131:       if (partyAuras.maxHp) {
 132:         stats.maxHp = Math.floor((stats.maxHp || 100) * (1 + partyAuras.maxHp));
 133:       }
 134:     }
 135:     stats.hp = Math.min(Math.round(hpRatio * stats.maxHp), stats.maxHp);
 136:     return stats;
 137:   }
 138:   function memberPower(member) {
 139:     const s = effectiveStats(member);
 140:     return (s.atk * 2) + s.def + s.spd + Math.floor((s.maxHp || 50) / 10) + (s.mag * 1.5) + (s.crit || 0) + Math.floor((s.dodge || 0) * 0.5);
 141:   }
 142:   function expToNext(level) {
 143:     return Math.floor(100 * Math.pow(level, 1.5));
 144:   }
 145:   function save() {
 146:     if (!state) return;
 147:     state.lastSaved = Date.now();
 148:     try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch(e) {}
 149:   }
 150:   function load() {
 151:     try {
 152:       const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
 153:       if (!raw) return false;
 154:       const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 155:       if (parsed.version !== 1) return false;
 156:       state = parsed;
 157:       if ((state.partyExpansions || 0) > PARTY_EXPANSION_COSTS.length) {
 158:         state.partyExpansions = PARTY_EXPANSION_COSTS.length;
 159:       }
 160:       const maxSlots = getMaxPartySize();
 161:       if (state.activeSlots && state.activeSlots.length > maxSlots) {
 162:         state.activeSlots = state.activeSlots.slice(0, maxSlots);
 163:       }
 164:       const dedupeSkills = (member) => {
 165:         if (!member || !member.skills) return;
 166:         member.skills = [...new Set(member.skills)];
 167:       };
 168:       dedupeSkills(state.player);
 169:       if (state.party) state.party.forEach(m => dedupeSkills(m));
 170:       const RETIRED_CLASS_SKILL_IDS = new Set([
 171:         'KI_BARRIER', 'INNER_FOCUS', 'COUNTER_STANCE', 'DARK_PACT',
 172:       ]);
 173:       const stripRetiredSkills = (member) => {
 174:         if (!member || !member.skills) return;
 175:         member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => !RETIRED_CLASS_SKILL_IDS.has(id));
 176:       };
 177:       stripRetiredSkills(state.player);
 178:       if (state.party) state.party.forEach(m => stripRetiredSkills(m));
 179:       const stripDeadSkills = (member) => {
 180:         if (!member || !member.skills) return;
 181:         member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => getSkill(id) != null);
 182:       };
 183:       stripDeadSkills(state.player);
 184:       if (state.party) state.party.forEach(m => stripDeadSkills(m));
 185:       const reconcileEquipmentSkills = (member) => {
 186:         if (!member || !member.equipment) return;
 187:         if (!member.skills) member.skills = [];
 188:         for (const slot of Object.keys(member.equipment)) {
 189:           const itemId = member.equipment[slot];
 190:           if (!itemId) continue;
 191:           const item = getItem(itemId);
 192:           if (!item) continue;
 193:           const grants = [].concat(item.grantedSkill || [], item.grantedSkills || []);
 194:           for (const sk of grants) {
 195:             if (sk && getSkill(sk) && !member.skills.includes(sk)) {
 196:               member.skills.push(sk);
 197:             }
 198:           }
 199:         }
 200:       };
 201:       reconcileEquipmentSkills(state.player);
 202:       if (state.party) state.party.forEach(m => reconcileEquipmentSkills(m));
 203:       const reconcileClassSkills = (member) => {
 204:         if (!member || !member.class) return;
 205:         if (!member.skills) member.skills = [];
 206:         member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => {
 207:           const sk = getSkill(id);
 208:           if (!sk) return true;
 209:           return sk.source !== 'legacy' && sk.type !== 'legacy';
 210:         });
 211:         const shouldHave = getUnlockedClassSkills(member.class, member.level || 1);
 212:         for (const sk of shouldHave) {
 213:           if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) member.skills.push(sk.id);
 214:         }
 215:         const shouldHaveMasteries = getUnlockedClassMasteries(member.class, member.level || 1);
 216:         for (const sk of shouldHaveMasteries) {
 217:           if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) member.skills.push(sk.id);
 218:         }
 219:         applyHeroSpecReplacement(member);
 220:         if (member.class === 'HERO' && member.heroSpec) {
 221:           const specUnlocks = getUnlockedSpecSkills(member.heroSpec, member.level || 1);
 222:           for (const sk of specUnlocks) {
 223:             if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) member.skills.push(sk.id);
 224:           }
 225:         }
 226:       };
 227:       reconcileClassSkills(state.player);
 228:       if (state.party) state.party.forEach(m => reconcileClassSkills(m));
 229:       if (!state.tower) state.tower = getDefaultTowerState();
 230:       if (!state.guildLegacy) state.guildLegacy = { overflowRP: 0, level: 0, talents: [] };
 231:       if (!state.guildLegacy.talents) state.guildLegacy.talents = [];
 232:       if (state.guildLegacy.level > LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP) {
 233:         state.guildLegacy.level = LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP;
 234:         state.guildLegacy.overflowRP = 0;
 235:       }
 236:       if (state.guild.activeQuest && !state.guild.activeQuest.eventCount
 237:           && state.guild.activeQuest.startedAt < Date.now() - 60000) {
 238:         state.guild.activeQuest = null;
 239:       }
 240:       if (!state.tutorial) state.tutorial = { step: 0, dismissed: true };
 241:       return true;
 242:     } catch(e) { return false; }
 243:   }
 244:   function hasSave() {
 245:     return !!localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
 246:   }
 247:   function deleteSave() {
 248:     localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
 249:     state = null;
 250:   }
 251:   function exportSave() {
 252:     if (!state) return null;
 253:     save();
 254:     const data = JSON.stringify(state);
 255:     const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'application/json' });
 256:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 257:     const a = document.createElement('a');
 258:     a.href = url;
 259:     const guildName = state.guild?.name || 'adventurers-guild';
 260:     const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
 261:     a.download = `${guildName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_${date}.json`;
 262:     document.body.appendChild(a);
 263:     a.click();
 264:     document.body.removeChild(a);
 265:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
 266:     return { ok: true };
 267:   }
 268:   function importSave(jsonString) {
 269:     try {
 270:       const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
 271:       if (!parsed.version || !parsed.guild || !parsed.party) {
 272:         return { ok: false, reason: 'Invalid save file — missing required data' };
 273:       }
 274:       if (parsed.version > 1) {
 275:         return { ok: false, reason: `Save is from a newer game version (v${parsed.version}). Update the game first.` };
 276:       }
 277:       const backup = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
 278:       localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, jsonString);
 279:       const success = load();
 280:       if (!success) {
 281:         if (backup) localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, backup);
 282:         else localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
 283:         return { ok: false, reason: 'Save file failed validation' };
 284:       }
 285:       save();
 286:       return { ok: true, guildName: state.guild?.name, guildRank: state.guild?.rank };
 287:     } catch (e) {
 288:       return { ok: false, reason: 'Could not parse save file — is it valid JSON?' };
 289:     }
 290:   }
 291:   function logEvent(text) {
 292:     state.guild.eventLog.unshift({ text, time: Date.now() });
 293:     if (state.guild.eventLog.length > 20) state.guild.eventLog.pop();
 294:   }
 295:   const LEGACY_RP_PER_LEVEL = 50000;
 296:   const LEGACY_BONUSES = {
 297:     goldBonus:      0.02,
 298:     itemFind:       0.01,
 299:     celestialBonus: 0.005,
 300:     expBonus:       0.01,
 301:   };
 302:   function addRankPoints(points) {
 303:     if (!points) return null;
 304:     const legacyAtCap = (state.guildLegacy?.level || 0) >= LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP;
 305:     const ri0 = rankIndex(state.guild.rank);
 306:     const atMaxRank = ri0 >= RANK_ORDER.length - 1 && RANK_THRESHOLDS[state.guild.rank] === null;
 307:     if (legacyAtCap && atMaxRank) {
 308:       return null;
 309:     }
 310:     state.guild.rankPoints += points;
 311:     let oldRank = null;
 312:     let newRank = null;
 313:     let ri = rankIndex(state.guild.rank);
 314:     while (ri < RANK_ORDER.length - 1) {
 315:       const threshold = RANK_THRESHOLDS[state.guild.rank];
 316:       if (threshold && state.guild.rankPoints >= threshold) {
 317:         if (!oldRank) oldRank = state.guild.rank;
 318:         state.guild.rankPoints -= threshold;
 319:         ri++;
 320:         state.guild.rank = RANK_ORDER[ri];
 321:         newRank = state.guild.rank;
 322:         logEvent(`Guild rank advanced to ${state.guild.rank} Rank!`);
 323:       } else break;
 324:     }
 325:     if (ri >= RANK_ORDER.length - 1 && RANK_THRESHOLDS[state.guild.rank] === null) {
 326:       if (!state.guildLegacy) state.guildLegacy = { overflowRP: 0, level: 0 };
 327:       state.guildLegacy.overflowRP += state.guild.rankPoints;
 328:       state.guild.rankPoints = 0;
 329:       const oldLevel = state.guildLegacy.level;
 330:       while (state.guildLegacy.level < LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP && state.guildLegacy.overflowRP >= LEGACY_RP_PER_LEVEL) {
 331:         state.guildLegacy.overflowRP -= LEGACY_RP_PER_LEVEL;
 332:         state.guildLegacy.level++;
 333:         logEvent(`Guild Legacy advanced to Level ${state.guildLegacy.level}!`);
 334:         if (state.guildLegacy.level >= LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP) {
 335:           logEvent(`Guild Legacy has reached its MAX level of ${LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP}!`);
 336:         }
 337:       }
 338:       if (state.guildLegacy.level >= LEGACY_LEVEL_CAP) {
 339:         state.guildLegacy.overflowRP = 0;
 340:       }
 341:     }
 342:     return oldRank && newRank ? { from: oldRank, to: newRank } : null;
 343:   }
 344:   function getLegacyBonuses() {

 348:       itemFind:       lvl * LEGACY_BONUSES.itemFind,
 349:       celestialBonus: lvl * LEGACY_BONUSES.celestialBonus,
 350:       expBonus:       lvl * LEGACY_BONUSES.expBonus,
 351:       level:          lvl,
 352:     };
 353:   }

 390:     const lvl = state.guildLegacy?.level || 0;

 394:   function canPurchaseTalent(talentId) {
 395:     const t = LEGACY_TALENTS[talentId];
 396:     if (!t) return { ok: false, reason: 'Unknown talent.' };
 397:     const lvl = state.guildLegacy?.level || 0;
 398:     if (lvl < t.reqLevel) return { ok: false, reason: `Requires Legacy Level ${t.reqLevel}.` };
 399:     const { available } = getLegacyTalentPoints();
 400:     if (available < t.cost) return { ok: false, reason: `Need ${t.cost} talent points (${available} available).` };
 401:     if ((state.guildLegacy?.talents || []).includes(talentId)) return { ok: false, reason: 'Already purchased.' };
 402:     return { ok: true };
 403:   }
 404:   function purchaseTalent(talentId) {
 405:     const check = canPurchaseTalent(talentId);
 406:     if (!check.ok) return check;
 407:     if (!state.guildLegacy.talents) state.guildLegacy.talents = [];
 408:     state.guildLegacy.talents.push(talentId);
 409:     logEvent(`Talent unlocked: ${LEGACY_TALENTS[talentId].label}!`);
 410:     save();
 411:     return { ok: true };
 412:   }

 422:   function addExp(memberId, amount) {
 423:     const member = memberId === 'player' ? state.player : state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId);
 424:     if (!member) return { levelUps: [], skillGains: [] };
 425:     if (member.level >= PLAYER_LEVEL_CAP) {
 426:       member.exp = 0;
 427:       return { levelUps: [], skillGains: [] };
 428:     }
 429:     member.exp += amount;
 430:     const levelUps = [];
 431:     const skillGains = [];
 432:     while (member.level < PLAYER_LEVEL_CAP && member.exp >= expToNext(member.level)) {
 433:       member.exp -= expToNext(member.level);
 434:       member.level++;
 435:       const newStats = computeStats(member.class, member.level);
 436:       const hpGain = newStats.maxHp - member.stats.maxHp;
 437:       for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(newStats)) {
 438:         if (k !== 'hp') member.stats[k] = v;
 439:       }
 440:       member.stats.hp = Math.min(member.stats.maxHp, member.stats.hp + Math.max(0, hpGain));
 441:       const newSkill = getUnlockedClassSkills(member.class, member.level).find(s => !member.skills.includes(s.id));
 442:       const skipBaseline = newSkill && member.class === 'HERO' && member.heroSpec && HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS.includes(newSkill.id);
 443:       if (newSkill && !skipBaseline && !member.skills.includes(newSkill.id)) {
 444:         member.skills.push(newSkill.id);
 445:         logEvent(`${member.name} learned skill: ${newSkill.name}!`);
 446:         skillGains.push({ memberName: member.name, skillName: newSkill.name, skillIcon: newSkill.icon || '⚡', type: 'skill' });
 447:       }
 448:       const newMastery = getUnlockedClassMasteries(member.class, member.level).find(s => !member.skills.includes(s.id));
 449:       if (newMastery && !member.skills.includes(newMastery.id)) {
 450:         member.skills.push(newMastery.id);
 451:         logEvent(`${member.name} gained mastery: ${newMastery.name}!`);
 452:         skillGains.push({ memberName: member.name, skillName: newMastery.name, skillIcon: newMastery.icon || '🔶', type: 'mastery' });
 453:       }
 454:       if (member.class === 'HERO' && member.heroSpec) {
 455:         const newSpec = getUnlockedSpecSkills(member.heroSpec, member.level).find(s => !member.skills.includes(s.id));
 456:         if (newSpec && !member.skills.includes(newSpec.id)) {
 457:           member.skills.push(newSpec.id);
 458:           logEvent(`${member.name} learned spec skill: ${newSpec.name}!`);
 459:           skillGains.push({ memberName: member.name, skillName: newSpec.name, skillIcon: newSpec.icon || '⚔', type: 'spec' });
 460:         }
 461:       }
 462:       levelUps.push({ name: member.name, level: member.level });
 463:     }
 464:     if (member.level >= PLAYER_LEVEL_CAP) member.exp = 0;
 465:     return { levelUps, skillGains };
 466:   }
 467:   function addToInventory(itemId, qty = 1) {
 468:     const entry = state.inventory.find(e => e.itemId === itemId);
 469:     if (entry) entry.quantity += qty;
 470:     else state.inventory.push({ itemId, quantity: qty });
 471:   }
 472:   function removeFromInventory(itemId, qty = 1) {
 473:     const idx = state.inventory.findIndex(e => e.itemId === itemId);
 474:     if (idx === -1) return false;
 475:     if (state.inventory[idx].quantity < qty) return false;
 476:     state.inventory[idx].quantity -= qty;
 477:     if (state.inventory[idx].quantity === 0) state.inventory.splice(idx, 1);
 478:     return true;
 479:   }
 480:   function healTick(secondsElapsed) {
 481:     if (state.pendingResults) return;
 482:     const onQuestIds = new Set();
 483:     if (state.guild.activeQuest) {
 484:       for (const snap of state.guild.activeQuest.partySnapshot) onQuestIds.add(snap.id);
 485:     }
 486:     const healPct = (120 / 60) * secondsElapsed / 100;
 487:     const heal = (m) => {
 488:       if (onQuestIds.has(m.id)) return;
 489:       const eff = effectiveStats(m);
 490:       if (m.stats.hp < eff.maxHp) {
 491:         const amount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(eff.maxHp * healPct));
 492:         m.stats.hp = Math.min(eff.maxHp, m.stats.hp + amount);
 493:       }
 494:     };
 495:     heal(state.player);
 496:     state.party.forEach(heal);
 497:   }
 498:   function recruitMember(classId) {
 499:     const cls = getClass(classId);
 500:     if (!cls.recruitCost) return { ok:false, reason:'Cannot recruit this class' };
 501:     if (state.party.length >= 8) return { ok:false, reason:'Roster full (max 8 members)' };
 502:     const cost = getRecruitCost(state.party.length);
 503:     if (state.gold < cost) return { ok:false, reason:`Need ${cost}g (have ${state.gold}g)` };
 504:     state.gold -= cost;
 505:     const stats = computeStats(classId, 1);
 506:     for (const k of Object.keys(stats)) {
 507:       if (k === 'hp') continue;
 508:       stats[k] = Math.max(1, Math.round(stats[k] * (1 + (Math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1))));
 509:     }
 510:     stats.hp = stats.maxHp;
 511:     const starterSkills = getUnlockedClassSkills(classId, 1).map(s => s.id);
 512:     const member = {
 513:       id: `m${state.nextMemberId++}`,
 514:       name: randomName(classId, state.party),
 515:       class: classId,
 516:       level: 1, exp: 0,
 517:       stats,
 518:       equipment: { weapon:null, armor:null, accessory:null, offhand:null },
 519:       skills: starterSkills,
 520:       questsCompleted: 0,
 521:     };
 522:     state.party.push(member);
 523:     logEvent(`${member.name} the ${cls.label} has joined!`);
 524:     return { ok:true, member };
 525:   }
 526:   function dismissMember(memberId) {
 527:     const idx = state.party.findIndex(m => m.id === memberId);
 528:     if (idx === -1) return { ok:false, reason:'Member not found' };
 529:     if (state.guild.activeQuest) return { ok:false, reason:'Cannot dismiss while party is on a quest' };
 530:     state.activeSlots = state.activeSlots.filter(id => id !== memberId);
 531:     state.party.splice(idx, 1);
 532:     return { ok:true };
 533:   }
 534:   function setActive(memberId, active) {
 535:     if (active) {
 536:       if (state.activeSlots.includes(memberId)) return { ok:false, reason:'Already active' };
 537:       const maxSize = getMaxPartySize();
 538:       if (state.activeSlots.length >= maxSize) return { ok:false, reason:`Active party full (max ${maxSize})` };
 539:       if (!state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId)) return { ok:false, reason:'Member not found' };
 540:       state.activeSlots.push(memberId);
 541:     } else {
 542:       state.activeSlots = state.activeSlots.filter(id => id !== memberId);
 543:     }
 544:     return { ok:true };
 545:   }
 546:   function setHeroSpec(memberId, specTrack) {
 547:     const member = memberId === 'player' ? state.player : state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId);
 548:     if (!member) return { ok: false, reason: 'Member not found' };
 549:     if (member.class !== 'HERO') return { ok: false, reason: 'Only Heroes can specialize' };
 550:     if (member.level < 10) return { ok: false, reason: 'Must be level 10 to specialize' };
 551:     if (member.heroSpec) return { ok: false, reason: 'Already specialized. Use respec to change.' };
 552:     if (!HERO_SPECS[specTrack]) return { ok: false, reason: 'Invalid specialization track' };
 553:     member.heroSpec = specTrack;
 554:     const specSkills = getUnlockedSpecSkills(specTrack, member.level);
 555:     for (const sk of specSkills) {
 556:       if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) {
 557:         member.skills.push(sk.id);
 558:         logEvent(`${member.name} learned spec skill: ${sk.name}!`);
 559:       }
 560:     }
 561:     applyHeroSpecReplacement(member);
 562:     save();
 563:     return { ok: true, spec: HERO_SPECS[specTrack] };
 564:   }
 565:   function respecHeroSpec(memberId, newSpecTrack) {
 566:     const member = memberId === 'player' ? state.player : state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId);
 567:     if (!member) return { ok: false, reason: 'Member not found' };
 568:     if (member.class !== 'HERO') return { ok: false, reason: 'Only Heroes can specialize' };
 569:     if (!member.heroSpec) return { ok: false, reason: 'No specialization to reset' };
 570:     if (newSpecTrack && !HERO_SPECS[newSpecTrack]) return { ok: false, reason: 'Invalid specialization track' };
 571:     if (newSpecTrack === member.heroSpec) return { ok: false, reason: 'Already on that track' };
 572:     const cost = 0;
 573:     const oldSpec = HERO_SPECS[member.heroSpec];
 574:     if (oldSpec) {
 575:       member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => !oldSpec.skills.includes(id));
 576:     }
 577:     member.heroSpec = newSpecTrack || null;
 578:     if (newSpecTrack) {
 579:       const specSkills = getUnlockedSpecSkills(newSpecTrack, member.level);
 580:       for (const sk of specSkills) {
 581:         if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) {
 582:           member.skills.push(sk.id);
 583:           logEvent(`${member.name} learned spec skill: ${sk.name}!`);
 584:         }
 585:       }
 586:       applyHeroSpecReplacement(member);
 587:     } else {
 588:       const baseline = getUnlockedClassSkills(member.class, member.level || 1);
 589:       for (const sk of baseline) {
 590:         if (!member.skills.includes(sk.id)) {
 591:           member.skills.push(sk.id);
 592:           logEvent(`${member.name} re-learned ${sk.name}!`);
 593:         }
 594:       }
 595:     }
 596:     save();
 597:     return { ok: true, cost };
 598:   }
 599:   function getRespecCost() {
 600:     return 0;
 601:   }
 602:   function getItemGrantedSkills(item) {
 603:     if (!item) return [];
 604:     const skills = [];
 605:     if (item.grantedSkill) skills.push(item.grantedSkill);
 606:     if (item.grantedSkills) skills.push(...item.grantedSkills);
 607:     return skills;
 608:   }
 609:   function equipItem(memberId, itemId, targetSlot) {
 610:     const member = memberId === 'player' ? state.player : state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId);
 611:     if (!member) return { ok:false, reason:'Member not found' };
 612:     const item = getItem(itemId);
 613:     if (!item || !item.slot) return { ok:false, reason:'Not equippable' };
 614:     if (!canClassEquip(member.class, item)) {
 615:       const cls = getClass(member.class);
 616:       return { ok:false, reason:`${cls.label} cannot equip ${item.name}` };
 617:     }
 618:     const canDualWield =
 619:       (item.dagger && member.class === 'ROGUE') ||
 620:       (item.claw && member.class === 'MONK') ||
 621:       (item.slot === 'weapon' && !item.twoHanded && !item.dagger && !item.claw && !item.bow &&
 622:        member.class === 'RANGER' && item.classReq && item.classReq.includes('RANGER'));
 623:     let slot = item.slot;
 624:     if (targetSlot === 'offhand' && canDualWield) {
 625:       slot = 'offhand';
 626:     } else if (targetSlot && targetSlot !== item.slot) {
 627:       if (!(canDualWield && targetSlot === 'offhand')) {
 628:         return { ok:false, reason:'Cannot equip that item in this slot' };
 629:       }
 630:     }
 631:     if (slot === 'weapon' && item.twoHanded && member.equipment.offhand) {
 632:       unequipItem(memberId, 'offhand');
 633:     }
 634:     if (slot === 'offhand' && member.equipment.weapon) {
 635:       const wpn = getItem(member.equipment.weapon);
 636:       if (wpn && wpn.twoHanded) {
 637:         return { ok:false, reason:'Cannot use offhand with a two-handed weapon' };
 638:       }
 639:     }
 640:     const inv = state.inventory.find(e => e.itemId === itemId);
 641:     if (!inv || inv.quantity < 1) return { ok:false, reason:'Not in inventory' };
 642:     const oldItemId = member.equipment[slot];
 643:     if (oldItemId) {
 644:       addToInventory(oldItemId, 1);
 645:       const oldItem = getItem(oldItemId);
 646:       const oldSkills = getItemGrantedSkills(oldItem);
 647:       if (oldSkills.length) {
 648:         const otherSlot = slot === 'weapon' ? 'offhand' : 'weapon';
 649:         const otherItemId = member.equipment[otherSlot];
 650:         const otherItem = otherItemId ? getItem(otherItemId) : null;
 651:         const otherSkills = new Set(getItemGrantedSkills(otherItem));
 652:         for (const sk of oldSkills) {
 653:           if (!otherSkills.has(sk)) {
 654:             member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => id !== sk);
 655:           }
 656:         }
 657:       }
 658:     }
 659:     inv.quantity--;
 660:     if (inv.quantity === 0) state.inventory.splice(state.inventory.indexOf(inv), 1);
 661:     member.equipment[slot] = itemId;
 662:     for (const sk of getItemGrantedSkills(item)) {
 663:       if (!member.skills.includes(sk)) member.skills.push(sk);
 664:     }
 665:     return { ok:true };
 666:   }
 667:   function unequipItem(memberId, slot) {
 668:     const member = memberId === 'player' ? state.player : state.party.find(m => m.id === memberId);
 669:     if (!member || !member.equipment[slot]) return { ok:false, reason:'Nothing to unequip' };
 670:     const itemId = member.equipment[slot];
 671:     const item = getItem(itemId);
 672:     for (const sk of getItemGrantedSkills(item)) {
 673:       member.skills = member.skills.filter(id => id !== sk);
 674:     }
 675:     addToInventory(itemId, 1);
 676:     member.equipment[slot] = null;
 677:     return { ok:true };
 678:   }
 679:   function buildPartySnapshot() {
 680:     const allActive = [state.player, ...state.activeSlots.map(id => state.party.find(p => p.id === id)).filter(Boolean)];
 681:     const auras = collectPartyAuras(allActive);
 682:     const members = [{ id:'player', name:state.player.name, class:state.player.class, level:state.player.level, stats:effectiveStats(state.player, auras), power:memberPower(state.player) }];
 683:     for (const id of state.activeSlots) {
 684:       const m = state.party.find(p => p.id === id);
 685:       if (m) members.push({ id:m.id, name:m.name, class:m.class, level:m.level, stats:effectiveStats(m, auras), power:memberPower(m) });
 686:     }
 687:     return members;
 688:   }
 689:   function getPartyAuras() {
 690:     const allActive = [state.player, ...state.activeSlots.map(id => state.party.find(p => p.id === id)).filter(Boolean)];
 691:     return collectPartyAuras(allActive);
 692:   }
 693:   function totalPartyPower() {
 694:     return buildPartySnapshot().reduce((s, m) => s + m.power, 0);
 695:   }
 696:   function getMember(id) {
 697:     if (id === 'player') return state.player;
 698:     return state.party.find(m => m.id === id) || null;
 699:   }
 700:   function getActiveMembers() {
 701:     return state.activeSlots.map(id => state.party.find(m => m.id === id)).filter(Boolean);
 702:   }
 703:   function getActiveMemberSkills(memberId) {
 704:     const member = getMember(memberId);
 705:     if (!member) return [];
 706:     const skills = [];
 707:     let classSkills = getUnlockedClassSkills(member.class, member.level);
 708:     if (member.class === 'HERO' && member.heroSpec) {
 709:       classSkills = classSkills.filter(s => !HERO_SPEC_REPLACED_SKILLS.includes(s.id));
 710:     }
 711:     skills.push(...classSkills.map(s => s.id));
 712:     const classMasteries = getUnlockedClassMasteries(member.class, member.level);
 713:     skills.push(...classMasteries.map(s => s.id));
 714:     if (member.class === 'HERO' && member.heroSpec) {
 715:       const specSkills = getUnlockedSpecSkills(member.heroSpec, member.level);
 716:       for (const sk of specSkills) {
 717:         if (!skills.includes(sk.id)) skills.push(sk.id);
 718:       }
 719:     }
 720:     for (const slot of Object.values(member.equipment || {})) {
 721:       if (slot) {
 722:         const eqSkills = getEquipmentSkills(slot);
 723:         for (const eqSkill of eqSkills) {
 724:           if (eqSkill && !skills.includes(eqSkill.id)) skills.push(eqSkill.id);
 725:         }
 726:       }
 727:     }
 728:     return skills;
 729:   }
 730:   function canTakeQuest(questId) {
 731:     const quest = getGeneratedQuest(questId) || getQuest(questId);
 732:     if (!quest) return { ok:false, reason:'Quest not found' };
 733:     if (state.guild.activeQuest) return { ok:false, reason:'Party is already on a quest' };
 734:     if (rankIndex(state.guild.rank) < rankIndex(quest.requiredGuildRank)) {
 735:       return { ok:false, reason:`Requires ${quest.requiredGuildRank} Rank` };
 736:     }
 737:     const completions = state.guild.completedQuests.filter(id => id === questId).length;
 738:     if (!quest.isRepeatable && completions > 0) return { ok:false, reason:'Already completed' };
 739:     return { ok:true };
 740:   }
 741:   function completionCount(questId) {
 742:     return state.guild.completedQuests.filter(id => id === questId).length;
 743:   }
 744:   function resolveQuest(questDef, snapshot) {
 745:     const activatedSkills = [];
 746:     let adjustedPartyPower = snapshot.reduce((s, m) => s + m.power, 0);
 747:     for (const memberSnap of snapshot) {
 748:       const member = getMember(memberSnap.id);
 749:       if (!member) continue;
 750:       const triggered = rollActiveSkills(member, snapshot);
 751:       for (const skill of triggered) {
 752:         activatedSkills.push({ memberId: member.id, memberName: member.name, skill });
 753:         if (skill.effects && skill.effects.powerMultiplier) {
 754:           adjustedPartyPower += memberSnap.power * (skill.effects.powerMultiplier - 1);
 755:         }
 756:       }
 757:     }
 758:     const partyPower = adjustedPartyPower;
 759:     const questPower = questDef.recommendedPower || 15;
 760:     const ratio = partyPower / Math.max(1, questPower);
 761:     const simOutcome = getBattleOutcome();
 762:     let success;
 763:     if (simOutcome) {
 764:       success = simOutcome === 'victory';
 765:     } else {
 766:       const successChance = Math.min(0.95, Math.max(0.05, ratio * 0.40 + 0.30));
 767:       success = Math.random() < successChance;
 768:     }
 769:     const luckBonus = 0;
 770:     const baseGold = randInt(questDef.goldReward.min, questDef.goldReward.max);
 771:     const baseExp  = randInt(questDef.expReward.min, questDef.expReward.max);
 772:     const cappedRatio = Math.min(ratio, 3.0);
 773:     const legacy = getLegacyBonuses();
 774:     const goldXpMult = 1 + getGoldXpBonus(questDef.id) + legacy.goldBonus + legacy.expBonus;
 775:     const rpMult = 1 + getRpBonus(questDef.id);
 776:     const itemFindBonus = getItemFind(questDef.id) + legacy.itemFind;
 777:     const goldEarned = success ? Math.floor(baseGold * (0.8 + cappedRatio * 0.4) * goldXpMult) : 0;
 778:     const expEarned  = Math.floor(baseExp * (success ? 1 : 0.2) * goldXpMult);
 779:     const questRarityMult = questDef.rarity === 'legendary' ? 1.4
 780:       : questDef.rarity === 'rare' ? 1.2
 781:       : questDef.rarity === 'uncommon' ? 1.1 : 1.0;
 782:     const subTier = questDef.subTier || 'standard';
 783:     const SUB_TIER_QUALITY_MULT = {
 784:       easy:     { common: 0.80, magic: 0.80, rare: 0.80, epic: 0.80, legendary: 0.80, celestial: 0.80 },
 785:       standard: { common: 1.00, magic: 1.00, rare: 1.00, epic: 1.00, legendary: 1.00, celestial: 1.00 },
 786:       hard:     { common: 1.10, magic: 1.15, rare: 1.25, epic: 1.40, legendary: 1.50, celestial: 1.60 },
 787:       brutal:   { common: 1.20, magic: 1.30, rare: 1.50, epic: 1.80, legendary: 2.00, celestial: 2.20 },
 788:     };
 789:     const subQualityTable = SUB_TIER_QUALITY_MULT[subTier] || SUB_TIER_QUALITY_MULT.standard;
 790:     const loot = [];
 791:     if (success) {
 792:       const failedEntries = [];
 793:       for (const entry of questDef.lootTable) {
 794:         if (entry.chance >= 1.0) {
 795:           loot.push({ itemId: entry.itemId, quantity: randInt(entry.quantity[0], entry.quantity[1]) });
 796:           continue;
 797:         }
 798:         const lootRatio = Math.min(ratio, 3.0);
 799:         const baseChance = entry.chance * (0.7 + lootRatio * 0.3) + luckBonus * 0.02;
 800:         const item = getItem(entry.itemId);
 801:         const itemRarity = getItemRarity(item)?.id || 'common';
 802:         const isCelItem = itemRarity === 'celestial';
 803:         const celBonus = isCelItem ? legacy.celestialBonus : 0;
 804:         const subTierDropMult = subQualityTable[itemRarity] || 1.0;
 805:         const chance = Math.min(0.95, baseChance * (1 + itemFindBonus + celBonus) * questRarityMult * subTierDropMult);
 806:         if (Math.random() < chance) {
 807:           loot.push({ itemId: entry.itemId, quantity: randInt(entry.quantity[0], entry.quantity[1]) });
 808:         } else {
 809:           failedEntries.push({ entry, chance });
 810:         }
 811:       }
 812:       const RANK_BASE_DROPS = {
 813:         F: 2, E: 2, D: 3, C: 3, B: 4, A: 4,
 814:         S: 5, 'S+': 5, 'S++': 5,
 815:       };
 816:       const SUB_TIER_DROP_BONUS = {
 817:         easy: 0, standard: 1, hard: 2, brutal: 3,
 818:       };
 819:       const isRaid = !!questDef.raidBoss;
 820:       const isBoss = !!questDef.boss;
 821:       let minLoot, maxLoot;
 822:       if (isRaid) {
 823:         minLoot = 10;
 824:         maxLoot = 10;
 825:       } else if (isBoss) {
 826:         if (subTier === 'brutal') {
 827:           minLoot = 7; maxLoot = 9;
 828:         } else if (subTier === 'hard') {
 829:           minLoot = 6; maxLoot = 8;
 830:         } else {
 831:           const base = RANK_BASE_DROPS[questDef.rank] || 2;
 832:           const bonus = SUB_TIER_DROP_BONUS[subTier] || 0;
 833:           minLoot = base + bonus;
 834:           maxLoot = minLoot + 2;
 835:         }
 836:       } else {
 837:         const base = RANK_BASE_DROPS[questDef.rank] || 2;
 838:         const bonus = SUB_TIER_DROP_BONUS[subTier] || 0;
 839:         minLoot = base + bonus;
 840:         maxLoot = minLoot;
 841:       }
 842:       if (maxLoot && loot.length > maxLoot) {
 843:         while (loot.length > maxLoot) loot.pop();
 844:       }
 845:       if (loot.length < minLoot && failedEntries.length > 0) {
 846:         failedEntries.sort((a, b) => {
 847:           const aEquip = EQUIPMENT[a.entry.itemId] ? 1 : 0;
 848:           const bEquip = EQUIPMENT[b.entry.itemId] ? 1 : 0;
 849:           if (aEquip !== bEquip) return bEquip - aEquip;
 850:           return b.chance - a.chance;
 851:         });
 852:         for (const fe of failedEntries) {
 853:           if (loot.length >= minLoot) break;
 854:           if (loot.some(l => l.itemId === fe.entry.itemId)) continue;
 855:           loot.push({ itemId: fe.entry.itemId, quantity: randInt(fe.entry.quantity[0], fe.entry.quantity[1]) });
 856:         }
 857:       }
 858:     }
 859:     const baseRp = success ? questDef.rankPointReward : 0;
 860:     const rankPoints = Math.floor(baseRp * rpMult);
 861:     const pool = success ? questDef.narratives.success : questDef.narratives.failure;
 862:     const narrative = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
 863:     return { success, partyPower, questPower, ratio, goldEarned, expEarned, rankPoints, loot, narrative, activatedSkills };
 864:   }
 865:   function refreshShopIfNeeded() {
 866:     const now = Date.now();
 867:     const timerExpired = !state.shop.lastRefreshed || now - state.shop.lastRefreshed >= SHOP_REFRESH_MS;
 868:     const questThreshold = (state.shop.questsSinceRefresh || 0) >= SHOP_QUEST_REFRESH;
 869:     if (timerExpired || questThreshold) {
 870:       refreshShop();
 871:     }
 872:   }
 873:   function tickShopQuestCounter() {
 874:     state.shop.questsSinceRefresh = (state.shop.questsSinceRefresh || 0) + 1;
 875:     if (state.shop.questsSinceRefresh >= SHOP_QUEST_REFRESH) {
 876:       refreshShop();
 877:     }
 878:   }
 879:   function getRushRestockCost() {
 880:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 881:     if (level === 0) return 100;
 882:     return Math.floor(SHOP_UPGRADE_COSTS[level - 1] * 0.20);
 883:   }
 884:   function rushRestock() {
 885:     const cost = getRushRestockCost();
 886:     if (state.gold < cost) {
 887:       return { ok: false, reason: `Need ${cost.toLocaleString()}g (have ${state.gold.toLocaleString()}g)` };
 888:     }
 889:     state.gold -= cost;
 890:     refreshShop();
 891:     logEvent(`Rush restock! Spent ${cost.toLocaleString()}g to refresh the shop.`);
 892:     return { ok: true, cost };
 893:   }
 894:   const SHOP_UPGRADE_COSTS = [
 895:     500, 1500, 4000, 8000, 15000, 25000, 40000, 60000, 80000, 100000
 896:   ];
 897:   const SHOP_LEVEL_RANK_REQ = ['F', 'F', 'F', 'E', 'E', 'D', 'D', 'C', 'C', 'B'];
 898:   const RARITY_WEIGHT_BASE = { common: 40, magic: 30, rare: 18, epic: 8, legendary: 4 };
 899:   const RARITY_WEIGHT_MAX  = { common: 0,  magic: 0,  rare: 10, epic: 45, legendary: 45 };
 900:   function getShopRarityWeights() {
 901:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 902:     const t = level / 10;
 903:     const weights = {};
 904:     for (const r of Object.keys(RARITY_WEIGHT_BASE)) {
 905:       weights[r] = Math.round(RARITY_WEIGHT_BASE[r] * (1 - t) + RARITY_WEIGHT_MAX[r] * t);
 906:     }
 907:     return weights;
 908:   }
 909:   function getShopUpgradeCost() {
 910:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 911:     if (level >= 10) return null;
 912:     return SHOP_UPGRADE_COSTS[level];
 913:   }
 914:   function getShopUpgradeRankReq() {
 915:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 916:     if (level >= 10) return null;
 917:     return SHOP_LEVEL_RANK_REQ[level] || 'F';
 918:   }
 919:   function canUpgradeShop() {
 920:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 921:     if (level >= 10) return { ok: false, reason: 'Shop is already max level!' };
 922:     const reqRank = SHOP_LEVEL_RANK_REQ[level] || 'F';
 923:     if (rankIndex(state.guild.rank) < rankIndex(reqRank)) {
 924:       return { ok: false, reason: `Requires Guild Rank ${reqRank}` };
 925:     }
 926:     const cost = SHOP_UPGRADE_COSTS[level];
 927:     if (state.gold < cost) return { ok: false, reason: `Need ${cost.toLocaleString()}g (have ${state.gold.toLocaleString()}g)` };
 928:     return { ok: true };
 929:   }
 930:   function upgradeShop() {
 931:     const check = canUpgradeShop();
 932:     if (!check.ok) return check;
 933:     const level = state.shop.level || 0;
 934:     const cost = SHOP_UPGRADE_COSTS[level];
 935:     state.gold -= cost;
 936:     state.shop.level = level + 1;
 937:     logEvent(`Shop upgraded to level ${state.shop.level}!`);
 938:     refreshShop();
 939:     return { ok: true, newLevel: state.shop.level };
 940:   }
 941:   function getShopBonusRanks() {
 942:     return (state.shop.level || 0) >= 3 ? 1 : 0;
 943:   }
 944:   function getShopEffectiveRankIndex() {
 945:     return Math.min(RANK_ORDER.length - 1, rankIndex(state.guild.rank) + getShopBonusRanks());
 946:   }
 947:   function refreshShop() {
 948:     const ri = getShopEffectiveRankIndex();
 949:     const available = Object.values(EQUIPMENT).filter(item => item.rarity !== 'celestial' && item.shopMinRank != null && rankIndex(item.shopMinRank) <= ri);
 950:     if (available.length === 0) { state.shop.stock = []; state.shop.lastRefreshed = Date.now(); return; }
 951:     const selected = [];
 952:     const used = new Set();
 953:     const slots = ['weapon', 'armor', 'accessory', 'offhand'];
 954:     for (const slot of slots) {
 955:       const slotItems = available.filter(it => it.slot === slot && !used.has(it.id));
 956:       if (slotItems.length > 0) {
 957:         const pick = weightedPick(slotItems);
 958:         selected.push(pick);
 959:         used.add(pick.id);
 960:       }
 961:     }
 962:     const remaining = available.filter(it => !used.has(it.id));
 963:     while (selected.length < 10 && remaining.length > 0) {
 964:       const pick = weightedPick(remaining);
 965:       selected.push(pick);
 966:       used.add(pick.id);
 967:       remaining.splice(remaining.indexOf(pick), 1);
 968:     }
 969:     state.shop.stock = selected.map(item => {
 970:       const rarity = item.rarity || 'common';
 971:       const qty = rarity === 'legendary' ? 1 : rarity === 'epic' ? randInt(1, 1) : randInt(1, 3);
 972:       return { itemId: item.id, price: item.buyPrice, quantity: qty };
 973:     });
 974:     state.shop.lastRefreshed = Date.now();
 975:     state.shop.questsSinceRefresh = 0;
 976:   }
 977:   function weightedPick(items) {
 978:     const weights = getShopRarityWeights();
 979:     const totalWeight = items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (weights[it.rarity || 'common'] || 20), 0);
 980:     let roll = Math.random() * totalWeight;
 981:     for (const item of items) {
 982:       roll -= weights[item.rarity || 'common'] || 20;
 983:       if (roll <= 0) return item;
 984:     }
 985:     return items[items.length - 1];
 986:   }
 987:   function buyItem(itemId) {
 988:     const entry = state.shop.stock.find(s => s.itemId === itemId && s.quantity > 0);
 989:     if (!entry) return { ok:false, reason:'Out of stock' };
 990:     if (state.gold < entry.price) return { ok:false, reason:`Need ${entry.price}g (have ${state.gold}g)` };
 991:     const cost = entry.price;
 992:     state.gold -= cost;
 993:     entry.quantity--;
 994:     addToInventory(itemId, 1);
 995:     return { ok:true, cost };
 996:   }
 997:   function toggleKeepItem(itemId) {
 998:     const entry = state.inventory.find(e => e.itemId === itemId);
 999:     if (!entry) return { ok:false, reason:'Item not found' };
1000:     entry.kept = !entry.kept;
1001:     return { ok:true, kept: entry.kept };
1002:   }
1003:   function sellItem(itemId, qty = 1) {
1004:     const item = getItem(itemId);
1005:     if (!item) return { ok:false, reason:'Unknown item' };
1006:     const entry = state.inventory.find(e => e.itemId === itemId);
1007:     if (entry && entry.kept) return { ok:false, reason:'Item is kept — unlock it first' };
1008:     if (!removeFromInventory(itemId, qty)) return { ok:false, reason:'Not enough items' };
1009:     const earned = Math.floor((item.sellPrice || Math.floor(item.buyPrice * 0.4)) * qty);
1010:     state.gold += earned;
1011:     return { ok:true, earned };
1012:   }
1013:   function sellAllItems() {
1014:     let totalEarned = 0;
1015:     let totalSold = 0;
1016:     const entries = [...state.inventory].filter(e => {
1017:       const item = getItem(e.itemId);
1018:       return item && (item.sellPrice || item.buyPrice) && e.quantity > 0 && !e.kept;
1019:     });
1020:     for (const e of entries) {
1021:       const item = getItem(e.itemId);
1022:       if (!item) continue;
1023:       const earned = Math.floor((item.sellPrice || Math.floor(item.buyPrice * 0.4)) * e.quantity);
1024:       totalSold += e.quantity;
1025:       totalEarned += earned;
1026:       removeFromInventory(e.itemId, e.quantity);
1027:     }
1028:     state.gold += totalEarned;
1029:     return { ok: true, earned: totalEarned, count: totalSold };
1030:   }
1031:   function shopRefreshMs() {
1032:     if (!state.shop.lastRefreshed) return 0;
1033:     return Math.max(0, SHOP_REFRESH_MS - (Date.now() - state.shop.lastRefreshed));
1034:   }
1035:   function shopQuestsUntilRefresh() {
1036:     return Math.max(0, SHOP_QUEST_REFRESH - (state.shop.questsSinceRefresh || 0));
1037:   }
1038:   function getPartyStrength() {

1044:   function refreshQuestBoard(rank, force = false) {
1045:     if (!state.questBoard) {
1046:       state.questBoard = { quests: {}, lastRefreshed: {}, seeds: {} };
1047:     }
1048:     if (!force && !shouldRefreshBoard(state.questBoard.lastRefreshed[rank])) {
1049:       return state.questBoard.quests[rank] || [];
1050:     }
1051:     const seed = Date.now() + rankIndex(rank) * 10000;
1052:     const strength = getPartyStrength();
1053:     const quests = generateQuestBoard(rank, strength, seed, state.guild?.rank);
1054:     state.questBoard.quests[rank] = quests;
1055:     state.questBoard.lastRefreshed[rank] = Date.now();
1056:     state.questBoard.seeds[rank] = seed;
1057:     return quests;
1058:   }
1059:   function getQuestBoardQuests(rank) {
1060:     if (!state.questBoard) {
1061:       state.questBoard = { quests: {}, lastRefreshed: {}, seeds: {} };
1062:     }
1063:     if (shouldRefreshBoard(state.questBoard.lastRefreshed[rank])) {
1064:       return refreshQuestBoard(rank);
1065:     }
1066:     return state.questBoard.quests[rank] || [];
1067:   }
1068:   function questBoardRefreshMs(rank) {
1069:     if (!state.questBoard || !state.questBoard.lastRefreshed[rank]) return 0;
1070:     return Math.max(0, BOARD_REFRESH_MS - (Date.now() - state.questBoard.lastRefreshed[rank]));
1071:   }
1072:   function pickQuestByStrategy(rank, strategy) {
1073:     const quests = getQuestBoardQuests(rank);
1074:     if (!quests || quests.length === 0) return null;
1075:     const partyStr = getPartyStrength();
1076:     if (partyStr <= 0) return quests[0];
1077:     const scored = quests.map(q => ({
1078:       quest: q,
1079:       ratio: (q.difficulty * 20) / partyStr,
1080:     }));
1081:     if (strategy === 'safe') {
1082:       scored.sort((a, b) => a.ratio - b.ratio);
1083:     } else if (strategy === 'push') {
1084:       scored.sort((a, b) => b.ratio - a.ratio);
1085:     } else {
1086:       scored.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.ratio - 0.8) - Math.abs(b.ratio - 0.8));
1087:     }
1088:     return scored[0].quest;
1089:   }
1090:   function getGeneratedQuest(questId) {
1091:     if (!state.questBoard || !state.questBoard.quests) return null;
1092:     for (const rank of RANK_ORDER) {
1093:       const quests = state.questBoard.quests[rank];
1094:       if (quests) {
1095:         const q = quests.find(q => q.id === questId);
1096:         if (q) return q;
1097:       }
1098:     }
1099:     return null;
1100:   }

1164:   function _getSynergyBonus(questId, key) {
1165:     if (!state.partySynergy) return 0;

1167:     if (completions === 0) return 0;
1168:     const compMult = completions >= 10 ? 1.0 : completions >= 5 ? 0.7 : 0.4;
1169:     let bonus = 0;

1171:       if (state.partySynergy.bonusesUnlocked.includes(thresh.id) && thresh[key]) {
1172:         bonus = Math.max(bonus, thresh[key]);

1174:     }
1175:     return bonus * compMult;
1176:   }

1212:   function rollSecretBoss(questDef, snapshot) {
1213:     let chance = getSecretBossChance();
1214:     const partyPow = snapshot.reduce((s, m) => s + m.power, 0);
1215:     const questPow = questDef.recommendedPower || 15;
1216:     if (questPow > 0) {
1217:       const overPowerRatio = partyPow / questPow;
1218:       if (overPowerRatio > 2.0) {
1219:         const bonusChance = Math.min(0.40, (overPowerRatio - 2.0) * 0.08);
1220:         chance = Math.max(chance, bonusChance);
1221:       }
1222:     }
1223:     if (chance <= 0 || Math.random() >= chance) return null;
1224:     const boss = SECRET_BOSSES[Math.floor(Math.random() * SECRET_BOSSES.length)];
1225:     const bossPartyPower = snapshot.reduce((s, m) => s + m.power, 0);
1226:     const bossQuestPower = (questDef.recommendedPower || 15) * boss.powerMult;
1227:     const bossRatio = bossPartyPower / Math.max(1, bossQuestPower);
1228:     const bossSuccess = Math.random() < Math.min(0.90, Math.max(0.10, bossRatio * 0.4 + 0.3));
1229:     const recipient = snapshot[Math.floor(Math.random() * snapshot.length)];
1230:     const recipientMember = getMember(recipient.id);
1231:     const classReward = recipientMember ? CLASS_UNIQUE_REWARDS[recipientMember.class] : null;
1232:     return {
1233:       boss,
1234:       success: bossSuccess,
1235:       goldBonus: bossSuccess ? Math.floor(questDef.goldReward.max * boss.goldMult) : 0,
1236:       expBonus: bossSuccess ? Math.floor(questDef.expReward.max * boss.expMult) : 0,
1237:       recipientId: recipient.id,
1238:       recipientName: recipient.name,
1239:       classReward: bossSuccess ? classReward : null,
1240:     };
1241:   }

1271:       secretBoss: result.secretBoss || null,
1272:       levelUps,
1273:       narrative: result.narrative,
1274:       partySummary,
1275:       combatStats: combatStatsData || [],
1276:       timestamp: Date.now(),
1277:     });
1278:     if (state.questHistory.length > 50) state.questHistory.pop();
1279:   }
1280:   const EVENT_INTERVAL_MS = 1500;
1281:   function startQuest(questId) {
1282:     const quest = getGeneratedQuest(questId) || getQuest(questId);
1283:     if (!quest) return { ok:false, reason:'Quest not found' };
1284:     const check = canTakeQuest(questId);
1285:     if (!check.ok) return check;
1286:     const snapshot = buildPartySnapshot();

1288:       questId, startedAt: Date.now(),
1289:       eventCount: 0,
1290:       partySnapshot: snapshot,
1291:       questData: quest,
1292:     };
1293:     logEvent(`Party departed for: ${quest.title}`);
1294:     save();

1296:   }
1297:   function setQuestEventCount(count, intervalMs, decisiveIndex, fastForwardMs) {
1298:     if (state.guild.activeQuest) {
1299:       state.guild.activeQuest.eventCount = count;
1300:       state.guild.activeQuest.eventIntervalMs = intervalMs || EVENT_INTERVAL_MS;
1301:       state.guild.activeQuest.decisiveIndex = (decisiveIndex != null) ? decisiveIndex : (count - 1);
1302:       state.guild.activeQuest.fastForwardMs = fastForwardMs || 80;
1303:     }
1304:   }
1305:   function startAutoRun(strategy, count, rank) {
1306:     state.autoRun = { strategy, remaining: count, total: count, rank };
1307:     const quest = pickQuestByStrategy(rank, strategy);
1308:     if (!quest) {

1313:     if (!result.ok) {

1315:       return result;

1327:   function _getEventInterval() {
1328:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1329:     return (aq && aq.eventIntervalMs) || EVENT_INTERVAL_MS;
1330:   }
1331:   function _totalPlaybackMs(aq) {
1332:     if (!aq || !aq.eventCount) return 0;
1333:     const interval = _getEventInterval();
1334:     const decisive = (aq.decisiveIndex != null) ? aq.decisiveIndex : (aq.eventCount - 1);
1335:     const ff = aq.fastForwardMs || 80;
1336:     const normalMs = (decisive + 1) * interval;
1337:     const trailingEvents = Math.max(0, aq.eventCount - decisive - 1);
1338:     return normalMs + trailingEvents * ff;
1339:   }
1340:   function questEventsRevealed() {
1341:     if (!state.guild.activeQuest) return 0;
1342:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1343:     const elapsed = Date.now() - aq.startedAt;
1344:     const interval = _getEventInterval();
1345:     const decisive = (aq.decisiveIndex != null) ? aq.decisiveIndex : ((aq.eventCount || 1) - 1);
1346:     const ff = aq.fastForwardMs || 80;
1347:     const decisiveTime = (decisive + 1) * interval;
1348:     if (elapsed <= decisiveTime) {
1349:       return Math.max(1, Math.floor(elapsed / interval) + 1);
1350:     }
1351:     const extra = Math.floor((elapsed - decisiveTime) / ff);
1352:     return decisive + 1 + extra;
1353:   }
1354:   function questTimeRemaining() {
1355:     if (!state.guild.activeQuest) return 0;
1356:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1357:     if (!aq.eventCount) return 99;
1358:     const totalMs = _totalPlaybackMs(aq);
1359:     return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((aq.startedAt + totalMs - Date.now()) / 1000));
1360:   }
1361:   function questProgress() {
1362:     if (!state.guild.activeQuest) return 0;
1363:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1364:     if (!aq.eventCount) return 0;
1365:     const revealed = questEventsRevealed();
1366:     return Math.min(1, revealed / aq.eventCount);
1367:   }
1368:   function isQuestComplete() {
1369:     if (!state.guild.activeQuest) return false;
1370:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1371:     if (!aq.eventCount) return false;
1372:     return questEventsRevealed() >= aq.eventCount;
1373:   }
1374:   function finishQuest() {
1375:     if (!state.guild.activeQuest) return;
1376:     const aq = state.guild.activeQuest;
1377:     const quest = aq.questData || getGeneratedQuest(aq.questId) || getQuest(aq.questId);
1378:     if (!quest) { state.guild.activeQuest = null; return; }

1398:       }

1403:     const skillGains = [];

1406:       levelUps.push(...gained.levelUps);
````

## File: js/questgen.js
````javascript
  1: import { RANK_ORDER, EQUIPMENT, LOOT_ITEMS, getItem, getClass, rankIndex, randInt } from './data.js';
  2: import { getSkill } from './skills.js';
  3: import {
  4:   SUB_TIER_MULTIPLIERS,
  5:   BOARD_MIX_SLOTS,
  6:   WILDCARD_WEIGHTS,
  7:   MINE_SUB_TIER_WEIGHTS,

  9:   BOSS_POWER_MULT,
 10:   RAID_POWER_MULT,
 11:   BOSS_RP_MULT,
 12:   RAID_RP_MULT,
 13:   subTierForRankGap,
 14:   wildcardBracket,
 15:   rankGap as computeRankGap,
 16: } from './data/rankScales.js';
 17: export const DIFFICULTY_TIERS = [
 18:   { id: 'trivial',    label: 'Trivial',    color: '#7a7a8a', icon: '○', multiplier: 0.4 },
 19:   { id: 'easy',       label: 'Easy',       color: '#2ecc71', icon: '◐', multiplier: 0.7 },
 20:   { id: 'moderate',   label: 'Moderate',   color: '#f0c060', icon: '●', multiplier: 1.0 },
 21:   { id: 'hard',       label: 'Hard',       color: '#e67e22', icon: '◆', multiplier: 1.4 },
 22:   { id: 'epic',       label: 'Epic',       color: '#9b59b6', icon: '★', multiplier: 2.0 },
 23:   { id: 'legendary',  label: 'Legendary',  color: '#e74c3c', icon: '✦', multiplier: 3.0 },
 24: ];
 25: export function getDifficultyTier(tierId) {
 26:   return DIFFICULTY_TIERS.find(t => t.id === tierId) || DIFFICULTY_TIERS[2];
 27: }
 28: export function calculateMemberStrength(member, effectiveStatsFn) {
 29:   if (!member) return 0;
 30:   const stats = effectiveStatsFn ? effectiveStatsFn(member) : member.stats;
 31:   const statScore = (stats.atk || 0) * 2.0
 32:     + (stats.def || 0) * 1.5
 33:     + (stats.spd || 0) * 1.2
 34:     + (stats.mag || 0) * 1.8
 35:     + Math.floor((stats.maxHp || 50) / 8)
 36:     + (stats.crit || 0) * 0.8
 37:     + (stats.dodge || 0) * 0.5;
 38:   const levelBonus = Math.pow(member.level, 1.3) * 2;
 39:   const skillBonus = (member.skills || []).reduce((sum, skillId) => {
 40:     const skill = getSkill(skillId);
 41:     if (!skill) return sum;
 42:     if (skill.type === 'active') return sum + 8;
 43:     if (skill.type === 'passive') return sum + 5;
 44:     return sum;
 45:   }, 0);
 46:   const equipBonus = Object.values(member.equipment || {}).filter(Boolean).length * 6;
 47:   const questExpBonus = Math.min(50, (member.questsCompleted || 0) * 0.5);
 48:   return Math.floor(statScore + levelBonus + skillBonus + equipBonus + questExpBonus);
 49: }
 50: export function calculatePartyStrength(playerMember, activeMembers, effectiveStatsFn) {
 51:   let total = calculateMemberStrength(playerMember, effectiveStatsFn);
 52:   for (const m of activeMembers) {
 53:     total += calculateMemberStrength(m, effectiveStatsFn);
 54:   }
 55:   const partySize = 1 + activeMembers.length;
 56:   if (partySize >= 3) total = Math.floor(total * 1.05);
 57:   if (partySize >= 4) total = Math.floor(total * 1.03);
 58:   if (partySize >= 5) total = Math.floor(total * 1.03);
 59:   if (partySize >= 6) total = Math.floor(total * 1.02);
 60:   if (partySize >= 7) total = Math.floor(total * 1.02);
 61:   return total;
 62: }
 63: export function getQuestDifficultyTier(questPower, partyStrength) {
 64:   if (partyStrength <= 0) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[5];
 65:   const ratio = questPower / partyStrength;
 66:   if (ratio <= 0.25) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[0];
 67:   if (ratio <= 0.50) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[1];
 68:   if (ratio <= 0.80) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[2];
 69:   if (ratio <= 1.15) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[3];
 70:   if (ratio <= 1.60) return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[4];
 71:   return DIFFICULTY_TIERS[5];
 72: }

652: const NEXT_RANK = { F: 'E', E: 'D', D: 'C', C: 'B', B: 'A', A: 'S', S: 'S+', 'S+': 'S++', 'S++': 'S++' };
653: const SUCCESS_NARRATIVES = [

665: let _questSeed = Date.now();
666: function nextSeed() { return _questSeed++; }
667: function seededRand(seed) {
668:   let x = Math.sin(seed * 9301 + 49297) * 233280;
669:   return x - Math.floor(x);
670: }
671: function seededRandInt(min, max, seed) {
672:   return Math.floor(seededRand(seed) * (max - min + 1)) + min;
673: }
674: function seededPick(arr, seed) {
675:   return arr[Math.floor(seededRand(seed) * arr.length)];
676: }
677: function partyScalingMultiplier(partyStrength, rank) {
678:   if (!partyStrength || partyStrength <= 0) return 1.0;
679:   const scale = RANK_SCALES[rank];
680:   if (!scale) return 1.0;
681:   const baseMax = scale.recPow[1];
682:   if (partyStrength <= baseMax * 1.2) return 1.0;
683:   const combatEquivalent = partyStrength * 0.65;
684:   const target = combatEquivalent * 1.1;
685:   return Math.min(12.0, target / baseMax);
686: }
687: export function generateQuestInstance(rank, templateIndex, seed, partyStrength) {
688:   const templates = QUEST_TEMPLATES[rank];
689:   if (!templates || templateIndex >= templates.length) return null;
690:   const t = templates[templateIndex];
691:   const scale = RANK_SCALES[rank];
692:   const envPool = ENVIRONMENTS[t.mood] || ENVIRONMENTS.dungeon;
693:   const envName = seededPick(envPool, seed);
694:   const envIcon = ENV_ICONS[t.mood] || '?';
695:   const pScale = 1.0;
696:   const rewardScale = 1.0 + (pScale - 1.0) * 0.5;
697:   const goldMin = Math.floor(seededRandInt(scale.gold[0], Math.floor(scale.gold[1] * 0.6), seed + 1) * rewardScale);
698:   const goldMax = Math.floor(seededRandInt(Math.floor(scale.gold[1] * 0.6), scale.gold[1], seed + 2) * rewardScale);
699:   const expMin = Math.floor(seededRandInt(scale.exp[0], Math.floor(scale.exp[1] * 0.6), seed + 3) * rewardScale);
700:   const expMax = Math.floor(seededRandInt(Math.floor(scale.exp[1] * 0.6), scale.exp[1], seed + 4) * rewardScale);
701:   const rp = Math.floor(seededRandInt(scale.rp[0], scale.rp[1], seed + 5) * rewardScale);
702:   const dur = seededRandInt(scale.dur[0], scale.dur[1], seed + 6);
703:   const baseDiff = scale.diff[0] + seededRand(seed + 7) * (scale.diff[1] - scale.diff[0]);
704:   const diff = baseDiff * pScale;
705:   const baseRecPow = seededRandInt(scale.recPow[0], scale.recPow[1], seed + 8);
706:   const recPow = Math.floor(baseRecPow * pScale);
707:   const rarityRoll = seededRand(seed + 50);
708:   const rarityShift = Math.min(0.3, (pScale - 1.0) * 0.08);
709:   let rarity = 'common';
710:   if (rarityRoll > 0.9 - rarityShift * 2)  { rarity = 'legendary'; }
711:   else if (rarityRoll > 0.7 - rarityShift)  { rarity = 'rare'; }
712:   else if (rarityRoll > 0.4)                { rarity = 'uncommon'; }
713:   const rarityMult = rarity === 'legendary' ? 1.5 : rarity === 'rare' ? 1.25 : rarity === 'uncommon' ? 1.1 : 1.0;
714:   const isGemMining = !!t.gemMining;
715:   let lootTable;
716:   if (isGemMining) {
717:     const gemEntry = { itemId: t.gemItemId, chance: 1.0, quantity: [1, 1] };
718:     const junkPool = (RANK_LOOT_POOLS[rank] || []).filter(id => !EQUIPMENT[id] && !!LOOT_ITEMS[id]);
719:     const junkShuffled = [...junkPool].sort((a, b) => seededRand(seed + 10 + junkPool.indexOf(a)) - seededRand(seed + 10 + junkPool.indexOf(b)));
720:     const junkCount = seededRandInt(1, Math.min(3, junkShuffled.length), seed + 9);
721:     const junkEntries = junkShuffled.slice(0, junkCount).map((itemId, i) => ({
722:       itemId,
723:       chance: 0.30 + seededRand(seed + 30 + i) * 0.40,
724:       quantity: [1, seededRandInt(1, 3, seed + 40 + i)],
725:     }));
726:     lootTable = [gemEntry, ...junkEntries];
727:   } else {
728:     const isBoss = !!t.boss;
729:     let lootPool;
730:     if (isBoss) {
731:       const nextRank = NEXT_RANK[rank];
732:       const nextNext = (nextRank && nextRank !== rank) ? NEXT_RANK[nextRank] : null;
733:       lootPool = [...(RANK_LOOT_POOLS[nextRank && nextRank !== rank ? nextRank : rank] || [])];
734:       if (nextNext && nextNext !== nextRank) {
735:         const skip2Pool = RANK_LOOT_POOLS[nextNext] || [];
736:         for (const id of skip2Pool) { if (!lootPool.includes(id)) lootPool.push(id); }
737:       }
738:       const CELESTIAL_MIN_RANK = ['B', 'A', 'S', 'S+', 'S++'];
739:       if (CELESTIAL_MIN_RANK.includes(rank)) {
740:         for (const id of CELESTIAL_ITEM_IDS) { if (!lootPool.includes(id)) lootPool.push(id); }
741:       }
742:     } else {
743:       lootPool = [...(RANK_LOOT_POOLS[rank] || [])];
744:     }
745:     const RANK_BASE_TABLE = { F: 4, E: 4, D: 5, C: 5, B: 6, A: 6, S: 8, 'S+': 8, 'S++': 8 };
746:     const baseTable = RANK_BASE_TABLE[rank] || 4;
747:     const rarityLootBonus = rarity === 'legendary' ? 1 : rarity === 'rare' ? 1 : 0;
748:     const bossTableBonus = isBoss ? 4 : 0;
749:     const lootCountMin = baseTable + rarityLootBonus + bossTableBonus;
750:     const lootCountMax = Math.min(lootCountMin + 2, lootPool.length);
751:     const lootCount = seededRandInt(lootCountMin, Math.max(lootCountMin, lootCountMax), seed + 9);
752:     const RANK_EQUIP_BASE = {
753:       F: [0.06, 0.10], E: [0.07, 0.12],
754:       D: [0.08, 0.14], C: [0.09, 0.16],
755:       B: [0.10, 0.18], A: [0.12, 0.20],
756:       S: [0.14, 0.22], 'S+': [0.16, 0.25], 'S++': [0.18, 0.28],
757:     };
758:     const shuffled = [...lootPool].sort((a, b) => seededRand(seed + 10 + lootPool.indexOf(a)) - seededRand(seed + 10 + lootPool.indexOf(b)));
759:     lootTable = shuffled.slice(0, lootCount).map((itemId, i) => {
760:       const isEquip = !!EQUIPMENT[itemId];
761:       const isCelestial = isEquip && EQUIPMENT[itemId].rarity === 'celestial';
762:       const rarityDropMult = rarity === 'legendary' ? 2.0 : rarity === 'rare' ? 1.5 : rarity === 'uncommon' ? 1.2 : 1.0;
763:       const isRaid = isBoss && !!t.raidBoss;
764:       const sRankCelMult = rank === 'S++' ? (isRaid ? 15.0 : 8.0)
765:                          : rank === 'S+' ? 5.0
766:                          : rank === 'S' ? 3.0 : 1.0;
767:       const bossCelestialMult = isBoss ? sRankCelMult : 1.0;
768:       let baseChance;
769:       if (isCelestial) {
770:         baseChance = (0.012 + seededRand(seed + 20 + i) * 0.018) * Math.min(rarityDropMult, 1.5) * bossCelestialMult;
771:       } else if (isRaid) {
772:         baseChance = 0;
773:       } else if (isEquip) {
774:         const [eqLo, eqHi] = RANK_EQUIP_BASE[rank] || [0.08, 0.15];
775:         const bossEquipMult = isBoss ? 1.3 : 1.0;
776:         baseChance = (eqLo + seededRand(seed + 20 + i) * (eqHi - eqLo)) * rarityDropMult * bossEquipMult;
777:       } else {
778:         baseChance = 0.30 + seededRand(seed + 30 + i) * 0.50;
779:       }
780:       const celestialCap = isRaid ? 0.45
781:                          : rank === 'S++' ? 0.25
782:                          : rank === 'S+' ? 0.18
783:                          : (isBoss && rank === 'S') ? 0.15 : 0.07;
784:       return {
785:         itemId,
786:         chance: Math.min(isCelestial ? celestialCap : 0.90, baseChance),
787:         quantity: isEquip ? [1, 1] : [1, seededRandInt(1, 4, seed + 40 + i)],
788:       };
789:     });
790:   }
791:   const id = `${rank}_GEN_${templateIndex}_${seed}`;
792:   const description = t.desc.replace('{env}', envName);
793:   return {
794:     id,
795:     rank,
796:     title: t.title,
797:     description,
798:     environment: { name: envName, icon: envIcon, mood: t.mood },
799:     enemies: t.enemies,
800:     duration: dur,
801:     difficulty: Math.round(diff * rarityMult * 100) / 100,
802:     recommendedPower: Math.floor(recPow * rarityMult),
803:     goldReward: { min: Math.floor(goldMin * rarityMult), max: Math.floor(goldMax * rarityMult) },
804:     expReward: { min: Math.floor(expMin * rarityMult), max: Math.floor(expMax * rarityMult) },
805:     rankPointReward: Math.floor(rp * rarityMult),
806:     lootTable,
807:     requiredGuildRank: rank,
808:     isRepeatable: true,
809:     rarity,
810:     gemMining: isGemMining || false,
811:     gemItemId: isGemMining ? t.gemItemId : null,
812:     boss: !!t.boss,
813:     raidBoss: !!t.raidBoss,
814:     bossName: t.bossName || null,
815:     templateIndex,
816:     narratives: t.narratives || {
817:       success: SUCCESS_NARRATIVES,
818:       failure: FAILURE_NARRATIVES,
819:     },
820:   };
821: }
822: const BOARD_SIZE = 5;
823: const BOARD_REFRESH_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
824: function rollWildcardType(rank, seed) {
825:   const weights = WILDCARD_WEIGHTS[wildcardBracket(rank)];
826:   const roll = seededRand(seed);
827:   let acc = 0;
828:   for (const key of ['standard', 'mine', 'boss', 'raidBoss']) {
829:     acc += weights[key] || 0;
830:     if (roll < acc) return key;
831:   }
832:   return 'standard';
833: }
834: function rollMineSubTier(seed) {
835:   const roll = seededRand(seed);
836:   let acc = 0;
837:   for (const key of ['easy', 'standard', 'hard', 'brutal']) {
838:     acc += MINE_SUB_TIER_WEIGHTS[key] || 0;
839:     if (roll < acc) return key;
840:   }
841:   return 'standard';
842: }
843: function applySubTierRewards(quest, subTier) {
844:   quest.subTier = subTier;
845:   const tier = SUB_TIER_MULTIPLIERS[subTier] || SUB_TIER_MULTIPLIERS.standard;
846:   if (quest.goldReward) {
847:     quest.goldReward.min = Math.floor(quest.goldReward.min * tier.rewardMult);
848:     quest.goldReward.max = Math.floor(quest.goldReward.max * tier.rewardMult);
849:   }
850:   if (quest.expReward) {
851:     quest.expReward.min = Math.floor(quest.expReward.min * tier.rewardMult);
852:     quest.expReward.max = Math.floor(quest.expReward.max * tier.rewardMult);
853:   }
854:   const bossRewardMult = quest.raidBoss ? RAID_RP_MULT
855:     : quest.boss ? BOSS_RP_MULT : 1.0;
856:   if (quest.rankPointReward) {
857:     quest.rankPointReward = Math.floor(quest.rankPointReward * tier.rewardMult * bossRewardMult);
858:   }
859:   if (bossRewardMult > 1.0) {
860:     if (quest.goldReward) {
861:       quest.goldReward.min = Math.floor(quest.goldReward.min * bossRewardMult);
862:       quest.goldReward.max = Math.floor(quest.goldReward.max * bossRewardMult);
863:     }
864:     if (quest.expReward) {
865:       quest.expReward.min = Math.floor(quest.expReward.min * bossRewardMult);
866:       quest.expReward.max = Math.floor(quest.expReward.max * bossRewardMult);
867:     }
868:   }
869:   const rankTarget = RANK_POWER_TARGETS[quest.rank] || 100;
870:   let recPow = rankTarget * tier.powerMult;
871:   if (quest.raidBoss) recPow *= RAID_POWER_MULT;
872:   else if (quest.boss) recPow *= BOSS_POWER_MULT;
873:   const rarityMult = quest.rarity === 'legendary' ? 1.15
874:                    : quest.rarity === 'rare' ? 1.08
875:                    : quest.rarity === 'uncommon' ? 1.03
876:                    : 1.00;
877:   recPow *= rarityMult;
878:   quest.recommendedPower = Math.round(recPow);
879:   quest.difficulty = Math.round((recPow / 20) * 100) / 100;
880:   return quest;
881: }
882: function pickTemplate(templates, predicate, seed, used) {
883:   const pool = templates.map((t, i) => predicate(t) ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0 && !used.has(i));
884:   if (pool.length === 0) {
885:     const unfiltered = templates.map((t, i) => predicate(t) ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0);
886:     if (unfiltered.length === 0) return -1;
887:     return unfiltered[Math.floor(seededRand(seed) * unfiltered.length)];
888:   }
889:   return pool[Math.floor(seededRand(seed) * pool.length)];
890: }
891: export function generateQuestBoard(viewedRank, partyStrength, seed, playerRank) {
892:   const templates = QUEST_TEMPLATES[viewedRank];
893:   if (!templates) return [];
894:   const normalPred = (t) => !t.boss && !t.gemMining;
895:   const minePred = (t) => !!t.gemMining;
896:   const bossPred = (t) => !!t.boss && !t.raidBoss;
897:   const raidPred = (t) => !!t.boss && !!t.raidBoss;
898:   const gap = playerRank ? computeRankGap(playerRank, viewedRank) : 0;
899:   const lockedSubTier = subTierForRankGap(gap);
900:   const boardQuests = [];
901:   const used = new Set();
902:   for (let i = 0; i < BOARD_MIX_SLOTS.length; i++) {
903:     const subTier = lockedSubTier || BOARD_MIX_SLOTS[i];
904:     const slotSeed = seed + i * 1000;
905:     const idx = pickTemplate(templates, normalPred, slotSeed + 1, used);
906:     if (idx < 0) continue;
907:     used.add(idx);
908:     const quest = generateQuestInstance(viewedRank, idx, slotSeed, partyStrength);
909:     if (!quest) continue;
910:     applySubTierRewards(quest, subTier);
911:     boardQuests.push(quest);
912:   }
913:   const slotSeed = seed + 4 * 1000;
914:   const wildcardType = rollWildcardType(viewedRank, slotSeed + 777);
915:   let wildcardPred = normalPred;
916:   let wildcardSubTier = lockedSubTier || 'standard';
917:   if (wildcardType === 'mine') {
918:     wildcardPred = minePred;
919:     if (!lockedSubTier) wildcardSubTier = rollMineSubTier(slotSeed + 778);
920:   } else if (wildcardType === 'boss') {
921:     wildcardPred = bossPred;
922:     if (!lockedSubTier) {
923:       wildcardSubTier = seededRand(slotSeed + 779) < 0.625 ? 'hard' : 'brutal';
924:     }
925:   } else if (wildcardType === 'raidBoss') {
926:     wildcardPred = raidPred;
927:     wildcardSubTier = 'brutal';
928:   }
929:   const wildcardIdx = pickTemplate(templates, wildcardPred, slotSeed + 1, used);
930:   if (wildcardIdx >= 0) {
931:     used.add(wildcardIdx);
932:     const quest = generateQuestInstance(viewedRank, wildcardIdx, slotSeed, partyStrength);
933:     if (quest) {
934:       applySubTierRewards(quest, wildcardSubTier);
935:       boardQuests.push(quest);
936:     }
937:   } else {
938:     const idx = pickTemplate(templates, normalPred, slotSeed + 2, used);
939:     if (idx >= 0) {
940:       used.add(idx);
941:       const quest = generateQuestInstance(viewedRank, idx, slotSeed, partyStrength);
942:       if (quest) {
943:         applySubTierRewards(quest, lockedSubTier || 'standard');
944:         boardQuests.push(quest);
945:       }
946:     }
947:   }
948:   return boardQuests;
949: }
950: export function shouldRefreshBoard(lastRefreshed) {
951:   if (!lastRefreshed) return true;
952:   return Date.now() - lastRefreshed >= BOARD_REFRESH_MS;
953: }
954: export { BOARD_REFRESH_MS };
````

````javascript
149: export function calculateTowerLoot(floorsCleared) {
150:   const loot = [];
151:   let totalGold = 0;
152:   for (let f = 1; f <= floorsCleared; f++) {
153:     totalGold += TOWER_CONFIG.GOLD_PER_FLOOR.base + (f * TOWER_CONFIG.GOLD_PER_FLOOR.scale);
154:   }
155:   let totalExp = 0;
156:   for (let f = 1; f <= floorsCleared; f++) {
157:     totalExp += TOWER_CONFIG.EXP_PER_FLOOR.base + (f * TOWER_CONFIG.EXP_PER_FLOOR.scale);
158:   }
159:   for (const threshold of TOWER_CONFIG.GEM_BAG_THRESHOLDS) {
160:     if (floorsCleared >= threshold.floor) {
161:       if (Math.random() < threshold.chance) {
162:         loot.push({ itemId: threshold.itemId, quantity: 1 });
163:       }
164:     }
165:   }
166:   const checkpoints = Math.floor(floorsCleared / 10);
167:   let celestialsDropped = 0;
168:   for (let cp = 1; cp <= checkpoints; cp++) {
169:     const chance = Math.min(
170:       TOWER_CONFIG.CELESTIAL_MAX_CHANCE,
171:       TOWER_CONFIG.CELESTIAL_BASE_CHANCE + (cp * TOWER_CONFIG.CELESTIAL_CHANCE_PER_10)
172:     );
173:     if (Math.random() < chance && celestialsDropped < TOWER_CONFIG.CELESTIAL_MAX_ITEMS) {
174:       const itemId = CELESTIAL_ITEMS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CELESTIAL_ITEMS.length)];
175:       loot.push({ itemId, quantity: 1 });
176:       celestialsDropped++;
177:     }
178:   }
179:   const rankPoints = Math.floor(floorsCleared * 500 + Math.pow(floorsCleared, 1.5) * 100);
180:   return { gold: totalGold, exp: totalExp, rankPoints, loot };
181: }
````

````javascript
144:     if (autoRun && autoRun.remaining > 0) {
145:       const nextQuest = Game.pickQuestByStrategy(autoRun.rank, autoRun.strategy);
146:       if (nextQuest) {
147:         const result = Game.startQuest(nextQuest.id);
148:         if (!result.ok) {
149:           Game.state.autoRun = null;
150:         } else {
151:           Game.state.autoRun.remaining--;
152:         }
153:       } else {
154:         Game.state.autoRun = null;
155:       }
156:     } else if (autoRun) {
157:       Game.state.autoRun = null;
158:     }
159:     render();
160:   });
161:   document.getElementById('btn-new-game-header').addEventListener('click', () => {
162:     if (!confirm('Start a new game? All progress will be lost.')) return;
163:     Game.stopTick();
164:     Game.deleteSave();
165:     _started = false;
166:     currentTab = 'hall';
167:     resetPartyState();
168:     resetQuestsState();
169:     markHallDirty();
170:     showNewGameModal();
171:   });
172:   window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
173:     if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') Game.save();
174:   });
175:   render();
176: }
````

## File: js/util.js
````javascript
 1: const ESC_MAP = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' };
 2: export function esc(str) {
 3:   if (typeof str !== 'string') return String(str ?? '');
 4:   return str.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ESC_MAP[c]);
 5: }
 6: export function rankCss(rank) {
 7:   if (rank === 'S++') return 'Spp';
 8:   if (rank === 'S+') return 'Sp';
 9:   return rank;
10: }
````
